abstract: Do workers from social groups with comparable productivity distributions obtain comparable lifetime earnings? We study how a small amount of early-career discrimination propagates over time when workers’ productivity is revealed through employment. In breakdown learning environments that primarily track on-the-job failures, such discrimination spirals into a substantial lifetime earnings gap for groups of comparable productivity, whereas in breakthrough learning environments that track successes, early-career discrimination can be self-corrected, so comparable groups obtain comparable lifetime earnings. This contrast persists in large labor markets and with flexible wages, inconclusive learning, and misspecified employer beliefs.
abstract_zh: 来自生产力分布相似的社会群体的工人，是否能够获得相当水平的终身收入？我们研究了当工人的生产力通过就业逐步显现时，早期职业生涯中微小的歧视如何随时间扩散。
title: Early-Career Discrimination: Spiraling or Self-Correcting?
title_zh: 早期职业歧视：螺旋上升还是自我修正？

abstract: We study a parsimonious model of a competitive labor market in which firms privately screen workers to identify talent. The equilibrium exhibits dispersion in wages and productivity; when talent is scarce, firms with superior screening skills post higher wages, attract better applicants, and recruit more talented workers. High-wage firms impose a compositional externality on low-wage firms, leading to equilibrium inefficiency: Welfare would be higher if low-skilled firms posted high wages and selected first. We also provide a micro-foundation for firms heterogeneous screening skills. When talented workers are better at screening (e.g. via superior referrals), a dynamic version of the economy converges to a unique steady state in which differences in talent, profits and screening skills persist forever.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个竞争性劳动力市场的简约模型，其中企业私下筛选工人以识别人才。均衡状态表现出工资和生产率的分化；当人才稀缺时，筛选技能更优的企业会提供更高的工资，吸引更优秀的申请者，并招募到更有才华的工人。
title: Recruiting Talent
title_zh: 招募人才

abstract: Economic globalization in the 21st century has been characterized by the emergence and expansion of the global value chain (GVC). Producer services are essential to the modernization and structural transformation of the manufacturing sector, and their agglomeration patterns significantly influence firms' GVC position. Our study addresses a critical gap in the literature by examining how producer services agglomeration (PSA) affects the GVC position of manufacturing firms in a global context. Our empirical analysis, based on a comprehensive dataset that encompasses 600,000 firms in China from 2003 to 2014, reveals several key findings. PSA significantly enhances manufacturing firms' GVC upstreamness. This agglomeration effect manifests heterogeneity across firm characteristics, industrial sectors, and geographic regions. The positive impact of PSA operates through the home market effect (HME) and productivity effect, the labor pool effect, and the innovation and knowledge spillover effects. Our work extends conventional agglomeration theories by incorporating the GVC framework, offering a more nuanced analysis of how PSA influences the global competitiveness of manufacturing firms. Our findings highlight that firms can leverage the favorable conditions generated by PSA to enhance productivity, foster technological innovation, and deepen participation in the global division of labor.

abstract: We use a large episode of trade liberalization in Spain to test a rich set of channels linking trade and markups. The effect of reductions in import tariffs on firm‐level and aggregate markups is pro‐competitive, but there are offsetting effects via other channels. We show that firms with high intangible investment experience a weaker reduction in markups. This provides evidence for the concentration channel highlighted by recent theoretical work. We find weak evidence for reallocation effects and conclude that the relationship between trade and markups is mostly driven by changes at the intensive margin, changes in firm‐level markups.
title: Globalization and Market Power

abstract: Some European countries such as Greece which was already financially unstable, have strongly felt the aftershocks of the crises such as COVID-19 and the Russia-Ukraine war. This severely affected the lives of common households, as the government withdrew the major subsidies and exposed them to market vulnerabilities. To visualize the impacts of such devastating events on households, this study investigates the determinants of energy poverty in Greece. To do so, the paper investigates the distributional and tail-specific relationships between macroeconomic factors, and various dimensions of energy poverty in a persistently fragile economy with long-standing exposure to economic crises. This study has used a non-linear approach by combining bivariate and multivariate quantile-on-quantile regression (QQR) with causality-in-quantiles in mean (CIQ−MEAN). to capture the dynamic and distribution-wise relationship between financial stress, economic policy uncertainty, macroeconomic resilience, and institutional quality and various dimensions of energy poverty. The results exhibit asymmetric and nonlinear association across the energy-poverty distribution. Financial stress and economic policy uncertainty are more strongly associated with low-income households. While, the higher institutional resilience helps in reducing deprivation. These associations have some moderating effect of the quality of institutions, but not of a linear type. The patterns imply that energy-poverty outcomes are state-dependent, meaning macroeconomic pressures and institutional capacity are interrelated. The results also highlight some important policy implications to maximize the households’ welfare during the crisis period.
abstract_zh: 一些欧洲国家，例如本就财政不稳定的希腊，强烈感受到了COVID-19和俄乌战争等危机的余波。由于政府取消了主要补贴并使民众暴露于市场脆弱性之中，这严重影响了普通家庭的生活。为直观呈现此类破坏性事件对家庭的影响，本研究考察了希腊能源贫困的决定因素。为此，本文在一个长期脆弱且长期暴露于经济危机的经济体中，研究了宏观经济因素与能源贫困多个维度之间的分布性关系和尾部特定关系。本研究采用非线性方法，将双变量和多变量分位数对分位数回归（QQR）与均值中的分位数因果推断（CIQ−MEAN）相结合，以捕捉金融压力、经济政策不确定性、宏观经济韧性和制度质量与能源贫困多个维度之间的动态关系和分布关系。结果表明，在能源贫困分布上存在非对称和非线性关联。金融压力和经济政策不确定性与低收入家庭的关联更强。而更高的制度韧性有助于减少剥夺。这些关联受到制度质量的一定调节作用，但并非线性类型。这些模式意味着能源贫困结果具有状态依赖性，即宏观经济压力与制度能力相互关联。研究结果还强调了一些重要的政策启示，以在危机时期最大化家庭福利。
title: The pulse of energy poverty in Greece: The role of financial stress, uncertainty, and institutional resilience
title_zh: 希腊能源贫困的脉搏：金融压力、不确定性与制度韧性的作用

abstract: Discouraged workers are those who have given up searching for work because of the (perceived) low chances of obtaining it. In this paper we develop a stochastic structural econometric framework for analyzing discouraged worker behavior based on the theory of job search and the notion of probabilistic rationality and risky choice. Subsequently, we conduct an empirical analysis of immigrant women from non-Western countries and women born in Norway, using microdata on labor force participation and unemployment. We find that the discouraged worker effect is particularly high among immigrant women with low wage rates and many children.
abstract_zh: 沮丧劳动者是指那些因（感知到的）获得工作机会渺茫而放弃求职的人群。本文基于工作搜寻理论以及概率理性与风险选择的概念，构建了一个随机结构计量经济学框架，用以分析沮丧劳动者行为。随后，我们利用劳动力参与和失业的微观数据，对来自非西方国家的移民女性及挪威本土出生的女性进行了实证分析。研究发现，沮丧劳动者效应在工资率低且子女众多的移民女性群体中尤为显著。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 249
title: Stochastic modeling of labor supply and discouraged worker behavior
title_zh: 劳动力供给与受挫工人行为的随机建模

abstract: Normative theories assume that people have stable preferences across logically equivalent decision contexts. Preference reversals, cases where preferred options vary across decision contexts, violate this assumption and suggest that preferences are constructed during the decision-making process. We contribute to this literature by identifying a boundary condition for these context effects. We theorize that monetary preference elicitations, such as willingness to pay (WTP) and willingness to accept (WTA), evoke comparisons to external out-of-context standards, such as the market price of similar goods. These out-of-context comparisons should weaken the influence of the local context. Our theory predicts that context effects will be weaker for (1) monetary versus nonmonetary preference elicitations (e.g., WTP/WTA versus choice) and when (2) options differ on attributes highly correlated with market prices of similar goods and services. Across 22 studies, we find support for these predictions using three canonical decision context effects (intertemporal tradeoffs, framing effects, and attraction effects), incentive-compatible and stated preferences, and different response formats (binary, continuous, and mixed). Preferences for a wide range of goods and services—including baked goods, apartments, and lotteries—exhibit these patterns. Our theory explains substantial variance in context effects and offers testable predictions for when context effects will arise in research and practice. This paper was accepted by George Wu, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: This work was supported by Connaught Fund. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00913 .
abstract_zh: 规范性理论假设人们在逻辑等价的决策情境中拥有稳定的偏好。偏好反转，即在不同决策情境中偏好选项发生变化的现象，违反了这一假设，并表明偏好是在决策过程中构建的。我们通过识别这些情境效应的边界条件，为该文献做出贡献。我们理论化认为，货币性偏好诱导方法，如支付意愿（WTP）和接受意愿（WTA），会引发与外部情境外标准（如类似商品的市场价格）的比较。这些情境外比较应削弱局部情境的影响。我们的理论预测，情境效应在以下情况下会较弱：（1）货币性偏好诱导与非货币性偏好诱导（例如，WTP/WTA与选择）相比，以及（2）当选项在属性上高度相关于类似商品和服务的市场价格时。通过22项研究，我们使用三种经典的决策情境效应（跨期权衡、框架效应和吸引效应）、激励兼容和陈述性偏好，以及不同的响应格式（二元、连续和混合），找到了支持这些预测的证据。对广泛商品和服务的偏好——包括烘焙食品、公寓和彩票——均表现出这些模式。我们的理论解释了情境效应中的大量方差，并为研究和实践中情境效应何时会出现提供了可检验的预测。本文由乔治·吴（George Wu）在行为经济学与决策分析领域接受。资助：本研究由康诺特基金（Connaught Fund）支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00913 获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Why Context Influences Preferences Elicited with Willingness to Pay Less Than Preferences Elicited with Choice
title_zh: 为何支付意愿所揭示的偏好受情境影响小于选择所揭示的偏好

abstract: Exotic, invasive conifer tree species, known as ‘wilding conifers’, pose a significant threat to natural ecosystems and are costly to manage, creating a need to identify community preferences in order to inform and balance public investment in their control. Currently, approximately 7% of New Zealand's total land area is covered by invasive wilding conifers, and the rate of spread is approximately 5% per year. This study analysed the preferences of the New Zealand population regarding the control of wilding conifers in indigenous ecosystems using a choice experiment. The results, obtained through a mixed logistic model in willingness‐to‐pay space, showed that the public places significant value on controlling the spread of wilding conifers. Preferences for control displayed distance decay and diminishing marginal utility. The study also examined the spatial heterogeneity of preferences in terms of distance decay and the spatial dimension of scope. Finally, the study estimated the value of controlling the spread of wilding conifers nationally, which was found to be about NZ$147 million annually, and broadly consistent with the economic damage caused by other major invasive weeds in New Zealand. These findings confirm the importance of spatial factors in explaining preferences for the control of invasive trees and demonstrate how policymakers can use the estimated values to measure the benefits of different control options.
abstract_zh: 外来入侵性针叶树种，即所谓的“野生针叶树”，对自然生态系统构成重大威胁，且管理成本高昂，因此有必要识别社区偏好，以指导并平衡对其控制措施的公共投资。目前，新西兰约7%的国土面积被入侵性野生针叶树覆盖，且扩散速度约为每年5%。本研究采用选择实验法，分析了新西兰民众对控制本土生态系统中野生针叶树的偏好。通过支付意愿空间中的混合逻辑模型所得结果显示，公众对控制野生针叶树扩散赋予了显著价值。控制偏好表现出距离衰减和边际效用递减的特征。研究还考察了偏好的空间异质性，涉及距离衰减和范围的空间维度。最后，研究估算了全国范围内控制野生针叶树扩散的价值，发现约为每年1.47亿新西兰元，与新西兰其他主要入侵杂草造成的经济损失大致相符。这些发现证实了空间因素在解释对入侵树木控制偏好中的重要性，并展示了政策制定者如何利用估算价值来衡量不同控制方案的收益。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: The Value of Controlling Wilding Conifers in New Zealand
title_zh: 控制新西兰野生针叶树的价值

abstract: This paper examines how firms responded to the disruptions caused by the global supply chain (GSC) shocks induced by the COVID‐19 pandemic. Leveraging firm‐level trade data from France, we analyze shifts in export and import values and prices in response to transportation bottlenecks and pandemic containment measures in partner countries. Our findings reveal that firms adapted to these shocks by temporarily scaling back trade volumes and dropping varieties. During the recovery phase, supply chain bottlenecks stoked price hikes, disproportionately affecting upstream industries. Furthermore, we demonstrate that firms using industrial robots in production and those with prudent inventory management practices were more resilient to the pandemic shock.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业如何应对由COVID-19疫情引发的全球供应链（GSC）冲击所导致的 disruptions。利用法国企业层面的贸易数据，我们分析了在运输瓶颈及伙伴国疫情管控措施下，出口和进口价值及价格的变动。研究发现，企业通过暂时缩减贸易规模和减少产品种类来适应这些冲击。在复苏阶段，供应链瓶颈加剧了价格上涨，对上游行业影响尤为显著。此外，我们证明，在生产中使用工业机器人的企业以及采取审慎库存管理实践的企业，对疫情冲击表现出更强的韧性。
title: Pandemic disruptions in global supply chains: Evidence on trade values and prices from French firms
title_zh: 全球供应链中的疫情中断：来自法国企业的贸易价值与价格证据

abstract: Trade networks underpinning the energy transition are endogenous economic objects, and their structure is a source of market power. Using bilateral trade data for thirteen electrification metals over 1995–2023, we show that trade in these materials has reorganised into a hub-and-spoke system centred on China, in sharp contrast to the more diffuse, multilateral structure of fossil fuels. This centrality did not follow from resource endowments: China holds few of the underlying reserves. It was built through processing investment, industrial policy, and commodity-targeted development finance, an equilibrium outcome rather than a geographical accident. We formalise this logic in a stylised model in which a country chooses how central to become, and show that centrality can map into pricing power: the response of the world price of critical minerals to a supply cut is stronger when the network is more concentrated, the downstream demand and the competitive fringe supply are more inelastic. Constructing text-based, commodity-specific supply shocks and estimating local projections, we find that supply contractions in critical metals raise consumer inflation in the European Union and the United States by roughly twice as much as comparable fossil-fuel shocks, and more persistently. Centrality is therefore not merely a descriptive feature of the new resource map: it can create leverage over global prices. The green transition reduces strategic dependence on hydrocarbon exporters but reconstitutes it around the architecture of mineral supply chains.
abstract_zh: 支撑能源转型的贸易网络是内生的经济对象，其结构构成市场势力的来源。利用1995年至2023年间十三种电气化金属的双边贸易数据，我们表明这些材料的贸易已重组为以中国为中心的轴辐体系，与化石燃料更为分散、多边的结构形成鲜明对比。这种中心地位并非源于资源禀赋：中国仅持有其中少部分的基础储量。它是通过加工投资、产业政策和针对特定大宗商品的发展融资构建而成，是均衡结果而非地理偶然。我们在一个简约模型中形式化了这一逻辑，在该模型中，一国选择其中心化程度，并表明中心地位可转化为定价权：当网络更为集中、下游需求及竞争性边缘供给更具刚性时，关键矿产的世界价格对供给削减的反应更为强烈。通过构建基于文本的、针对特定商品的供给冲击并估计局部投影，我们发现关键金属的供给收缩使欧盟和美国的消费者通胀上升幅度约为可比化石燃料冲击的两倍，且持续性更强。因此，中心地位不仅是新资源版图的描述性特征：它能够对全球价格产生杠杆作用。绿色转型减少了对碳氢化合物出口国的战略依赖，但围绕矿产供应链的架构重新构建了这种依赖。

abstract: To evaluate the impact of group identity on belief formation, we conducted online experiments before and after the 2020 US presidential election. We elicit participants’ beliefs about future unemployment statistics and health system rankings and provide relevant news summaries. We find that people pay money to avoid information from political outgroups and attribute lower weight to this information when updating beliefs. An intervention which unlabels information sources decreases outgroup information avoidance by 50%, with a significant impact on only groupish participants. A debiasing intervention equalizing instrumental values of information sources reduces only universalists’ WTP for a private signal. The interventions have little effect on information processing. The evidence is consistent with a source-utility channel contributing to polarization.
abstract_zh: 为评估群体身份对信念形成的影响，我们在2020年美国总统选举前后进行了在线实验。我们引导参与者表达对未来失业统计和医疗体系排名的信念，并提供相关新闻摘要。研究发现，人们愿意支付金钱以避免来自政治外群体的信息，并在更新信念时赋予此类信息较低权重。一项去除信息来源标签的干预措施将外群体信息回避行为减少了50%，且仅对具有强烈群体倾向的参与者产生显著影响。一项旨在平衡信息来源工具价值的去偏干预仅降低了普遍主义者的私人信号支付意愿。这些干预措施对信息处理过程影响甚微。证据与来源效用渠道促进两极化的观点一致。
title: Group Identity and Belief Formation: A Microfoundation of Political Polarization
title_zh: 群体身份与信念形成：政治极化的微观基础

abstract: Remote work policies remain controversial partly because of productivity concerns, which are potentially exacerbated in team settings. Using experiments, we isolate how location-based beliefs of teammate effort affect the own-effort choices of participants assigned to work with remote and office-based teammates. Participants perform a real effort task and can contribute this effort to an individual account, paying a piece rate wage, or to a team account using a minimum-effort payment scheme. We find that remote workers do not complete fewer tasks than their office-based counterparts. Yet, teams suffer from lower effort due to workers responding to beliefs that remote teammates contribute less effort to the team. In a follow-up treatment, we demonstrate that these location-based beliefs remain salient even under a revenue-sharing team payment scheme where beliefs of free-riding may have dominated. Finally, we provide unique evidence that the COVID-19 pandemic may have shifted beliefs to be more pessimistic about the effort of remote workers but did not alter the actual effort.
abstract_zh: 远程工作政策仍具争议，部分原因在于对生产力的担忧，而这种担忧在团队环境中可能被进一步放大。通过实验，我们分离出关于团队成员努力程度的地点性信念如何影响被分配与远程及办公室同事合作的参与者的自身努力选择。参与者执行一项实际努力任务，并可将该努力贡献至个人账户（按计件工资支付）或团队账户（采用最低努力支付方案）。我们发现，远程工作者完成的任务数量并不少于办公室同事。然而，团队因工人对远程同事贡献较少努力的信念而遭受努力水平下降。在后续处理中，我们证明即使在可能以搭便车信念为主导的收入共享团队支付方案下，这些基于地点的信念仍然显著。最后，我们提供独特证据表明，COVID-19大流行可能使人们对远程工作者努力的信念变得更加悲观，但并未改变实际努力水平。
title: Remote work and effort provision in teams
title_zh: 远程工作与团队中的努力供给

abstract: Child benefits in Canada are sizable, targeted to children and paid to custodial mothers, and so might be expected to affect household resource allocations and spousal bargaining. The introduction of the Canada Child Benefit in July 2016 more than doubled the amount of child benefits received by households with children. We estimate the effect of this change on the preferences and resource shares of men and women within dual‐parent households. Resource shares, defined as the fraction of household expenditure consumed by women versus men, are important parameters of collective household models. Using a difference‐in‐differences strategy within a structural collective household model, we find little evidence that preferences of either men or women changed in response to the increase in child benefits. However, we do find evidence that the policy increased female resource shares, but only among homeowner (and not renter) households. We discuss this heterogeneity in the treatment effect between owners and renters and suggest potential underlying mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 加拿大的儿童福利金数额可观，专门针对儿童发放，并支付给监护母亲，因此可能预期会影响家庭资源配置和配偶间的议价能力。2016年7月推出的加拿大儿童福利金使有子女家庭获得的儿童福利金额增加了一倍以上。我们估计了这一变化对双亲家庭中男性和女性偏好及资源份额的影响。资源份额，即女性相对于男性所消费的家庭支出比例，是集体家庭模型中的重要参数。利用结构集体家庭模型中的双重差分策略，我们发现几乎没有证据表明男性或女性的偏好因儿童福利金的增加而发生变化。然而，我们确实发现该政策提高了女性的资源份额，但仅限于有房家庭（而非租房家庭）。我们讨论了房主与租户之间处理效应的这种异质性，并提出了潜在的潜在机制。
title: How did the Canada Child Benefit affect household bargaining?
title_zh: 加拿大儿童福利如何影响家庭议价？

abstract: Managing time is an important aspect of student success. In this paper, we identify the impacts of a student’s timetable on their attendance, study habits, and academic achievement. We use detailed administrative and survey data from a public UK university that includes students from a broad range of degree programmes. Our data feature quasi-random assignment of students to their timetables and measure their individual hourly attendance decisions. We consider multiple aspects of timetables including single-class days, back-to-back classes, time-of-day, day-of-instruction and total hours. We find that student attendance is highly dependent on timetable structure. Single-class days reduce attendance and back-to-back classes raise it. Attendance also varies by time-of-day and day-of-week. We document that students compensate for marginal non-attendance at some events with increased attendance at others within the same module and that more conscientious students respond by increasing study time. Net of all behavioural responses, however, these timetable features and attendance choices do not have systematic impacts on academic achievement. Subsample analysis suggests that lab-based modules and compulsory modules are where timetables may play the most meaningful role in impacting marks.
abstract_zh: 时间管理是学生成功的重要方面。本文旨在识别学生课程表对其出勤、学习习惯及学业成绩的影响。我们利用来自英国一所公立大学的详细行政与调查数据，该数据涵盖广泛学位课程的学生。我们的数据特点在于学生课程表的准随机分配，并测量了学生每小时的出勤决策。我们考察了课程表的多个方面，包括单日单课、连续课程、上课时段、教学日及总课时。研究发现，学生出勤高度依赖于课程表结构。单日单课降低了出勤率，而连续课程则提高了出勤率。出勤情况亦随上课时段和星期几而变化。我们记录到，学生会在同一模块内以增加其他活动出勤的方式，来补偿对某些活动的边际缺勤，且更为认真的学生会通过增加学习时间作为回应。然而，在考虑所有行为反应后，这些课程表特征及出勤选择并未对学业成绩产生系统性影响。子样本分析表明，实验室模块和必修模块是课程表可能对成绩产生最显著影响的领域。
title: Timetables, attendance and academic achievement in higher education
title_zh: 高等教育中的课程表、出勤率与学业成绩

abstract: Urban form is undergoing rapid transformation amid global politico-economic transitions, yet the mechanisms shaping these changes in non-Western contexts remain under-theorized. Taking China’s transition as an example, we reconceptualize the transition by adding regionalization into the traditional framework of decentralization, marketization, and globalization, highlighting the role of regional cooperation. We delineate the evolution of urban form through morphological analysis in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area (GBA) from 2010 to 2019, and employ regression methods to validate the pathways through which this extended transitional framework influences form outcomes. Empirical results demonstrate that urban form is co-shaped by local governments’ fiscal expenditure, land market prices, foreign direct investment, and the intensity of inter-city cooperation. A compound growth model integrating industrial land, transport networks, and real estate is emerging as a significant mechanism forging urban spatial structure. Overall, our study reaffirms the pivotal impact of local government play among the various actors shaping urban development and spatial configuration in China. While regionalization has shown tangible effects in enhancing inter-city collaboration and reducing regional disparities, it has yet to fundamentally transform the entrenched governance logic through which local governments leverage land markets to drive urban growth.
abstract_zh: 在全球政治经济转型的背景下，城市形态正经历快速变革，然而在非西方情境下塑造这些变化的机制仍未得到充分理论化。以中国的转型为例，我们通过将区域化纳入传统的分权化、市场化与全球化分析框架中，重新概念化这一转型过程，并强调区域合作的作用。我们运用形态分析方法，描绘了2010年至2019年间粤港澳大湾区城市形态的演变，并采用回归方法验证了这一扩展转型框架影响形态结果的路径。实证结果表明，城市形态受到地方政府财政支出、土地市场价格、外商直接投资及城际合作强度的共同塑造。一个整合工业用地、交通网络与房地产的复合增长模式，正成为塑造城市空间结构的重要机制。总体而言，本研究重申了地方政府在中国城市发展与空间格局塑造的多元主体中所发挥的关键作用。尽管区域化在增强城际协作与缩小区域差距方面已显现出切实成效，但其尚未从根本上改变地方政府借助土地市场驱动城市增长的固有治理逻辑。

title: Urban form under China’s politico-economic transition: The role of decentralization, marketization, globalization, and regionalization in the Greater Bay Area
title_zh: 中国政治经济转型下的城市形态：粤港澳大湾区中分权、市场化、全球化与区域化的作用

abstract: Understanding the role of international trade in sustainable manufacturing development is a critical area of industrial research. This study investigates the impact of imports on manufacturing development within a sustainable framework encompassing economic, environmental, and social dimensions. Using city-level panel data from Guangdong Province, China, we find that imports have a positive impact on sustainable manufacturing development. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that this positive effect is more pronounced for labour-intensive and technology-intensive imports, midstream imports along the supply chain, and in cities with greater sectoral complexity within the manufacturing sector. Further analysis indicates that increased imports enhance key aspects of sustainable manufacturing development, including innovation capability, structural optimization, inclusive development, and public support, while negatively affecting green production.
abstract_zh: 理解国际贸易在可持续制造业发展中的作用是工业研究的一个关键领域。本研究在涵盖经济、环境和社会维度的可持续框架内，探讨了进口对制造业发展的影响。利用中国广东省的城市级面板数据，我们发现进口对可持续制造业发展具有积极影响。异质性分析显示，这一积极效应在劳动密集型和技术密集型进口、供应链中游进口以及制造业部门内行业复杂度较高的城市中更为显著。进一步分析表明，进口增加提升了可持续制造业发展的关键方面，包括创新能力、结构优化、包容性发展和公共支持，而对绿色生产产生了负面影响。

title: Imports and sustainable manufacturing development: evidence from Guangdong, China
title_zh: 进口与制造业可持续发展：来自中国广东的证据

abstract: The increasing frequency of extreme natural risks, coupled with volatility in the international financial environment, has exerted dual pressures on national monetary policy regulation and the global trade landscape. Based on a global panel dataset covering 62 countries from 2005 to 2023, this study employs three-stage least squares (3SLS), fixed-effects panel models, and an endogenous Kernel Regularized Quantile Regression (KRQR) to systematically examine the independent and interactive effects of natural risk shocks and policy-rate changes on international trade. The baseline findings highlight the significant synergistic disruptive effects in emerging markets (EMs). Post-disaster forced monetary tightening significantly exacerbated the export contraction, while imports exhibited post-disaster rigidity, showing minimal sensitivity to this dual shock. Crucially, the non-linear KRQR estimates reveal a profound distributional asymmetry. While advanced economies (AEs) demonstrate the macro-financial capacity for post-shock trade recovery, EMs suffer from a complete absence of upside resilience, falling into a liquidity-induced trade stagnation under the compound shock. This paper explores the macroeconomic consequences of natural risks from a unique perspective focusing on the monetary-trade transmission mechanism. It emphasizes the crucial role of central banks in balancing inflation targets and trade stability in vulnerable economies amid escalating natural risks.
abstract_zh: 极端自然风险频发叠加国际金融环境波动，对各国货币政策调控与全球贸易格局形成双重压力。基于2005至2023年覆盖62个国家的全球面板数据集，本研究运用三阶段最小二乘法（3SLS）、固定效应面板模型及内生核正则化分位数回归（KRQR），系统考察自然风险冲击与政策利率变动对国际贸易的独立效应及交互效应。基准结果凸显了新兴市场（EMs）中显著的协同破坏效应：灾后被迫性货币紧缩显著加剧出口收缩，而进口则呈现灾后刚性，对此双重冲击的敏感度极低。关键在于，非线性KRQR估计揭示了深刻的分布不对称性：尽管发达经济体（AEs）展现出冲击后贸易复苏的宏观金融能力，新兴市场却完全缺乏上行韧性，在复合冲击下陷入流动性引致的贸易停滞。本文从聚焦货币—贸易传导机制的独特视角，探讨自然风险的宏观经济后果，强调在自然风险不断升级背景下，中央银行在脆弱经济体中平衡通胀目标与贸易稳定方面的关键作用。

title: Natural risk disclosure, monetary policy, and international trade: empirical evidence from global data
title_zh: 自然风险披露、货币政策与国际贸易：来自全球数据的经验证据

abstract: This article examines the effects of persistent negative terms-of-trade (ToT) shocks on economic performance in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) using a local projections difference-in-differences (LP-DiD) approach. This methodology allows for flexible estimation of dynamic treatment effects while controlling for GDP dynamics and contemporaneous shocks. The results show that persistent negative ToT shocks generate delayed but economically meaningful reductions in GDP per capita, with effects accumulating gradually and lasting up to 9 years. The estimated contractions are significantly larger in SSA than in the rest of the world. This heightened vulnerability reflects the region’s structural characteristics – high commodity dependence, low economic diversification, limited financial development, and weaker institutional quality. Heterogeneity analyses further reveal that countries with deeper financial systems and stronger institutions experience smaller and less persistent losses. Overall, the findings underscore the importance of financial development, institutional strengthening, and export diversification in enhancing resilience to persistent adverse ToT shocks in SSA.
abstract_zh: 本文采用局部投影双重差分（LP-DiD）方法，考察了持续负向贸易条件（ToT）冲击对撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）经济表现的影响。该方法能够在控制GDP动态和同期冲击的同时，灵活估计动态处理效应。结果表明，持续负向贸易条件冲击会引发延迟但具有经济意义的GDP人均水平下降，其影响逐步累积并持续长达9年。与全球其他地区相比，SSA地区的估计收缩幅度显著更大。这种更高的脆弱性反映了该地区的结构性特征——高度依赖大宗商品、经济多元化程度低、金融发展有限以及制度质量较弱。异质性分析进一步揭示，金融体系更深化、制度更健全的国家所遭受的损失更小且持续性更弱。总体而言，研究结果强调了金融发展、制度强化和出口多元化在增强SSA地区抵御持续不利贸易条件冲击能力方面的重要性。
title: On the effects of persistent negative terms-of-trade shocks on growth: new evidence from Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 持续性贸易条件负面冲击对增长的影响：来自撒哈拉以南非洲的新证据

abstract: Advances in artificial intelligence and data analytics have notably expanded employers’ monitoring and surveillance capabilities. While new digital monitoring (DM) technologies facilitate the accurate observability of work effort, their productivity and broader welfare implications remain subject to debate. In this context, many countries confer information, consultation and co-determination rights to employee representation (ER) bodies on matters related to workplace organization and the introduction of new technologies, which could potentially discourage employers from making DM investments. Using a cross-sectional sample of more than 21,000 European establishments, we find instead that establishments with ER are more likely to utilize DM technologies than establishments without ER. We also document a positive effect of ER on DM utilization in the context of a local-randomization regression discontinuity analysis that exploits size-contingent policy rules governing the operation of ER bodies in Europe. We rationalize this unexpected finding through the lens of a theoretical model in which shared governance via ER creates organizational safeguards that mitigate workers’ control-averse responses to monitoring.
abstract_zh: 人工智能与数据分析技术的进步显著扩展了雇主的监控与监督能力。尽管新型数字监控（DM）技术有助于精确观测工作投入，但其生产率及更广泛的福利影响仍存争议。在此背景下，许多国家赋予员工代表（ER）机构在工作场所组织及新技术引入相关事务上的知情权、协商权与共同决策权，这可能抑制雇主进行DM投资。基于对超过21,000家欧洲企业的横截面样本，我们发现，与无ER机构的企业相比，设有ER机构的企业更倾向于采用DM技术。我们还利用欧洲ER机构运作中基于规模的政策规则，通过局部随机化回归断点分析，记录了ER对DM利用的积极影响。我们通过一个理论模型来解释这一意外发现，该模型认为，经由ER实现的共同治理创造了组织保障机制，从而缓解了员工对监控的抵触反应。
title: Contested Transparency: Digital Monitoring Technologies and Worker Voice
title_zh: 争议中的透明度：数字监控技术与工人话语权

abstract: When a central bank buys lower inflation with unemployment, does it get fewer price increases or more price cuts? We answer this for the United States by decomposing the Phillips multiplier — the cumulative inflation response to a monetary shock that raises unemployment by one percentage point — into its two directional margins, using 245 disaggregated PCE sub-indices and identified monetary shocks. Before 1990, a one-point rise in the cumulative unemployment gap raises deflationary pressure by 0.4pp: the trade-off runs through price cuts. After 1990, excluding the zero lower bound, weak instruments identify neither the multiplier nor either margin.
abstract_zh: 当中央银行以失业为代价降低通胀时，它获得的是更少的价格上涨还是更多的价格下调？我们通过将菲利普斯乘数——即导致失业率上升一个百分点的货币冲击对通胀的累积反应——分解为其两个方向性边际，利用245个细分的个人消费支出（PCE）子指数及识别出的货币冲击，为美国回答了这一问题。1990年前，累积失业缺口上升一个百分点会使通缩压力增加0.4个百分点：这一权衡通过价格下调实现。1990年后，排除零利率下限情形，弱工具变量既无法识别乘数，也无法识别任一方向性边际。
title: The Phillips multiplier and the two sides of inflation
title_zh: 菲利普斯乘数与通货膨胀的两面性

abstract: We study the product-level effects of Preferential Trade Agreements (PTAs) on the implementation of non-tariff measures (NTMs) using a global database spanning the 2000-2017 period. Employing an instrumental variable strategy, we provide evidence that an increase in the import share of PTA partners leads to a reduction in the application of NTMs. Exploring several mechanisms, we find that these effects are driven by products with higher preferential margins, the gap between MFN and preferential tariff rates. This result is consistent with what we call a “rent preservation effect,” whereby PTA partner countries push to limit the imposition of NTMs in order to preserve their preferential rents. We find that the negative PTA-NTM nexus is stronger for deeper PTAs, technical NTMs, and advanced economies. But there is no evidence that the effects are confined to NTMs that target broader or narrower sets of countries, agricultural products, or products that are subject to more NTMs. Importantly, higher PTA import shares contribute to multilateral liberalization by lowering both the usage of NTMs against PTA members and non-PTA partners.
abstract_zh: 我们利用覆盖2000-2017年期间的全球数据库，研究了特惠贸易协定（PTAs）对非关税措施（NTMs）实施的产品层面影响。采用工具变量策略，我们提供的证据表明，PTA伙伴国进口份额的增加会导致NTMs适用减少。通过探索多种机制，我们发现这些效应由具有较高特惠幅度（即最惠国税率与特惠税率之间的差距）的产品所驱动。这一结果与我们所谓的“租金保全效应”相一致，即PTA伙伴国推动限制NTMs的施加，以维护其特惠租金。我们发现，PTA与NTM之间的负向关联在更深层次的PTA、技术性NTMs以及发达经济体中更为显著。但没有证据表明这些效应仅限于针对更广泛或更狭窄国家群体、农产品或受更多NTMs约束的产品。重要的是，较高的PTA进口份额通过降低对PTA成员国及非PTA伙伴国的NTMs使用，促进了多边自由化。
title: Preferential trade agreements and non-tariff measures
title_zh: 优惠贸易协定与非关税措施

abstract: This paper studies how financial development affects business cycles through entrepreneurial composition. Using Argentine microdata, I show that self-employed entrepreneurs are concentrated below the median of the income distribution and have countercyclical population shares, while employer entrepreneurs are concentrated above the median and have procyclical shares. Motivated by these patterns, I develop a dynamic occupational choice model with aggregate risk in which endogenous sorting across occupations shapes macroeconomic fluctuations. In the calibrated model, financial development raises aggregate output volatility by 8 percent because relaxing collateral constraints shifts economic activity toward employer entrepreneurs, who are more sensitive to aggregate shocks. These findings show that while financial development raises long-run output, it may also increase short-run instability.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了金融发展如何通过企业家构成影响经济周期。利用阿根廷微观数据，我展示了自雇型企业家集中于收入分布中位数以下，其人口份额呈逆周期特征，而雇主型企业家则集中于中位数以上，其份额呈顺周期特征。受这些模式启发，我构建了一个包含总体风险的动态职业选择模型，其中跨职业的内生分类塑造了宏观经济波动。在校准模型中，金融发展使总体产出波动性提高了8%，因为放松抵押约束将经济活动转向对总体冲击更为敏感的雇主型企业家。这些发现表明，尽管金融发展提升了长期产出，但也可能加剧短期不稳定性。
title: Entrepreneurial heterogeneity, financial development, and business cycle dynamics
title_zh: 创业异质性、金融发展与商业周期动态

abstract: Majoritarian democracy is widely regarded as the canonical procedure for converting heterogeneous individual preferences into collective decisions, yet its welfare properties are far more fragile than legal and political theorists suggest. This paper contributes to the literature on the limits of majoritarianism by applying a spatial voting model to demonstrate that the conditions under which majoritarian democracies produce efficient outcomes are narrowly constrained by the structural features of majority rule itself. We formalize a multidimensional policy environment in which voters bargain over both the policy vector and lump‑sum transfers. We show that—even with transferable utility among members of the majority coalitions—the equilibrium chosen by the pivotal majority is generally off the Pareto frontier. Taken together, these results establish an impossibility theorem for majority rule in multidimensional policy spaces: whether coalitions are stable or cyclical, simple majority voting fails to maximize aggregate welfare. Political externalities imposed on minorities systematically exceed the surplus gains accruing to decisive majorities, and vote trading cannot redress the loss. Institutional remedies—supermajority thresholds, agenda control, or issue-bundling constraints—are therefore necessary conditions for approaching efficiency under democratic decision-making.
abstract_zh: 多数主义民主被广泛视为将异质性个体偏好转化为集体决策的典范程序，然而其福利属性远比法律与政治理论家所认为的更为脆弱。本文通过应用空间投票模型，论证了多数主义民主产生有效结果的条件受到多数规则自身结构特征的严格限制，从而为关于多数主义局限性的文献做出贡献。我们形式化了一个多维政策环境，其中选民就政策向量与一次性转移支付进行讨价还价。我们证明——即使在多数联盟成员之间具有可转移效用的情形下——由关键多数所选择的均衡通常偏离帕累托前沿。综合来看，这些结果确立了多维政策空间中多数规则的不可能性定理：无论联盟是稳定的还是循环的，简单多数投票均无法最大化总体福利。施加于少数群体的政治外部性系统性超过决定性多数所获得的剩余收益，且选票交易无法弥补这一损失。因此，制度性补救措施——如超级多数门槛、议程控制或议题捆绑约束——是民主决策接近效率的必要条件。
title: The efficiency paradox of majoritarian democracy
title_zh: 多数民主的效率悖论

abstract: We study the impact of dust-driven pollution on social conflict in West Africa, exploiting exogenous variation in PM2.5 concentrations caused by Saharan dust transported by Harmattan winds. Using a monthly panel covering 16 West African countries from 2003 to 2017, we combine satellite-derived PM2.5 data with geo-referenced conflict events. We instrument PM2.5 using dust emissions from the Bodélé Depression interacted with northeasterly Harmattan winds. We find that a one standard deviation increase in PM2.5 reduces the likelihood of conflict by 0.13 percentage points. The effects are concentrated in riots, one-sided violence, ethnic and religious conflict, and conflicts involving non-local actors. Similarly, we find that resource-related conflicts increase. The findings suggest that severe dust episodes constrain mobility, visibility, and social interaction, thereby reducing opportunities for violent confrontation, even as they intensify competition over scarce resources.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了沙尘驱动的污染对西非社会冲突的影响，利用由哈马丹风输送的撒哈拉沙尘引起的PM2.5浓度外生变化。通过覆盖2003年至2017年16个西非国家的月度面板数据，我们将卫星获取的PM2.5数据与地理参照的冲突事件相结合。我们使用博德莱洼地的沙尘排放与东北哈马丹风的交互作用作为PM2.5的工具变量。研究发现，PM2.5每增加一个标准差，冲突发生的可能性降低0.13个百分点。这一效应主要集中在骚乱、单方面暴力、民族和宗教冲突以及涉及非本地行为者的冲突中。同样，我们发现资源相关冲突有所增加。研究结果表明，严重的沙尘事件限制了流动性、能见度和社交互动，从而减少了暴力对抗的机会，即便它们加剧了对稀缺资源的竞争。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Air pollution and conflict in West Africa: The effects of the harmattan dust
title_zh: 西非空气污染与冲突：哈马丹沙尘的影响

abstract: This study extends Blackwell (1953) comparison of information to a sequential social learning model in which agents make decisions sequentially based on both private signals and observed actions of others. In this context, we introduce a binary relation over information structures: an information structure is more socially valuable than another if it yields higher expected payoffs for all agents, regardless of their preferences and equilibrium realizations. First, we establish that this binary relation is strictly stronger than the Blackwell order. Next, we provide a necessary and sufficient condition for our binary relation and propose a simpler sufficient condition that is easier to verify. We further explore comparisons of information structures in terms of long-run payoffs, limit welfare, and canonical binary environments.
abstract_zh: 本研究将Blackwell（1953）的信息比较扩展至序贯社会学习模型，在该模型中，代理人基于私人信号及观察到的他人行为依次做出决策。在此背景下，我们引入了一种关于信息结构的二元关系：若一种信息结构对所有代理人而言，无论其偏好及均衡实现如何，均能产生更高的预期收益，则称其比另一种更具社会价值。首先，我们确立该二元关系严格强于Blackwell序。其次，我们给出该二元关系的充要条件，并提出一个更易验证的简化充分条件。我们进一步探讨了信息结构在长期收益、极限福利及典型二元环境中的比较。
title: Value of Information in Social Learning
title_zh: 社会学习中信息的价值

abstract: If the economic performance of a firm is disappointing, the manager may be replaced. Whether that improves performance is unclear. For regular firms, it is often difficult to study the causes and consequences of managerial replacement due to limited data availability. This is different for sports clubs, where high-quality data are available on a regular basis. The current paper studies managerial replacements in professional football in the Netherlands. Disappointment is measured by two indicators that use bookmaker expectations as a reference. Points surprise is based on actual results, while performance surprise is based on expected goals. The analysis shows that within-season managerial replacements are more likely when there is disappointment, that is, when both surprise indicators are negative. Match results improve after managerial replacement. However, this improvement is not causal: a counterfactual analysis suggests that match results would have improved even in the absence of managerial replacement.
abstract_zh: 如果企业经济表现令人失望，经理可能会被替换。这种替换是否能改善业绩尚不明确。对于普通企业而言，由于数据可得性有限，研究管理层更替的原因及后果往往较为困难。而体育俱乐部则不同，其高质量数据定期可得。本文研究了荷兰职业足球中的管理层更替现象。失望程度通过两个以博彩公司预期为基准的指标来衡量：积分意外基于实际比赛结果，而表现意外则基于预期进球数。分析显示，当出现失望情况，即两个意外指标均为负值时，赛季内管理层更替的可能性更高。管理层更替后，比赛结果有所改善。然而，这种改善并非因果关系：反事实分析表明，即使没有管理层更替，比赛结果也会有所提升。
title: Dust in the Wind: Causes and Consequences of Managerial Replacements
title_zh: 风中之尘：管理层更替的原因与后果

abstract: Long-term care is costly. About 45 percent of 65-year-old Americans will require formal long-term care assistance during their lifetime and one in twelve will incur out-of-pocket expenses of $200,000 or more. Surprisingly, only 10 percent of retirees have private long-term care insurance. We use a quantitative structural model to show that an obstacle to increasing coverage is disagreement across the income distribution: scaling back Medicaid expands the private market and benefits the affluent but imposes large welfare losses on the poor, while universal public insurance does the opposite. We then show that making Medicaid the primary rather than the secondary payer of longterm care costs, while retaining its means tests, raises welfare for nearly all Americans. Private insurers respond by offering smaller, more profitable policies, and total coverage against long-term care risk rises with only a modest increase in public expenditures.
abstract_zh: 长期护理成本高昂。约45%的65岁美国人在其一生中将需要正式的长期护理援助，且每12人中就有1人将承担20万美元或以上的自付费用。令人惊讶的是，仅有10%的退休人员拥有私人长期护理保险。我们运用定量结构模型表明，扩大覆盖面的一个障碍在于收入分配上的分歧：缩减医疗补助计划会扩大私人市场并惠及富裕群体，但会给贫困群体带来巨大的福利损失，而全民公共保险则效果相反。随后，我们证明，若将医疗补助计划作为长期护理费用的主要支付方而非次要支付方，同时保留其经济状况调查，则几乎能提升所有美国人的福利。私人保险公司会相应提供更小但利润更高的保单，针对长期护理风险的总体保障水平将上升，而公共支出仅需适度增加。
title: How to Reform US Long-term Care
title_zh: 如何改革美国长期护理制度

abstract: Analysis of population aging is typically framed in terms of chronological age. However, chronological age itself is not necessarily deeply informative about the aging process. This paper reviews literature and conducts empirical analyses aimed at investigating whether chronological age is a reliable proxy for physiological functioning when used in models of economic behavior and outcomes. We show that chronological age is an unreliable proxy for physiological functioning due to appreciable differences in how aging unfolds across people, health domains, and over time. We further demonstrate that chronological age either fails to predict economic variables when used in lieu of physiological functioning, or that it predicts additional effects on economic behavior and outcomes that are largely unrelated to physiological aging. Continued reliance on chronological age as a proxy for physiological functioning might impede the ability of societies to fully harness the benefits of increasing longevity.
abstract_zh: 人口老龄化的分析通常以实际年龄为框架。然而，实际年龄本身并不一定对老龄化过程具有深刻的信息价值。本文回顾相关文献并进行实证分析，旨在探究在实际年龄作为经济行为与结果模型中的代理变量时，其是否能可靠地反映生理功能。我们表明，由于老龄化在不同人群、健康领域及时间维度上的显著差异，实际年龄作为生理功能的代理指标并不可靠。进一步地，我们证明，当实际年龄替代生理功能使用时，要么无法预测经济变量，要么预测出的经济行为与结果额外效应与生理老龄化基本无关。持续依赖实际年龄作为生理功能的代理变量，可能会阻碍社会充分利用寿命延长带来的益处。
title: On the Limits of Chronological Age
title_zh: 论时间年龄的局限性

abstract: This article examines the economics of paid sick leave from both theoretical and empirical perspectives. Research on paid sick leave has evolved dynamically over the last decade, primarily driven by the spread of U.S. sick pay mandates, which have increased paid sick leave access from 63 percent to 77 percent in all U.S. jobs. We begin by discussing the economic rationales for government regulation of paid sick leave, particularly the negative externalities associated with contagious diseases when individuals work while sick. After that, we discuss the key trade-offs in the general design of paid sick leave schemes, along with the trade-offs when setting specific policy parameters. Finally, we review economic modeling approaches to study optimal paid sick leave policies.
abstract_zh: 本文从理论与实证两个维度探讨了带薪病假的经济学问题。过去十年间，带薪病假研究动态演进，主要受美国病假政策普及推动，该政策使全美工作中带薪病假的可及性从63%提升至77%。我们首先讨论政府对带薪病假进行监管的经济学理据，特别是当个体带病工作时，传染病所伴随的负外部性。随后，我们探讨带薪病假方案总体设计中的关键权衡，以及设定具体政策参数时的权衡。最后，我们回顾了研究最优带薪病假政策的经济学建模方法。
title: The Economics of Paid Sick Leave
title_zh: 带薪病假的经济学

abstract: Medicaid finances U.S. nursing home care through federal matching grants that reward verifiable volume, not quality. We show that states exploit this through creative financing, diverting funds earmarked for nursing homes. This turns the federal match into a pure volume subsidy and generates a novel allocative distortion we term public moral hazard. We develop the mechanism theoretically and test its predictions using 24 federal audits and administrative microdata from Indiana. Event studies show Medicaid dementia volume rises 12\%; structural quality estimates show the expansion concentrates in the lowest-quality facilities, reallocating patients toward worse providers and reducing one-year survival.
abstract_zh: 医疗补助通过联邦配套拨款资助美国养老院护理，该拨款奖励可验证的数量而非质量。我们证明，各州利用创造性融资手段来利用这一点，将指定用于养老院的资金挪作他用。这使联邦配套资金变成纯粹的数量补贴，并产生了一种我们称之为公共道德风险的新型配置扭曲。我们从理论上阐述这一机制，并利用24项联邦审计和印第安纳州的行政微观数据检验其预测。事件研究显示，医疗补助痴呆症患者数量上升12%；结构质量估计表明，扩张集中于质量最低的设施，将患者重新分配至更差的提供者，并降低一年生存率。
title: Creative Financing and Public Moral Hazard: Evidence from Medicaid and the Nursing Home Industry
title_zh: 创造性融资与公共道德风险：来自医疗补助与养老院行业的证据

abstract: During the 2010 financial crisis, the Portuguese government enacted a series of reforms in its prescription drug reimbursement system. Over the next three years, value added per pharmacist in retail pharmacies fell by a third, reflecting a rise in generic substitution and reductions in the markups allowed for prescription drugs. This massive shock led to pay cuts for incumbent pharmacists and the introduction of a two-tier pay system for new hires, with little or no reduction in the growth of employment. We use detailed longitudinal records from the Quadros de Pessoal database, merged with collective bargaining settlements and firms
abstract_zh: 在2010年金融危机期间，葡萄牙政府对其处方药报销制度实施了一系列改革。随后的三年里，零售药店中每位药剂师的人均附加值下降了三分之一，这反映了仿制药替代率的上升及处方药允许加成率的降低。这一巨大冲击导致在职药剂师薪酬削减，并为新入职者引入了两级薪酬体系，而就业增长几乎没有或完全没有放缓。我们利用来自“Quadros de Pessoal”数据库的详细纵向记录，结合集体谈判协议及企业层面的数据进行分析。
title: Sharing the Burden: The Impacts of Pharmacy Sector Reforms on the Labor Market for Pharmacists in Portugal
title_zh: 共担重负：葡萄牙药剂行业改革对药剂师劳动力市场的影响

abstract: Concerns about excessive mobile phone use among youth are mounting. We present estimates of both behavioral and contextual peer effects, along with comprehensive evidence on how students
abstract_zh: 关于青少年过度使用手机问题的担忧日益加剧。我们提供了行为与情境同伴效应的估计值，以及关于学生如何受到影响的全面证据。
title: Digital Distractions with Peer Influence: The Impact of Mobile App Usage on Academic and Labor Market Outcomes
title_zh: 同伴影响下的数字干扰：移动应用使用对学业与劳动力市场结果的影响

abstract: This paper examines whether financial incentives for general practitioners (GPs) can effectively replace patient cost-sharing within a gatekeeper healthcare system in which the GP regulates access to specialist care. We estimate the effects of incentives provided to GPs by exploiting a field experiment in which treated GPs received a share of the cost savings they achieved. There was also a set of control practices. The patient population includes about 26,000 individuals and is largely representative of the overall population in the Netherlands. We estimate the effects of incentives for patients provided by a deductible using a simulated instrumental variables approach. For both sets of analyses, we use the same measures of healthcare costs, the same time period, and the same population of patients. Our findings show that the incentives provided to GPs reduce costs by 4.3 percent, mainly by decreasing less-urgent specialist care. A small patient deductible of 375 euros per year reduces costs by 27.8 percent in each month in which patients still have to pay out-of-pocket and 10.4 percent at the annual level, impacting all types of care. In contrast, physicians discriminate by type and priority of care. We do not find clear patterns for the interaction of incentives provided to GPs and patients. Our results suggest that GP incentives may complement but not fully replace patient deductibles in managing healthcare costs effectively.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在守门人医疗体系中，全科医生（GPs）的财务激励能否有效替代患者费用分摊，其中全科医生负责调控专科医疗的准入。我们利用一项实地实验来估计对全科医生提供的激励效应，实验中受激励的全科医生可获得其实现的成本节约份额，同时设有对照组诊所。患者群体约包含26,000人，在很大程度上代表了荷兰总体人口。我们采用模拟工具变量方法，估计了由免赔额提供的患者激励效应。对于两组分析，我们使用了相同的医疗成本衡量指标、相同的时间段以及相同的患者群体。研究结果显示，对全科医生提供的激励使成本降低了4.3%，主要通过减少非紧急专科医疗服务实现。每年375欧元的小额患者免赔额在患者仍需自付费用的月份中每月降低成本27.8%，年度水平上降低10.4%，影响所有类型的医疗服务。相比之下，医生会根据护理类型和优先级进行区分。我们未发现全科医生与患者激励交互作用的明确模式。我们的结果表明，在有效管理医疗成本方面，全科医生激励可能补充但无法完全替代患者免赔额。
title: Is physician cost-sharing an alternative to patient cost-sharing?
title_zh: 医生费用分担能否替代患者费用分担？

abstract: Healthy life expectancy is conventionally computed by combining life-table mortality with independently observed health information. This paper proposes an alternative approach that computes healthy life expectancy from mortality schedules alone. Building on the empirical regularities that adult mortality follows Gompertz
abstract_zh: 健康预期寿命通常通过将生命表死亡率与独立观测的健康信息相结合来计算。本文提出了一种替代方法，仅依据死亡率表即可计算健康预期寿命。基于成人死亡率遵循冈珀茨法则的经验规律
title: MICHELE: The Computation of Healthy Life Expectancy from Mortality Schedules
title_zh: 米歇尔：从死亡率表计算健康预期寿命

abstract: Children's mental health has deteriorated across high-income countries since the early 2010s, coinciding with the mass adoption of smartphones among young people. I provide the first quasi-experimental evidence on delaying children's smartphone ownership through a community-led policy. Since 2024 the Smartphone Free Childhood movement has coordinated families across the United Kingdom through a "Parent Pact" to delay giving children a smartphone until age 14. Using a matched difference-in-differences design, I compare changes in children's mental-health needs in English schools where a large share of parents signed with changes in similar schools where very few did. Where at least one fifth of families signed, school-recorded social, emotional and mental health need falls by around 8 percent of the counterfactual. At the same time, child psychiatric disability claims, determined independently by the Department for Work and Pensions, also fall by about 6 percent in the same communities. The effects are larger among younger children who are less likely to already have a phone and in neighborhoods where more parents sign the pledge. The findings support coordinated ownership delay as a near-zero-cost complement to school phone bans and statutory age limits, and they give parents causal evidence for delaying a child's first smartphone through the primary-school years.
abstract_zh: 自2010年代初以来，高收入国家儿童的心理健康状况持续恶化，恰逢青少年中智能手机的大规模普及。我通过一项社区主导的政策，首次提供了关于延迟儿童拥有智能手机的准实验证据。自2024年起，“无智能手机童年”运动通过“家长契约”协调英国各地的家庭，将儿童获得智能手机的年龄推迟至14岁。采用匹配的双重差分设计，我比较了在大量家长签署该契约的英格兰学校与极少数家长签署的类似学校中，儿童心理健康需求的变化。在至少五分之一家庭签署的地区，学校记录的社会、情感和心理健康需求较反事实水平下降了约8%。与此同时，由就业与养老金部独立确定的儿童精神残疾索赔在同一社区也下降了约6%。这一效应在年龄较小、更不可能已拥有手机的儿童中更为显著，且在更多家长签署承诺的社区中效果更强。研究结果支持将协调延迟拥有手机作为一种近乎零成本的补充措施，与学校手机禁令和法定年龄限制相辅相成，并为家长提供了在小学阶段延迟孩子首次拥有智能手机的因果证据。
title: Smartphones and Children's Mental Health
title_zh: 智能手机与儿童心理健康

abstract: Unprecedented increases in unemployment insurance (UI) claims and dramatic changes in UI delivery across the U.S. in recent years stress the importance of understanding the wide-ranging effects of UI receipt. We estimate the short-run effect of UI on suicide and drug overdose mortality following mass layoff events. Using quarterly county-level data from 1995-2010 and leveraging interactions between state-specific UI generosity and mass layoff events, our two-way fixed effects models and event studies show that more generous UI reduces suicide at the county level. These mitigation effects coincide with otherwise large spikes in mortality following mass layoff events in local communities. We find no effect on drug overdose deaths.
abstract_zh: 近年来，美国失业保险（UI）申请数量空前激增，且UI发放方式发生剧烈变化，这凸显了理解UI领取广泛影响的重要性。我们估算了大规模裁员事件后UI对自杀和药物过量死亡率的短期效应。利用1995年至2010年的季度县级数据，并借助州特定UI慷慨程度与大规模裁员事件之间的交互作用，我们的双向固定效应模型和事件研究显示，更慷慨的UI降低了县级自杀率。这些缓解效应与当地社区在大规模裁员事件后死亡率本会出现的急剧上升形成对比。我们未发现UI对药物过量死亡有影响。
title: The Mitigating Effects of Unemployment Insurance on Short-Run Mortality
title_zh: 失业保险对短期死亡率的缓解效应

abstract: To increase the uptake of mental health care and reduce the burden of mental health, many countries have introduced programs offering easily accessible talk therapy. Despite their widespread introduction and continued expansion, causal evidence on these programs
abstract_zh: 为提升心理健康服务的利用率并减轻精神健康负担，许多国家推出了提供便捷谈话治疗的项目。尽管这些项目已广泛实施并持续扩展，但关于其因果效应的证据仍然有限。
title: (Not) Talking Through Mental Health Problems: How Talk Therapy Impacts Healthcare Utilization, Health and Employment
title_zh: （不）通过心理健康问题交谈：谈话疗法如何影响医疗利用、健康与就业

abstract: Managing chronic medical conditions requires daily adherence to pharmaceutical regimens, yet low-income families frequently face unstable budget constraints that force immediate spending trade-offs between nutrition and out-of-pocket healthcare costs. This paper explores how the time since benefit receipt of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) affects healthcare access for low-income families managing chronic medical conditions. Empirical estimation reveals significant fluctuations in medication use, particularly during Days 20–23, when benefits are nearly exhausted. We observe a unique dual-peak pattern in medication use: an initial spike right after benefits are received (Days 0–3) due to immediate shopping disruptions, followed by a sharp increase in medication rationing around three weeks later, driven by liquidity constraints. We also identify sub-population heterogeneity based on benefit adequacy and food insecurity. Low-allotment households exhibit a 23 percentage point increase in medication non-adherence early in the cycle (Days 8–11) compared to those with higher allotments. Conversely, while high-allotment households remain stable early on, their adherence rates decline significantly by the third week, indicating depleted financial buffers. These results suggest that improving SNAP benefit amounts and adjusting issuance frequency could enhance medication adherence and alleviate healthcare access challenges for vulnerable families.
abstract_zh: 管理慢性疾病需要每日坚持用药方案，然而低收入家庭常常面临不稳定的预算约束，迫使他们在营养与自付医疗费用之间做出即时的支出权衡。本文探讨了补充营养援助计划（SNAP）福利领取后的时间长度如何影响管理慢性疾病的低收入家庭的医疗可及性。实证估计揭示了药物使用的显著波动，尤其是在福利即将耗尽时的第20至23天。我们观察到药物使用中一种独特的双峰模式：福利领取后立即出现初始峰值（第0至3天），源于即时的购物中断效应；随后约三周后，受流动性约束驱动，药物配给现象急剧增加。我们还基于福利充足性和食品不安全状况识别出亚群体异质性。低配额家庭在周期早期（第8至11天）的药物不依从率比高配额家庭高出23个百分点。相反，高配额家庭在早期保持稳定，但其依从率在第三周显著下降，表明财务缓冲已耗尽。这些结果表明，提高SNAP福利金额并调整发放频率可以增强药物依从性，并缓解弱势家庭面临的医疗可及性挑战。
title: SNAP Cycle and Cost-Related Delays in Medical Care
title_zh: SNAP周期与医疗护理中的费用相关延误

abstract: The share of young Australians reporting poor mental health has risen sharply over the past two decades, a pattern mirrored across many high-income countries. A central question is whether this reflects a genuine deterioration in underlying mental health or shifts in how different birth cohorts report their symptoms. Using 22 years of nationally representative longitudinal survey data from Australia (2002-2023), we construct a predicted mental health index from respondents
abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，澳大利亚年轻人报告心理健康状况不佳的比例急剧上升，这一趋势在许多高收入国家中同样显现。核心问题在于，这是否反映了潜在心理健康的真实恶化，还是不同出生队列报告症状方式的转变。利用澳大利亚2002年至2023年间22年的全国代表性纵向调查数据，我们构建了一个基于受访者预测的心理健康指数。
title: The good old days? Mental health across birth cohorts
title_zh: 美好的旧时光？不同出生队列的心理健康状况

abstract: Work requirements are a central feature of U.S. welfare program design. The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) imposes a time limit on benefit receipt for able-bodied adults without dependents (ABAWDs) who do not meet work requirements. This time limit was suspended nationally during the Great Recession and the COVID-19 pandemic, with staggered reimplementation occurring at the county level following each suspension. We construct a novel county-month panel dataset on ABAWD waiver status and pair it with American Community Survey microdata to estimate the effects of time limit reimplementation using a triple-difference design that exploits variation across counties and age groups on either side of the work requirement eligibility cutoff. We find that reimplementation significantly reduced SNAP participation among ABAWDs subject to work requirements following the Great Recession suspension and increased employment and labor force participation among these adults in both reimplementation periods. We also identify impacts on similar older adults who were not subject to the work requirements, especially in the form of reduced SNAP participation, suggesting the role of indirect costs of par- ticipation associated with work requirements. Estimates on ABAWD SNAP benefits and earned income are consistent with the participation and employment findings, and mechanism analysis suggests the participation decline is at least partly driven by ABAWDs moving to employment and exiting SNAP—the generally intended effect of work requirements.
abstract_zh: 工作要求是美国福利项目设计的核心特征之一。补充营养援助计划（SNAP）对不符合工作要求且无受抚养人的健全成年人（ABAWDs）领取福利设定了时间限制。这一时间限制在大萧条和新冠疫情期间在全国范围内暂停，每次暂停后各县在不同时间逐步恢复实施。我们构建了一个新颖的县-月面板数据集，涵盖ABAWD豁免状态，并将其与美国社区调查微观数据配对，利用三重差分设计估计时间限制重新实施的影响，该设计利用了各县及工作要求资格截止线两侧年龄组的差异。我们发现，在大萧条暂停后，重新实施工作要求显著降低了受工作要求约束的ABAWDs的SNAP参与率，并在两个重新实施期间提高了这些成年人的就业率和劳动力参与率。我们还识别出对不受工作要求约束的相近年龄较大成年人的影响，尤其是SNAP参与率下降，这表明工作要求相关的参与间接成本发挥了作用。关于ABAWDs的SNAP福利和劳动收入的估计结果与参与和就业发现一致，机制分析表明，参与率下降至少部分源于ABAWDs转向就业并退出SNAP——这通常是工作要求的预期效果。
title: The Effects of Reinstating ABAWD Work Requirements Following National Suspensions on SNAP Participation and Employment
title_zh: 全国暂停后恢复ABAWD工作要求对SNAP参与和就业的影响

abstract: Compared to metropolitan residents, rural residents face a disparity in access to local mental health providers that is even larger than for other health care services. Telehealth appears to be a natural solution to this issue: Patients should be able to more easily access providers from metro areas, reducing disparities in access to mental health care. In this paper, we consider the flip side of this argument, which has not yet received enough attention. Mental health providers, especially in areas where demand for their services exceeds supply, become more easily able to access patients and therefore may become more selective. We show evidence that access to telehealth services is 8-9 percentage points lower for non-metro residents, even after accounting for potential differences in stigma and internet access. We also show that self-payment is a significant predictor of telehealth utilization in mental health and provide suggestive evidence that the increase of telehealth in mental health treatments has coincided with reduced access to mental health care for publicly insured patients, despite growth in provider numbers across counties. We caution that expansions in telehealth need to be combined with policies to promote equitable reimbursement and reduce barriers for independent providers to bill public and private insurance.
abstract_zh: 与城市居民相比，农村居民在获取本地心理健康服务提供者方面面临更大差距，这一差距甚至超过其他医疗保健服务。远程医疗似乎是解决这一问题的自然方案：患者应能更容易地接触到城市地区的服务提供者，从而缩小心理健康护理获取方面的差距。本文探讨了这一论点的另一面，而这一面尚未得到充分关注。心理健康服务提供者，尤其是在服务需求超过供给的地区，更容易接触到患者，因此可能变得更加挑剔。我们提供的证据表明，即使考虑了污名化和互联网接入方面的潜在差异，非城市居民获得远程医疗服务的可能性仍低8至9个百分点。我们还发现，自费支付是心理健康领域远程医疗使用的重要预测因素，并提供了初步证据表明，心理健康治疗中远程医疗的增加与公共保险患者获取心理健康护理机会的减少同时发生，尽管各县服务提供者数量有所增长。我们提醒，远程医疗的扩展需与促进公平报销的政策相结合，并减少独立服务提供者向公共和私人保险收费的障碍。

title: Mental Health Care Access in Rural Communities Amid the Expansion of Telehealth
title_zh: 远程医疗扩展背景下农村社区心理健康服务的可及性

abstract: This study examines the public health impact of early dairy regulation in the United States by analyzing the relationship between raw milk laws and child mortality from 1850 to 1950. Using linked census microdata from the Integrated Public Use Microdata Series (IPUMS) full-count datasets, intercensal child mortality rates are constructed for children aged 0-5, and a staggered adoption difference-in-differences design is employed to estimate the causal effects of dairy regulations. The identification strategy exploits the heterogeneous timing of raw milk law adoption across counties, with regulations emerging in 1914. The analysis tracks approximately 54.8 million children across ten decade pairs, focusing on families with successfully linked parents to minimize measurement error in mortality estimation. Results indicate that comprehensive dairy regulations did not, on average, reduce child mortality. The preferred specification restricts estimation to individually-verified municipal ordinance counties, the jurisdictions where mandates were most plausibly binding, and is the only specification satisfying the parallel trends assumption. Remaining specifications fail the parallel trends test, consistent with positive selection of urbanizing, lower-mortality counties into treatment. The null result is consistent with voluntary pre-adoption, weak enforcement outside major cities, and declining milk-borne exposure as concurrent water infrastructure improvements reduced competing causes of child death.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过分析1850年至1950年间生奶法律与儿童死亡率之间的关系，考察了美国早期乳制品监管的公共卫生影响。利用综合公共使用微观数据系列（IPUMS）全量普查微观数据，构建了0-5岁儿童的人口普查间隔期死亡率，并采用交错采纳的双重差分设计来估计乳制品监管的因果效应。识别策略利用了各县采纳生奶法律的时间差异，相关法规于1914年开始出现。分析追踪了十个十年配对中约5480万名儿童，重点关注父母成功关联的家庭，以最小化死亡率估计中的测量误差。结果表明，全面的乳制品监管平均而言并未降低儿童死亡率。首选规格将估计限制在经个体验证的市政条例县，即法规最可能具有约束力的司法管辖区，且是唯一满足平行趋势假设的规格。其余规格均未通过平行趋势检验，这与城市化程度较高、死亡率较低的县正向选择进入处理组的情况一致。零结果与采纳前的自愿行为、主要城市以外执法力度薄弱，以及同期供水基础设施改善减少了儿童死亡竞争性原因从而降低了乳源性暴露风险的解释相一致。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国1850-1950年乳制品法规与儿童死亡率，数据来自美国IPUMS，制度背景为美国各州法律，与中国无直接关联。
title: Early Dairy Regulation: Raw Milk Laws and Child Mortality in the United States
title_zh: 美国早期乳制品监管：生乳法律与儿童死亡率

abstract: Social norms are an important barrier to gender convergence in economic outcomes. We study whether a public policy designed to promote gender equality at home can pave the way towards gender convergence by shaping gender norms in the next generation. We exploit the introduction of paid paternity leave in Spain in 2007, which granted fathers 13 days of non-transferable paid leave after childbirth. Eligibility depended sharply on the child’s date of birth. We combine this policy variation with original survey data collected from adolescents and implement a within-school difference-in-differences design comparing children born just before and after the reform cutoff within the same school cohort, using adjacent cohorts as controls. Children exposed to paternity leave eligibility display more egalitarian gender attitudes and beliefs in early adolescence. They are also more likely to engage in counter-stereotypical household chores, and hold less gender-stereotypical expectations regarding future work and family roles. The effects largely disappear in late adolescence.
abstract_zh: 社会规范是阻碍经济成果性别趋同的重要障碍。我们研究旨在促进家庭内部性别平等的公共政策，是否能够通过塑造下一代的性别规范，为性别趋同铺平道路。我们利用西班牙2007年引入的带薪陪产假政策，该政策赋予父亲在孩子出生后13天不可转让的带薪假期。资格严格取决于孩子的出生日期。我们将这一政策变化与从青少年中收集的原始调查数据相结合，并在同一学校队列内实施校内双重差分设计，比较改革截止日期前后出生的儿童，以相邻队列作为对照组。暴露于陪产假资格条件的儿童在青春期早期表现出更平等的性别态度和信念。他们也更可能参与反刻板印象的家务劳动，并对未来的工作和家庭角色持有更少的性别刻板印象预期。这些影响在青春期晚期基本消失。
title: Changing Gender Norms Across Generations: Evidence from a Paternity Leave Reform
title_zh: 跨代性别规范变迁：来自陪产假改革的证据

abstract: Health screenings are potentially powerful tools to mitigate adverse health and labour outcomes. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of the labour market and health effects of a diabetes warning in a country that has not introduced such a screening system. Using data from over 160, 000 participants in Lifelines, a Dutch cohort study, and a multidimensional regression discontinuity design, we estimate the short- and long-run impacts of a diabetes risk warning. Individuals under 40 increase their employment rate following a warning, with effects that are especially pronounced and persistent for women. These employment gains are accompanied by improvements in self-reported health among women and reduced smoking among men. Among older individuals, the responses are more heterogeneous: Women are more likely to retire and reduce alcohol consumption, while men are less likely to receive disability benefits and more likely to visit their general practitioner in the short term. Our findings provide novel evidence that health information can influence labour market outcomes through gender- and age-specific behavioural adjustments.
abstract_zh: 健康筛查是缓解不良健康与劳动结果的潜在有力工具。我们对一个尚未引入此类筛查制度的国家中糖尿病警示对劳动力市场及健康的影响进行了全面评估。利用荷兰队列研究Lifelines中超过16万名参与者的数据，并采用多维回归断点设计，我们估计了糖尿病风险警示的短期与长期影响。40岁以下的个体在收到警示后就业率上升，这一效应在女性中尤为显著且持久。这些就业增长伴随着女性自报健康状况的改善以及男性吸烟行为的减少。在年长个体中，反应更为异质：女性更可能退休并减少饮酒，而男性短期内更不可能领取残疾补助，且更可能就诊于全科医生。我们的发现提供了新颖证据，表明健康信息可通过性别与年龄特定的行为调整影响劳动力市场结果。
title: The Labour Market and Health Effects of a Diabetes Warning: Evidence of Gender and Age Differences from the Lifelines Cohort Study
title_zh: 糖尿病警示对劳动力市场与健康的影响：来自Lifelines队列研究中性别与年龄差异的证据

abstract: This paper examines how acute pollution exposure in historical London (1892–1919) affected child health. I proxy acute, extreme pollution exposure using daily data on fog events, which reflect meteorological conditions where pollution emitted in the city was not dispersed across space leading to a sharp spike in pollution. I also use rich individual-level data on child health drawn from the Queen Charlotte Hospital, a maternity hospital, and the Foundling Hospital, an orphanage. I find no effect of pollution exposure at birth on birth or growth outcomes or on upper respiratory morbidity. However, exposure on the day of birth had persistent effects on health, increasing mortality risk in childhood and adolescence from respiratory diseases and raising incidence, prevalence and sickness duration of influenza and measles. There was no persistent effect of in utero and postnatal pollution exposures. These mixed results show that extreme pollution at birth had lasting impacts on specific, but also limited, dimensions of child health.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了历史时期伦敦（1892-1919年）急性污染暴露对儿童健康的影响。我利用每日雾事件数据作为急性极端污染暴露的代理指标，这些雾事件反映了城市排放的污染物未能扩散至空间的气象条件，导致污染急剧飙升。同时，我采用了来自皇后夏洛特医院（一家妇产医院）和育婴堂医院（一家孤儿院）的丰富个体层面儿童健康数据。研究发现，出生时的污染暴露对出生结果、生长结果或上呼吸道发病率无显著影响。然而，出生当日的暴露对健康产生了持续性影响，增加了儿童期及青春期因呼吸系统疾病导致的死亡风险，并提高了流感和麻疹的发病率、患病率及病程持续时间。宫内及产后污染暴露未显示出持续性效应。这些混合结果表明，出生时的极端污染对儿童健康的特定维度产生了持久影响，但影响范围有限。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为1892-1919年历史伦敦的儿童健康，数据来自伦敦医院，制度背景和核心应用均非中国，明确不是中国研究。
title: Born in smog: immediate and persistent health consequences of acute air pollution exposure in historical London, 1892–1919
title_zh: 生于雾霾：历史伦敦急性空气污染暴露的即时与持久健康后果，1892-1919

abstract: Research shows that the receipt and timing of income can significantly influence behavior, including risky behaviors and health indicators such as mortality and emergency department visits. These effects have been linked to the timing of income benefits and transfers, such as those provided by the U.S. Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP). We leverage exogenous variation in the monthly date on which individuals receive SNAP benefits, combined with linked individual-level state and federal administrative microdata, to estimate: (1) the causal effects of days since SNAP (income) receipt within a monthly benefit cycle, and (2) the causal effects of the monthly distribution date (income smoothing) on labor market and health outcomes across months. We show that (1) as the days since SNAP distribution increases, work absenteeism increases and labor market participation decreases until just before the next monthly issuance of SNAP benefits, when outcomes begin to improve again. We directly test food insecurity and health as mechanisms for these labor market cycles and show that they also follow the 30-day benefits cycle. Controlling for these 30-day benefit cycles, we then estimate (2) the causal effect of monthly distribution date on labor market participation, health, and food insecurity. We find evidence that if states distributed SNAP in the middle of a calendar month, rather than the beginning or end of a month, SNAP recipient labor market participation would increase, reported disability would decrease, food insecurity would decrease, and the lifespan of SNAP participants—which we capture by linking the universe of Social Security Administration individual death records—would increase by 101 days (0.5%), on average.
abstract_zh: 研究表明，收入的获得及其时间安排能显著影响行为，包括冒险行为及死亡率、急诊就诊等健康指标。这些影响已与收入福利及转移支付的时间安排相关联，例如美国补充营养援助计划（SNAP）所提供的福利。我们利用个人每月领取SNAP福利日期中的外生变异，结合关联的个人层面州及联邦行政微观数据，以估计：（1）在一个月度福利周期内，自SNAP（收入）领取以来天数对劳动力市场及健康结果的因果效应；（2）月度发放日期（收入平滑化）对跨月劳动力市场及健康结果的因果效应。我们发现：（1）随着SNAP发放后天数增加，工作缺勤率上升，劳动力市场参与率下降，直至下月SNAP福利发放前夕，各项结果方开始再度改善。我们直接检验食物不安全及健康作为这些劳动力市场周期的机制，并显示它们同样遵循30天福利周期。在控制这些30天福利周期后，我们进而估计（2）月度发放日期对劳动力市场参与、健康及食物不安全的因果效应。我们发现证据表明，若各州在日历月中旬而非月初或月末发放SNAP福利，则SNAP受助者的劳动力市场参与率将上升，报告的残疾率将下降，食物不安全状况将减轻，且SNAP参与者的寿命——我们通过关联社会保障管理局全体个人死亡记录来捕捉——平均将增加101天（0.5%）。
title: Monthly Income Variability and Its Consequences: Evidence from SNAP Administrative Data
title_zh: 月收入波动及其后果：来自SNAP行政数据的证据

abstract: We estimate the causal effect of exposure to fast-food outlets on adolescent z-BMI using the UK Millennium Cohort Study linked to comprehensive geospatial data. We develop a novel approach to modelling z-BMI persistence by clustering early childhood z-BMI trajectories, allowing us to distinguish baseline obesity susceptibility from contemporaneous environmental effects. Identification exploits the near-universal transition from primary to secondary school, generating plausibly exogenous variation in exposure to fast-food outlets around schools. We find that adolescents with at least one major-brand outlet near school have, on average, a 0.158 standard-deviation higher z-BMI. Effects decline with distance, are limited around the home, and do not extend to other food outlets.
abstract_zh: 我们利用英国千禧队列研究结合全面的地理空间数据，估计了接触快餐店对青少年z-BMI的因果效应。我们开发了一种新方法，通过聚类早期儿童z-BMI轨迹来建模z-BMI的持续性，从而能够区分基线肥胖易感性与同期环境效应。识别策略利用了从小学到中学近乎普遍的过渡，这为学校周边快餐店接触提供了看似外生的变异。我们发现，学校附近至少有一家主要品牌快餐店的青少年，其z-BMI平均高出0.158个标准差。效应随距离增加而减弱，仅限于家庭周边，且不延伸至其他食品店。
title: Proximity to Fast-Food Outlets and Adolescent z-BMI: Accounting for Persistent Health Dynamics
title_zh: 靠近快餐店与青少年z-BMI：考虑持续性健康动态

abstract: Mangroves provide vital ecosystem services, including fisheries support, carbon sequestration, and natural protection against coastal erosion, but their health consequences are less well understood. We study their impacts on mental health and cognitive functioning in Indonesia, which has the most extensive and biodiverse mangroves in the world. Decades of deforestation, fueled by climate pressures, oil palm expansion, and aquaculture, have led to widespread mangrove loss in the country, disproportionately affecting vulnerable coastal communities. By merging high-resolution satellite data on coastal land use change with individual-level panel data from the Indonesian Family Life Survey (IFLS), we find that a one-standard-deviation increase in local mangrove cover reduces the likelihood of clinical depression by 4.5 percentage points. These effects operate through reduced flood exposure, higher household income, and improved food consumption. We also find that restoration potential matters more than blue carbon potential, cash transfers, or social capital in shaping the mangrove-mental health relationship. Our results show that mangrove conservation and restoration can generate important local human capital and welfare benefits.
abstract_zh: 红树林提供重要的生态系统服务，包括渔业支持、碳封存以及抵御海岸侵蚀的自然防护，但其对健康的影响尚不十分明确。我们研究了红树林对印度尼西亚心理健康和认知功能的影响，该国拥有全球面积最大、生物多样性最丰富的红树林。数十年来，由气候压力、油棕扩张和水产养殖驱动的森林砍伐，导致该国红树林大面积丧失，对脆弱的沿海社区造成了不成比例的影响。通过将高分辨率卫星数据与印度尼西亚家庭生活调查（IFLS）的个体层面面板数据相结合，我们发现，当地红树林覆盖率每增加一个标准差，临床抑郁症的可能性降低4.5个百分点。这些效应通过减少洪水暴露、提高家庭收入和改善食品消费来实现。我们还发现，在塑造红树林与心理健康关系方面，恢复潜力比蓝碳潜力、现金转移或社会资本更为重要。我们的结果表明，红树林的保护和恢复能够产生重要的地方人力资本和福利效益。
title: Mangroves, Mental Health, and Cognition
title_zh: 红树林、心理健康与认知

abstract: Generative AI is fast becoming the first place people turn for expert advice. The advice it provides can be directional rather than neutral, shaped in part by the choices of its designers and regulators. When clients consult AI before meeting an expert, they carry this directional advice into a relationship that once rested on the expert's judgment alone. We study its consequences in healthcare through a large-scale preregistered field experiment at a Chinese hospital, where we randomize patients' access to an AI chatbot before their outpatient visit. Examination of the conversation logs shows that the chatbot routinely cautions against the use of medications, especially Traditional Chinese Medicine and antibiotics, while issuing clean recommendations for diagnostic testing, consistent with the liability-driven guardrails encoded in AI training. This directionality propagates into clinical practice. Prescription rates decline among treated patients while diagnostic testing increases, and these effects are more pronounced among physicians who are receptive to patient input and those with more intensive prescribing styles. Beyond shifting healthcare utilization, survey results show that AI access reduces patient compliance and satisfaction, shifting the balance of authority between patients and physicians.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能正迅速成为人们寻求专家建议的首选途径。其提供的建议可能带有方向性而非中立性，部分受到设计者和监管者选择的影响。当客户在咨询专家前先与AI交流时，他们会将这种方向性建议带入原本仅依赖专家判断的关系中。我们通过在中国一家医院进行的大规模预注册实地实验，研究了其在医疗保健领域的后果，实验中我们随机分配患者在门诊就诊前接触AI聊天机器人。对话日志分析显示，该聊天机器人经常警告不要使用药物，尤其是中药和抗生素，同时对诊断检测提出明确建议，这与AI训练中编码的基于责任的防护措施一致。这种方向性传播到临床实践中。治疗患者的处方率下降，而诊断检测增加，这些效应在乐于接受患者意见的医生及处方风格更为积极的医生中更为显著。除了改变医疗利用外，调查结果显示，AI访问降低了患者依从性和满意度，改变了患者与医生之间的权威平衡。
