title: Directional AI Advice: Experimental Evidence from Healthcare
title_zh: 定向人工智能建议：来自医疗保健的实验证据

abstract: Rising temperatures may influence everyday food choices in ways that have important implications for nutrition and public health. This paper studies how short-run exposure to extreme temperatures affects the composition of household grocery purchases in the United States. Using a nationally representative household panel dataset of grocery transactions merged with local weather information, we exploit within-household variation and estimate two-way fixed effects models to identify causal effects. We find that hotter weeks consistently shift food purchases toward less healthy items and reduce overall diet quality, with little change in total grocery spending. In contrast, unusually cold weeks lead to slight increases in total spending but do not significantly alter the nutritional composition of purchases. These results suggest that heat exposure primarily induces households to reallocate spending toward less healthy foods rather than to change how much they spend, whereas cold exposure mainly affects the volume of groceries purchased. The heat-induced effects on healthiness of food purchases are modest in the short run but are highly robust and more pronounced for households with less healthy baseline purchasing patterns. These findings highlight an underexplored channel through which rising temperatures may degrade diet quality, underscoring the potential public health and welfare costs of climate change.
abstract_zh: 气温上升可能会以对营养和公共健康具有重要影响的方式改变日常食品选择。本文研究了短期极端温度暴露如何影响美国家庭杂货购买的结构。利用一个全国代表性的家庭面板数据集，其中包含杂货交易记录并与当地天气信息相匹配，我们利用家庭内部变动，并估计双向固定效应模型以识别因果效应。研究发现，较热的周持续将食品购买转向较不健康的项目，并降低整体饮食质量，而总杂货支出变化不大。相反，异常寒冷的周导致总支出略有增加，但并未显著改变购买的营养构成。这些结果表明，热暴露主要促使家庭将支出重新分配至较不健康的食品，而非改变其支出总额，而冷暴露则主要影响所购杂货的数量。热诱导的食品购买健康性影响在短期内较为温和，但高度稳健，并且对于基线购买模式较不健康的家庭更为显著。这些发现突显了一个未被充分探索的渠道，通过该渠道，气温上升可能降低饮食质量，强调了气候变化潜在的公共健康与福利成本。
title: Can Temperature Shock Lead to Higher Spending on Unhealthy Foods among U.S. Households
title_zh: 温度冲击会导致美国家庭增加不健康食品支出吗

abstract: Fertility is a complex amalgamation of human choice, economic conditions, and environmental factors. While the biological toxicity of wildfire-induced air pollution is well-documented to have severe detrimental effects on human health and the reproductive system, reproductive outcomes are not dictated by biology alone. They are profoundly shaped by human behavioral responses. This study analyzes the net effect of wildfire exposure, alongside economic shocks and non-parametric temperature extremes, on fertility in the United States. Utilizing a comprehensive county-monthyear panel dataset from 2010 to 2023, the analysis employs a Poisson Pseudo-Maximum Likelihood (PPML) regression incorporating high-dimensional county and year-month fixed effects. The primary findings reveal a statistically significant positive relationship between wildfire exposure and fertility. Utilizing SafeGraph mobility data, this study empirically isolates the behavioral mechanism driving this result: wildfires cause a highly significant increase in the proportion of the population sheltering completely at home, altering daily routines in a manner that overrides the biological detriments of smoke exposure. Furthermore, a continuous interaction analysis reveals a stark environmental justice divide: while the shelter-in-place "baby bump" occurs universally across income groups, economically vulnerable counties suffer severe fertility depressions from the economic anxiety accompanying disasters, significantly muting the behavioral bump. A 500iteration randomization inference (placebo) test confirms the causal robustness of these findings, yielding an empirical p-value of < 0.01.
abstract_zh: 生育是人类选择、经济状况与环境因素复杂交织的产物。尽管野火引发的空气污染在生物学上的毒性已被充分证实对人类健康及生殖系统具有严重不利影响，但生育结果并非仅由生物学因素决定，而是深受人类行为响应的塑造。本研究分析了野火暴露、经济冲击及非参数化温度极端事件对美国生育率的净效应。利用2010年至2023年间全面的县级-年月面板数据集，分析采用泊松伪极大似然（PPML）回归，并纳入高维县级及年月固定效应。主要发现揭示了野火暴露与生育率之间存在统计上显著的正相关关系。借助SafeGraph流动性数据，本研究实证分离了驱动这一结果的行为机制：野火导致完全居家庇护的人口比例显著增加，从而改变日常作息，其影响超越了烟雾暴露的生物学危害。此外，连续交互分析揭示了鲜明的环境正义鸿沟：尽管居家庇护引发的“婴儿潮”在各收入群体中普遍存在，但经济脆弱县因灾害伴随的经济焦虑而遭受严重的生育率抑制，显著削弱了行为性增长效应。一项500次迭代的随机化推断（安慰剂）检验证实了这些发现的因果稳健性，经验p值小于0.01。
china_relevance_reason: 论文明确以美国为研究对象，使用美国县级面板数据和SafeGraph移动数据，分析野火对美国生育率的影响，不涉及中国、中国企业、人群或地区。
title: Do Forests Burn Alone? The Role of Wildfire on Fertility in the United States
title_zh: 森林独自燃烧吗？野火对美国生育率的影响

abstract: Over the last decade a wave of U.S. states began reimbursing doula services through Medicaid, hoping to improve infant health and narrow stark racial gaps in birth outcomes. I evaluate these mandates using the staggered 2021-2024 rollout, a panel of 32.1 million births from CDC WONDER (2016-2024), and a newly assembled measure of the state doula workforce drawn from the national provider registry. Identification comes from the policy's timing rather than from comparing doula users to non-users, addressing the selection problem that limits the existing observational literature. On average I find no detectable effect on low birth weight (LBW). Consistent with the heterogeneity emphasized by Peet (2022) and the maternal-health-disparities literature, however, the effect concentrates among the group at greatest risk: Black mothers, for whom LBW falls by roughly half a percentage point (about 5% of the baseline) in the states with the longest exposure, with flat pre-trends and a coherent upward shift in the birth-weight distribution. The estimate is marginal once I use inference valid for few treated clusters, and the binding constraint is statistical power: most mandates took effect in 2024-2025, at or beyond the end of the data. A two-stage least squares analysis shows that coverage roughly doubles the doula workforce (first-stage F approximately 21-35), and that the induced increase in doula supply is associated with lower Black LBW, though imprecisely. I read the results as credible early evidence that doula mandates work where they have had time to operate and where the need is greatest, rather than as a finished causal claim.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，美国多州开始通过医疗补助计划报销导乐服务，旨在改善婴儿健康并缩小出生结局中显著的种族差异。我利用2021-2024年交错推行的政策、来自CDC WONDER（2016-2024年）的3210万出生人口面板数据，以及从国家提供者注册库中新汇编的州级导乐劳动力指标，对这些政策指令进行了评估。识别策略依赖于政策实施的时间节点，而非比较导乐使用者与非使用者，从而解决了现有观察性文献中存在的选择性问题。平均而言，我未发现对低出生体重（LBW）有可检测的影响。然而，与Peet（2022）及孕产妇健康差异文献所强调的异质性一致，该效应集中于风险最高的群体：黑人母亲，在暴露时间最长的州中，其低出生体重率下降约0.5个百分点（约为基线的5%），且事前趋势平稳，出生体重分布呈现一致的右移。当采用适用于少数处理集群的推断方法时，该估计值变得边际显著，而制约因素在于统计功效：多数政策指令于2024-2025年生效，恰逢或超出数据覆盖期末。两阶段最小二乘分析显示，政策覆盖使导乐劳动力大约翻倍（第一阶段F统计量约为21-35），且由此引发的导乐供给增加与黑人低出生体重率下降相关，尽管估计精度有限。我将这些结果解读为可信的初步证据，表明导乐政策指令在已有时间发挥作用且需求最为迫切的地区产生了效果，而非一项定论的因果主张。
title: Helping Hands, Healthier Infants: The Effect of Medicaid Doula Coverage Mandates on Birth Outcomes
title_zh: 援助之手，健康婴儿：医疗补助助产士覆盖强制令对分娩结局的影响

abstract: This paper examines whether Chinese foreign aid strengthens state capacity in recipient countries. We construct a country-year panel covering 214 countries over 2000–2021 by combining AidData’s Global Chinese Development Finance Dataset with a latent-variable measure of state capacity. To address aid allocation endogeneity, we instrument Chinese official development assistance (ODA) using the interaction between China’s steel production and each recipient’s historical propensity to receive Chinese aid. The results show that one additional Chinese ODA project increases the state-capacity index by 0.032 points, equivalent to 9.22% of the sample mean. This finding remains robust to controlling for additional recipient characteristics, other aid sources, policy factors, and spatial spillovers. The effect is stronger in countries that are institutionally or politically closer to China and for aid directed towards production and infrastructure sectors, with infrastructure provision and bilateral economic engagement serving as the primary channels. The estimates for official finance (OF) and other official financing (OOF) remain positive but are smaller and less precisely estimated, highlighting the distinctive role of concessional ODA in state capacity building. From a policy perspective, this finding suggests that concessional aid can strengthen recipient governments’ capacity to implement policies and pursue self-reliant development. abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国对外援助是否增强了受援国的国家能力。通过结合AidData的全球中国发展融资数据集与国家能力的潜变量测度，我们构建了一个覆盖2000年至2021年214个国家的国家-年份面板数据。为处理援助分配的内生性问题，我们利用中国钢铁产量与各受援国历史上接受中国援助的倾向之间的交互项，作为中国官方发展援助（ODA）的工具变量。结果显示，每增加一个中国ODA项目，国家能力指数提升0.032点，相当于样本均值的9.22%。在控制额外受援国特征、其他援助来源、政策因素及空间溢出效应后，这一发现依然稳健。该效应在制度或政治上与中国更接近的国家中更为显著，且对投向生产与基础设施部门的援助效果更强，其中基础设施供给与双边经济交往是主要作用渠道。官方融资（OF）及其他官方融资（OOF）的估计系数虽为正，但数值较小且显著性较弱，凸显了优惠性ODA在国家能力建设中的独特作用。从政策角度看，这一发现表明，优惠性援助能够增强受援国政府实施政策及追求自主发展的能力。关键词：中国援助 ODA 国家能力 基础设施项目 JEL分类：F35：对外援助 O19：国际组织在发展中的国际联系作用 P45：国际贸易、金融、投资与援助 O43：制度与增长 H11：政府的结构、范围与绩效

abstract: Extreme weather increasingly threatens agricultural production, underscoring the need to enhance farmers’ adaptive capacity and strengthen disaster risk management. Using panel data from China’s National Fixed Observation Points (NFOP) matched with ERA5 data for 2009–2019, this study employs fixed-effects models to examine the effects of extreme weather on farmers’ agricultural insurance participation and insurance expenditure, and further analyzes the moderating role of insurance claims. We further examine how variation in the severity of extreme weather affects farmers’ crop insurance participation and coverage levels. The results show that drought exposure increases farmers’ likelihood of purchasing agricultural insurance, particularly under prolonged drought conditions. However, the effect on insurance payment levels is mixed: short-term drought shocks are associated with increased insurance investment, while moderate-duration drought shows a negative association, and intermediate horizons yield insignificant results. This heterogeneity suggests that farmers‘ coverage adjustment responses are contingent on the duration and timing of drought exposure. The association between drought exposure and insurance uptake is more pronounced among households with prior claim experience. KEYWORDS: Agricultural disasters crop insurance drought severity insurance demand JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q14 Q13 Q54
abstract_zh: 极端天气日益威胁农业生产，凸显了增强农户适应能力与强化灾害风险管理的必要性。本研究利用中国国家固定观测点（NFOP）2009—2019年的面板数据，匹配ERA5气象数据，采用固定效应模型考察极端天气对农户农业保险参与及保费支出的影响，并进一步分析保险理赔的调节作用。同时，本文还探讨了极端天气严重程度的变化如何影响农户种植业保险参与及保障水平。结果表明，干旱暴露提高了农户购买农业保险的可能性，尤其是在持续干旱条件下。然而，干旱对保险支付水平的影响呈现混合效应：短期干旱冲击与保险投入增加相关，中等时长干旱则呈负向关联，而中间时段的影响不显著。这一异质性表明，农户保障水平的调整反应取决于干旱暴露的持续时间和发生时机。干旱暴露与保险参与之间的正向关联在具有既往理赔经历的农户中更为显著。关键词：农业灾害；种植业保险；干旱严重程度；保险需求 JEL分类：Q14 Q13 Q54

abstract: The rapid expansion of digital technologies has transformed how individuals access information and interact with institutions, yet older adults often remain excluded from these opportunities. This study examines the role of information access in fostering rights awareness among older adults in Vietnam, a country undergoing both demographic ageing and rapid digital transformation. Using data from the 2011 Vietnam National Ageing Survey, we construct a composite index of information access incorporating television, radio, newspapers, internet, community loudspeakers, and computer ownership. Rights awareness is measured across four domains: health, social protection, legal and policy, and civic participation. To address potential endogeneity, we employ a coefficient stability bounds approach, complemented by propensity score matching, inverse probability weighting, entropy balancing, coarsened exact matching, and double/debiased machine learning. Across all specifications, information access is consistently associated with greater rights awareness, even under conservative assumptions regarding omitted variable bias. Mediation analysis further reveals that information access promotes awareness both directly and indirectly, through enhanced civic participation and stronger intergenerational support. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the effects are stronger and more robust in the Northern and Southern regions, among more educated individuals, within the Kinh majority group, and among women. KEYWORDS: Information access right awareness ageing Vietnam JEL CLASSIFICATION: I39 O10
abstract_zh: 数字技术的迅速扩张改变了个人获取信息和与机构互动的方式，然而老年人往往仍被排除在这些机会之外。本研究考察了信息获取在促进越南老年人权利意识方面的作用，越南正处于人口老龄化和快速数字化转型并行的阶段。利用2011年越南国家老龄化调查数据，我们构建了一个包含电视、广播、报纸、互联网、社区扩音器和计算机拥有情况在内的信息获取综合指数。权利意识从四个维度进行衡量：健康、社会保障、法律与政策以及公民参与。为应对潜在的内生性问题，我们采用系数稳定性边界方法，并辅以倾向得分匹配、逆概率加权、熵平衡、粗化精确匹配以及双重/去偏机器学习。在所有设定下，即使在关于遗漏变量偏差的保守假设下，信息获取始终与更高的权利意识相关联。中介分析进一步表明，信息获取既通过增强公民参与和强化代际支持间接地，也直接地促进权利意识。异质性分析显示，在北部和南部地区、受教育程度较高的群体、京族多数群体以及女性中，该效应更强且更为稳健。关键词：信息获取 权利意识 老龄化 越南 JEL分类：I39 O10
title: Empowering the elderly: the role of information access in promoting rights awareness in Vietnam
title_zh: 赋权老年人：信息获取在促进越南权利意识中的作用

abstract: We study how discount rates affect the level and composition of innovation within an industry. We develop a model in which higher discount rates need not reduce innovation in industry equilibrium, challenging conventional wisdom. While higher discount rates deter entry, effectively acting as entry barriers, they stimulate innovation along the intensive margin, potentially increasing aggregate industry innovation on net. The data support these predictions. The effects are stronger in more R&D intensive industries and industries with greater exposure to systematic risk. Additionally, higher discount rates foster explorative rather than exploitative innovation.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了贴现率如何影响行业内创新的水平与结构。我们构建了一个模型，在该模型中，较高的贴现率在行业均衡状态下未必会减少创新，这挑战了传统观念。尽管较高的贴现率阻碍了新企业的进入，实际上起到了进入壁垒的作用，但它们却促进了集约边际上的创新，可能总体上增加行业的整体创新量。数据支持这些预测。在研发密集型更高以及系统性风险暴露更大的行业中，这些效应更为显著。此外，较高的贴现率更倾向于促进探索性创新而非利用性创新。
title: Innovation, industry equilibrium, and discount rates
title_zh: 创新、行业均衡与贴现率

abstract: We study the impact of foreign exchange interventions during periods of tight credit constraints. Expanding on the Gabaix and Maggiori (2015) model, we predict that long-lived spot interventions have larger effects on exchange rates than shortlived swaps, unanticipated interventions are more impactful, and tighter credit constraints amplify effects. Using high-frequency data on Brazilian Central Bank interventions from 1999 to 2023, we find that unanticipated spot sales of USD reserves lead to significant domestic currency appreciation and reduced covered interest parity deviations. Spot interventions outperform swaps, especially when global intermediaries are constrained, and enhance market efficiency by lowering USD borrowing costs.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了信贷约束紧缩时期外汇干预的影响。在扩展Gabaix和Maggiori（2015）模型的基础上，我们预测，长期即期干预对汇率的影响大于短期互换，未预期到的干预更具影响力，且更紧的信贷约束会放大这些效应。利用1999年至2023年巴西中央银行干预的高频数据，我们发现，未预期到的美元储备即期卖出导致本币显著升值，并减少了抛补利率平价偏离。即期干预优于互换，尤其是在全球中介机构受约束时，并通过降低美元借贷成本提升了市场效率。
title: Foreign Exchange Interventions and Intermediary Constraints
title_zh: 外汇干预与中介机构约束

abstract: This study examines how geopolitical risk (GPR) transmits to sovereign credit risk in emerging market economies (EMEs), using monthly data on the 5-year sovereign credit default swap (SCDS) and the J.P. Morgan Emerging Markets Bond Index (EMBI) spread for 13 EMEs over the period of January 2005–October 2025. Using fixed-effects panel local projections, the framework is extended to allow for state-dependent transmission. Differences in impulse responses across states are attributed to specific macrofinancial fundamentals. Three main findings are identified. First, an increase in the GPR index raises both SCDS and EMBI spreads. Second, disaggregating the index into its subcomponents reveals a larger response to threats than to acts, consistent with the possibility of anticipation effects in sovereign credit markets. Third, evaluating the state-dependent impulse response around the Russian invasion of Ukraine yields substantially different responses, with the post-invasion configuration increasing the sovereign risk premia response. Our findings show the importance of modeling the state-dependent transmission of geopolitical shocks and provide a useful tool for incorporating geopolitical scenarios into sovereign risk analysis.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察地缘政治风险（GPR）如何传导至新兴市场经济体（EMEs）的主权信用风险，利用2005年1月至2025年10月期间13个新兴市场经济体的5年期主权信用违约互换（SCDS）和摩根大通新兴市场债券指数（EMBI）利差的月度数据。采用固定效应面板局部投影法，将框架扩展至允许状态依赖的传导效应。不同状态下脉冲响应的差异归因于特定的宏观金融基本面因素。研究得出三项主要发现。第一，GPR指数的上升同时推高SCDS和EMBI利差。第二，将指数分解为其子成分后发现，对威胁的反应大于对实际行动的反应，这与主权信用市场中存在预期效应的可能性一致。第三，围绕俄罗斯入侵乌克兰事件评估状态依赖的脉冲响应，显示出显著不同的反应，入侵后的状态配置放大了主权风险溢价响应。我们的研究结果表明，对地缘政治冲击的状态依赖传导进行建模具有重要意义，并为将地缘政治情景纳入主权风险分析提供了实用工具。
title: Geopolitical risk and emerging market sovereign risk premia
title_zh: 地缘政治风险与新兴市场主权风险溢价

abstract: Macroprudential instruments have been increasingly used by advanced economics and emerging markets, especially since the global financial crisis. This paper looks at how macroprudential policy can help reduce the risks associated with capital flows. We start by examining different types of macroprudential policy tools and their usage in different countries over time. We revisit the research on the link between capital inflows shocks and house prices and ask whether this link may have been weakened by the more extensive use of macroprudential instruments post global financial crisis. We review the empirical evidence on the effect of macroprudential policies on capital flows volatility and on the transmission of capital flows shocks to the real economy. We discuss the factors that may reduce the effectiveness of macroprudential policies in dealing with potential risks associated with capital flows, particularly leakages and spillovers. We conclude with open questions for policy and research.
abstract_zh: 宏观审慎工具在发达经济体和新兴市场中得到了越来越多的应用，尤其是在全球金融危机之后。本文探讨了宏观审慎政策如何有助于降低与资本流动相关的风险。我们首先考察不同类型的宏观审慎政策工具及其在不同国家随时间的使用情况。我们重新审视了关于资本流入冲击与房价之间联系的研究，并探讨这一联系是否因全球金融危机后宏观审慎工具的广泛使用而有所减弱。我们回顾了关于宏观审慎政策对资本流动波动性及其对实体经济传导效应的实证证据。我们讨论了可能削弱宏观审慎政策应对资本流动相关潜在风险有效性的因素，特别是漏洞和溢出效应。最后，我们提出了政策和研究方面的开放性问题。
title: Macroprudential Policy and Capital Flows
title_zh: 宏观审慎政策与资本流动

abstract: The emergence of stablecoins has created a new channel to access US dollar liquidity in emerging market and developing economies (EMDEs), similar to the historical role of foreigncurrency deposits, or "deposit dollarisation". This has raised concerns about the possible implications for monetary control in EMDEs. Drawing on data on foreign currency deposits and dollar-pegged stablecoin inflows for more than 130 economies, we compare the dynamics and drivers of "stablecoin dollarisation" with those of conventional deposit dollarisation. We document that historical deposit dollarisation and recent stablecoin flows are both associated with similar macro-financial drivers, including the strength of exchange rate pass-through and sovereign or banking crises. We further document significant persistence in both deposit and stablecoin dollarisation, suggesting that dollarisation is hard to reverse once established. Unlike deposit dollarisation, stablecoin flows seem to be largely unaffected by either broad or specific capital flow restrictions. This likely occurs because stablecoins are partly circulating outside the regulatory perimeter. The historical record also suggests that moderate deposit dollarisation has been associated with somewhat higher inflation risks, although there is little evidence of significant impacts on monetary policy transmission.
abstract_zh: 稳定币的出现为新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDEs）获取美元流动性开辟了新渠道，这与历史上外币存款或“存款美元化”所扮演的角色相似。这引发了关于其对EMDEs货币政策控制可能产生影响的担忧。利用来自130多个经济体的外币存款和盯住美元的稳定币流入数据，我们比较了“稳定币美元化”与传统存款美元化的动态变化及其驱动因素。我们发现，历史上的存款美元化与近期的稳定币流动均与相似的宏观金融驱动因素相关联，包括汇率传导强度以及主权或银行危机。我们还发现，存款美元化和稳定币美元化均表现出显著的持续性，这表明一旦形成美元化，便难以逆转。与存款美元化不同，稳定币流动似乎在很大程度上不受广泛或特定资本流动限制的影响。这可能是因为稳定币部分在监管范围之外流通。历史记录还表明，适度的存款美元化与略高的通胀风险相关，尽管几乎没有证据表明其对货币政策传导产生显著影响。
title: Dollarisation and monetary control: what lessons for the rise of stablecoins?
title_zh: 美元化与货币控制：稳定币兴起带来哪些启示？

abstract: We study how central banks have used their balance sheet to absorb international monetary shocks since the late 19th century, thereby regaining some monetary policy autonomy in a context of financial openness. If the uncovered interest rate parity does not hold, an increase in the leading international interest rate may push up domestic interest rates in both fixed and floating exchange rate regimes. Central banks can partially insulate domestic short-term interest rates from this increase by expanding domestic assets. With a fixed exchange rate, this is in addition to the sterilization of foreign exchange interventions. Accounting for the response of central bank balance sheets to an exogenous international shock sheds light on some puzzling behavior of interest rates and exchange rates across international monetary regimes in history. This study is based on a new monthly dataset of central bank balance sheets, macroeconomic, and financial variables for 23 countries since 1891.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了自19世纪末以来，中央银行如何利用其资产负债表来吸收国际货币冲击，从而在金融开放的背景下重新获得一定的货币政策自主性。若未抛补利率平价不成立，主要国际利率的上升可能会在固定汇率和浮动汇率制度下推高国内利率。中央银行可以通过扩大国内资产来部分隔离国内短期利率免受这种上升的影响。在固定汇率制度下，这除了对外汇干预进行冲销之外，还是一种额外的措施。考虑中央银行资产负债表对外生国际冲击的反应，有助于解释历史上不同国际货币制度下利率和汇率的一些令人困惑的行为。本研究基于自1891年以来23个国家的中央银行资产负债表、宏观经济和金融变量的新月度数据集。
title: Central Banks and the Absorption of International Shocks (1891-2019)
title_zh: 中央银行与国际冲击的吸收（1891-2019）

abstract: We provide new estimates of the return on US external claims and liabilities using confidential, high-quality, security-level data. The excess return is positive on average, since claims are relatively more tilted toward higher-return equities. The excess return is large and positive in normal times and large and negative during global crises, reflecting the global insurance role of the US external balance sheet. With an increased frequency of global crises, the excess return has declined over the recent period. When controlling for issuer's nationality, US investors have larger exposure to equity issued by Asia-headquartered corporations than reported in aggregate statistics. Equity portfolios are concentrated in 'superstar' firms, but for US liabilities foreign holdings are less concentrated than the overall market.
abstract_zh: 我们利用保密、高质量、证券层面的数据，对美国外部债权与负债的回报率提供了新的估计。平均而言，超额回报为正，因为债权相对更倾向于高回报的股权。在正常时期，超额回报大且为正，而在全球危机期间则大且为负，这反映了美国外部资产负债表的全球保险作用。随着全球危机频率的增加，近期超额回报有所下降。在控制发行人国籍后，美国投资者对总部位于亚洲的公司发行的股权敞口大于汇总统计数据所显示的水平。股权组合集中于“超级明星”企业，但对于美国负债而言，外国持有集中度低于整体市场。
title: New Evidence on the US Excess Return on Foreign Portfolios
title_zh: 美国对外投资组合超额收益的新证据

abstract: This paper studies monetary policy in a New Keynesian model with persistent supply shocks, that is, sustained increases in production costs due to factors such as wars or geopolitical fragmentation. First, we demonstrate that Taylor rules fail to stabilize long-term inflation due to endogenous shifts in the natural interest rate. Second, we analyze optimal policy responses under discretion and commitment. Under discretion, a systematic inflationary bias emerges when the shock impacts the economy. Under commitment, the optimal policy adopts a lean-against-the-wind approach without compensating for past inflation, implying that "bygones are bygones". We further extend the model to incorporate the zero lower bound (ZLB) and show that the optimal policy supports preemptive easing.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个包含持续性供给冲击的新凯恩斯模型中的货币政策，此类冲击指因战争或地缘政治分裂等因素导致的生产成本持续上升。首先，我们证明泰勒规则因自然利率的内生变动而无法稳定长期通胀。其次，我们分析了相机抉择和承诺下的最优政策应对。在相机抉择下，当冲击影响经济时，会出现系统性的通胀偏差。在承诺下，最优政策采取逆风而行的方式，而不对过去的通胀进行补偿，这意味着“既往不咎”。我们进一步将模型扩展至包含零下界（ZLB）的情形，并表明最优政策支持预防性宽松。
title: Monetary Policy with Persistent Supply Shocks
title_zh: 持续供给冲击下的货币政策

abstract: Recessions are often accompanied by heightened uncertainty. We build an imperfect-information New Keynesian model in which procyclical information quality generates endogenous countercyclical uncertainty, and the nonlinear structure allows for a precautionary saving motive. We show theoretically that endogenous uncertainty operates entirely through aggregate demand. For negative supply shocks, the induced rise in uncertainty can depress demand enough to dominate the shock
abstract_zh: 经济衰退往往伴随着不确定性的加剧。我们构建了一个信息不完全的新凯恩斯主义模型，其中顺周期的信息质量内生地产生了逆周期的经济不确定性，而非线性结构则引入了预防性储蓄动机。我们从理论上证明，内生不确定性完全通过总需求渠道发挥作用。对于负向供给冲击，由此引发的不确定性上升足以抑制需求，从而可能主导冲击本身的影响。
title: Supply Shocks in the Fog: The Role of Endogenous Uncertainty
title_zh: 迷雾中的供给冲击：内生不确定性的作用

abstract: We develop a Trend-Cycle Bayesian VAR that jointly estimates the real neutral rate of interest, r_t^*, and identifies monetary policy shocks. A key innovation is that cyclical shocks, notably monetary policy shocks, can affect the trend of macroeconomic variables, providing a way to assess whether transitory disturbances have persistent effects. Using external instruments, we find that contractionary shocks reduce r_t^* and lower trend GDP growth. Although they generate sizable movements, their contribution to the secular decline in r_t^* is modest and slightly positive since the early 1990s. Cross-country evidence shows similar patterns.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个趋势-周期贝叶斯向量自回归模型，该模型联合估计实际中性利率r_t^*并识别货币政策冲击。一项关键创新在于，周期性冲击，尤其是货币政策冲击，能够影响宏观经济变量的趋势，从而提供了一种评估暂时性扰动是否具有持久效应的方法。利用外部工具，我们发现紧缩性冲击降低了r_t^*并抑制了趋势GDP增长。尽管这些冲击引发了显著波动，但自1990年代初以来，它们对r_t^*长期下降的贡献较为温和且略呈正向。跨国证据显示了相似的模式。
china_relevance_reason: 论文研究货币政策冲击对中性利率的影响，使用跨国数据，未涉及中国、中国企业、人群或地区，作者亦非中国背景。
title: Do Monetary Policy Shocks Affect the Neutral Rate of Interest?
title_zh: 货币政策冲击是否影响中性利率？

abstract: This paper reports key findings from the Sub-Saharan Africa Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) and Digital Payments Survey, shedding light on the motivations, benefits, and challenges of CBDC adoption, as well as the developments of digital private money and crypto assets in sub-Saharan Africa. It emphasizes the pivotal role of collaboration and shared knowledge in navigating the intricate landscape of digital currencies and assets in sub-Saharan Africa. As this evolving digital frontier is explored, the experiences and aspirations of the region's central banks, as expressed in the survey, will help harness the potential for digital currencies, assets, and payments, and foster cooperation among countries in sub-Saharan Africa. A forthcoming IMF Departmental Paper will focus on key issues for countries in sub-Saharan Africa pertaining to CBDCs, private digital payments, and crypto assets. It will provide a deeper discussion of the benefits, costs, and risks of these digital payment systems and present policy options to enhance financial digital development and inclusion, while safeguarding macroeconomic and financial stability.
abstract_zh: 本文报告了撒哈拉以南非洲中央银行数字货币（CBDC）与数字支付调查的关键发现，揭示了该地区CBDC采纳的动机、益处与挑战，以及私人数字货币和加密资产的发展动态。文章强调了合作与知识共享在应对撒哈拉以南非洲数字货币与资产复杂格局中的关键作用。随着这一不断演变的数字前沿被探索，调查中所反映的该地区中央银行的经历与愿景，将有助于挖掘数字货币、资产及支付的潜力，并促进撒哈拉以南非洲各国间的合作。即将发布的国际货币基金组织部门论文将聚焦于撒哈拉以南非洲国家在CBDC、私人数字支付及加密资产方面的关键问题，深入探讨这些数字支付系统的益处、成本与风险，并提出政策选项，以促进金融数字化发展与包容性，同时维护宏观经济和金融稳定。
title: Central Bank Digital Currency and Other Digital Payments in Sub-Saharan Africa: A Regional Survey
title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的中央银行数字货币与其他数字支付：区域调查

abstract: This paper examines how the Iran-Israel conflict, and the Middle East tension in general, have affected the Pakistani economy in terms of trade, energy, and remittance. Being an energy-import dependent and export-oriented economy with a large diaspora in Gulf countries, Pakistan is prone to global oil price shocks, oil disruptions along important energy routes such as the Strait of Hormuz and possible drops in remittance inflows. Pakistan saw a potential resolution of an impact on retail fuel prices of about 20 percent in 2023-2026, with an increment of petrol and diesel of 55 per Pak rupee, which has increased inflation and aggravated the trade deficit. This paper illustrates the spread of global political events in domestic economic forces using international trade theory, macroeconomic shock theory and remittance development theory. In order to reduce the risk in the short run and increase resilience in the long-term, it is recommended to diversify the trade, establish energy security measures, formal remittance protection, and implement sound fiscal and monetary policies. The paper highlights the economic fragility of Pakistan to external shocks and outlines feasible measures to help it maintain a growth and stability in the current geopolitical instability.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了伊朗-以色列冲突及整个中东紧张局势如何通过贸易、能源和侨汇渠道影响巴基斯坦经济。作为一个依赖能源进口、以出口为导向且在海湾国家拥有大量侨民的经济体，巴基斯坦易受全球油价冲击、霍尔木兹海峡等重要能源通道中断以及侨汇流入可能下降的影响。巴基斯坦预计在2023-2026年间零售燃油价格可能受到约20%的影响，汽油和柴油每巴基斯坦卢比上涨55%，这加剧了通货膨胀并恶化了贸易逆差。本文运用国际贸易理论、宏观经济冲击理论和侨汇发展理论，阐释了全球政治事件在国内经济力量中的传导机制。为降低短期风险并增强长期韧性，建议实现贸易多元化、建立能源安全措施、完善侨汇保障机制，并实施稳健的财政和货币政策。本文凸显了巴基斯坦对外部冲击的经济脆弱性，并提出了在当前地缘政治不稳定背景下帮助其维持增长与稳定的可行措施。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为巴基斯坦经济，涉及伊朗-以色列冲突影响，未涉及中国、中国企业、中国人群或中国地区。
title: Economic Implication of the Iran-Israel Conflict on Pakistan: Trade, Energy, and Remittance Perspectives (2023-2026)
title_zh: 伊朗-以色列冲突对巴基斯坦的经济影响：贸易、能源与侨汇视角（2023-2026）

title: When Fathers Do More Childcare: The Narrowing Gender Wage Gap, Intra-Household Time Reallocation, and Mothers' Rising Labor Supply
title_zh: 父亲承担更多育儿责任：性别工资差距缩小、家庭内部时间再分配与母亲劳动供给上升

abstract: Mientras está bien documentada la importancia del liderazgo de los rectores, poco se sabe sobre cómo desarrollar sus competencias, especialmente entre aquellos que están en ejercicio. La presente investigación estudia cómo el programa más importante de desarrollo profesional de rectores en Colombia, Rectores Líderes Transformadores (RLT), promueve las competencias necesarias para el ejercicio del liderazgo. Haciendo seguimiento a dos cohortes del programa durante dos años, se encuentran cinco acciones concretas e intencionadas que RLT implementa para impulsar las competencias de los rectores: (i) hacer énfasis en las competencias personales; ii) crear ambientes adecuados para la relación entre pares; iii) propiciar múltiples espacios de reflexión; iv) realizar acompañamiento directo; v) entregar herramientas prácticas y efectivas. A pesar de que RLT impulsa importantes habilidades, los resultados sugieren que el programa no desarrolla algunas competencias cruciales para el ejercicio del liderazgo educativo tales como gestión del cambio, innovación, negociación, toma de decisiones, manejo de conflictos, pensamiento estratégico, pensamiento sistémico y tolerancia a la presión. Finalmente, se concluye que las metodologías experienciales y el enfoque en el desarrollo del ser, son las que potencian el desarrollo de las demás competencias.
abstract_zh: 尽管校长领导力的重要性已有充分文献记载，但关于如何培养其能力，尤其是在职校长的能力发展方面，相关研究仍较为匮乏。本研究探讨了哥伦比亚最重要的校长专业发展项目——“变革型领导者校长项目”（RLT）如何促进校长行使领导力所需的能力。通过对该项目两届学员为期两年的跟踪调查，研究发现RLT实施了五项具体且有意的行动来推动校长能力提升：（i）强调个人能力；（ii）营造有利于同伴关系的环境；（iii）提供多种反思空间；（iv）开展直接辅导；（v）提供实用有效的工具。尽管RLT推动了重要技能的发展，但研究结果表明，该项目并未培养教育领导力实践中某些关键能力，如变革管理、创新、谈判、决策、冲突处理、战略思维、系统思维以及抗压能力。最后，研究得出结论：体验式方法论和以“人的发展”为核心的取向，是促进其他能力发展的关键因素。
title: ¿Cómo desarrollar las competencias de los líderes de la escuela? Un estudio del programa Rectores Líderes Transformadores (RLT)
title_zh: 如何培养学校领导者的能力？——基于“变革型校长领导力”项目（RLT）的研究

abstract: Über Wähler:innen der AfD dominieren häufig vereinfachende Stereotype: Sie gelten entweder als sozial abgehängte Protestwähler:innen oder als geschlossen radikal rechtes Milieu. Beides greift zu kurz. Das vorliegende Policy Paper zeigt, dass die AfD-Wählerschaft zwar durch migrations- und kulturpolitische Restriktivität verbunden ist, zugleich aber unterschiedliche politische Profile umfasst. Diese unterscheiden sich darin, wie stark Zuwanderungsablehnung mit Autoritarismus, antisemitischen Ressentiments und pessimistischen Einschätzungen der deutschen Wirtschaftslage verknüpft ist. Die Ergebnisse sprechen dafür, im Umgang mit der AfD-Wählerschaft stärker zu differenzieren.
abstract_zh: 关于德国选择党（AfD）选民，常常流行着过于简化的刻板印象：他们要么被视为社会边缘化的抗议选民，要么被视为铁板一块的激进右翼群体。这两种看法都失之偏颇。本政策文件表明，AfD选民虽然因移民和文化政策上的限制性立场而联结在一起，但同时也包含不同的政治面貌。这些差异体现在，对移民的排斥与威权主义、反犹怨恨情绪以及对德国经济形势的悲观评估之间的关联强度各不相同。研究结果支持在与AfD选民打交道时进行更细致的区分。
title: Von kultureller Restriktion und autoritärer Radikalität: Eine typologische Analyse der AfD-Wählerschaft
title_zh: 从文化限制到威权激进：德国选择党选民群体的类型学分析

abstract: As organizations increasingly weave algorithmic systems into control processes, managerial authority is shifting from human supervisors alone toward varying hybrid arrangements in which humans and algorithms jointly control workers. So far, we lack a sound conceptual basis for categorizing and comparing these arrangements across organizations. In this paper, we examine algorithmic cosupervision (ACoS) as a hybrid control mode in which supervisors and AC systems jointly direct, evaluate, and discipline workers. Building on prior literature and an analysis of 14 real-world ACoS settings, we propose a taxonomy that conceptualizes the phenomenon. We identify two meta-dimensions, control collaboration and control enactment, and six dimensions that enable researchers to categorize and compare ACoS across organizations. We demonstrate the taxonomy’s applicability through three ACoS examples. The proposed taxonomy advances understanding and provides a structured framework for studying emerging human–algorithmic supervisory arrangements in organizations.
abstract_zh: 随着组织日益将算法系统融入控制流程，管理权威正从仅由人类主管承担，转向人类与算法共同控制工人的多种混合安排。迄今为止，我们缺乏一个坚实的理论基础来对这些跨组织的安排进行分类和比较。本文探讨了算法共同监督（ACoS）作为一种混合控制模式，其中主管与AC系统共同指导、评估和约束工人。基于既有文献及对14个实际ACoS情境的分析，我们提出了一种概念化该现象的分类体系。我们识别出两个元维度——控制协作与控制执行，以及六个维度，使研究者能够跨组织对ACoS进行分类和比较。通过三个ACoS实例，我们展示了该分类体系的适用性。所提出的分类体系增进了理解，并为研究组织中新兴的人机监督安排提供了结构化框架。
title: A Taxonomy Of Algorithmic Co-Supervision
title_zh: 算法协同监督的分类体系

abstract: A salient feature of the post-COVID inflation surge is that economic activity has remained resilient despite unfavorable supply-side developments. We develop a macroeconomic model with nonlinear price and wage Phillips curves, endogenous intrinsic indexation, and an unobserved components representation of a cost-push shock that is consistent with these observations. In our model, a persistent large adverse supply shock can lead to a persistent inflation surge while output expands if the central bank follows an inflation forecast-based policy rule and thus abstains from hiking policy rates for some time as it (erroneously) expects inflationary pressures to dissipate quickly. A standard linearized formulation of our model cannot account for these observations under identical assumptions. Our nonlinear framework implies that the standard prescription of "looking throughâ€ supply shocks is a good policy for small shocks when inflation is near the central bank's target, but that such a policy may be quite risky when economic activity is strong and large shocks drive inflation well above target. Moreover, our model implies that the economic costs of "going the last mileâ€ -i.e., a tight stance aimed at returning inflation quickly to target-can be substantial.
abstract_zh: 后疫情时代通胀飙升的一个显著特征是，尽管供给侧形势不利，经济活动仍保持韧性。我们构建了一个宏观经济模型，该模型包含非线性的价格和工资菲利普斯曲线、内生性固有指数化机制，以及一个与上述观察相符的成本推动冲击的不可观测成分表示。在我们的模型中，如果中央银行遵循基于通胀预测的政策规则，并因此（错误地）预期通胀压力将迅速消散而在一段时间内避免加息，那么持续的大规模不利供给冲击可能导致持续的通胀飙升，同时产出扩张。在相同假设下，我们模型的标准线性化形式无法解释这些观察结果。我们的非线性框架表明，当通胀接近中央银行目标时，标准建议“透视”供给冲击对于小规模冲击是良好政策，但当经济活动强劲且大规模冲击将通胀推至远高于目标水平时，此类政策可能相当冒险。此外，我们的模型表明，“走完最后一英里”——即旨在迅速将通胀回归目标的紧缩政策立场——的经济成本可能相当可观。
title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Scares
title_zh: 货币政策与通胀恐慌

abstract: Using newly digitized election results and a name-matching algorithm that tracks individual candidates across elections, we provide the first systematic estimates of the effect of winning a legislative seat on re-running in the next election across 17 African countries and 86 elections (1963-2024). Getting back on the ballot is the first gate to re-election. Incumbent re-running rates average 47%, turnover averages around 70%, and barely winning raises the probability of re-running by a median of 21 percentage points and of winning the next election by only 9- far below the US and the UK, where re-running is near-universal, turnover is far lower, and incumbency effects on re-running and winning are far larger. We look at country specific academic literature, news sources, cross-country comparisons of indexes of parliamentary power, and text analysis of Hansard parliamentary activity to study the mechanism through which re-running is determined. The results are mostly consistent with re-running suppression by the executive. Monitoring incumbent re-nomination rates may help evaluate elections before a single ballot is cast.
abstract_zh: 利用新近数字化的选举结果及一种跨选举追踪个体候选人的姓名匹配算法，我们首次对17个非洲国家、86次选举（1963-2024年）中赢得立法席位对下届选举再次参选的影响进行了系统性估计。重新登上选票是连任的第一道门槛。现任议员再次参选率平均为47%，更替率平均约为70%，而勉强获胜使再次参选概率的中位数提高21个百分点，使赢得下届选举的概率仅提高9个百分点——远低于美国和英国，在那里再次参选近乎普遍，更替率远低，且现任优势对再次参选和获胜的影响远为显著。我们结合国别学术文献、新闻来源、议会权力指数的跨国比较，以及对议会活动记录的文本分析，来研究决定再次参选的机制。结果大体上与行政机构压制再次参选的现象相符。监测现任议员重新提名率，或许能在投出第一张选票之前就对选举进行评估。
title: The Re-running Margin: Incumbency and Turnover in African Parliaments, 1963-2024
title_zh: 重新竞选优势：非洲议会中的在位者与更替，1963-2024

abstract: We estimate the earnings returns to occupational licensing by exploiting regression discontinuities at the Italian bar exam. Law graduates who became lawyers after barely passing the exam earned 20,000 euros (50%) more per year than they would have in alternative occupations. This premium is not driven by monopoly rents from entry barriers. Instead, it reflects a compensating differential for the greater earnings risk inherent in the legal profession relative to the outside options available to law graduates.
abstract_zh: 我们利用意大利律师资格考试中的回归不连续性，估算了职业许可带来的收入回报。勉强通过考试后成为律师的法学院毕业生，其年收入比他们在其他职业中可能获得的收入高出20，000欧元（50%）。这一溢价并非源于进入壁垒带来的垄断租金，而是反映了相对于法学院毕业生可获得的替代职业选择，法律职业固有的更高收入风险所对应的补偿性差异。
title: Estimating the Returns to Occupational Licensing: Evidence from Regression Discontinuities at the Bar Exam
title_zh: 估计职业许可的回报：来自律师资格考试回归断点设计的证据

abstract: Using UK longitudinal data on dual-earner couples, this paper estimates a model of intrahousehold housework decisions, which combines a randomized experimental framework eliciting counterfactual choices with gender norms differences across ethnicities and cohorts to identify the impacts of individual preferences and gender identity norms. Equal sharing of tasks yields greater utility for both men and women, with women disliking domestic chores as much as men. Although couples would want to use housework arrangements to compensate for differentials in labor market involvement, women end up performing a substantially larger share of housework. This is not due to specialization, rather social norms play a key role. Exposure to more egalitarian gender attitudes significantly increases the probability of choosing an equal share of housework. Were attitudes evened up to the most progressive levels observed in the sample, women doing more housework than their partners would stop to be the norm already among present-day households, except for households with children.
abstract_zh: 本文利用英国双职工夫妇的纵向数据，估计了一个家庭内家务劳动决策模型，该模型结合了引出反事实选择的随机实验框架与不同种族和世代间的性别规范差异，以识别个人偏好和性别认同规范的影响。家务劳动的平等分担对男性和女性均带来更高的效用，且女性对家务劳动的厌恶程度与男性相当。尽管夫妇倾向于利用家务安排来补偿劳动力市场参与的差异，但女性最终承担了显著更大份额的家务劳动。这并非源于专业化分工，而是社会规范发挥了关键作用。接触更平等的性别态度显著提高了选择平等分担家务的概率。若态度提升至样本中观察到的最进步水平，女性承担多于伴侣家务的现象在当今家庭中将不再成为常态，但育有子女的家庭除外。
title: Dividing Housework between Partners: Individual Preferences and Social Norms
title_zh: 伴侣间家务分工：个人偏好与社会规范

abstract: In the digital era, organizations are increasingly relying on employee-generated communication to shape their employer brand image. This study proposes an integrative conceptual framework that examines the relationships between personal branding, employee advocacy, and employer brand attractiveness, while accounting for the moderating role of social media use. Drawing on Social Identity Theory, identity expressiveness theory and Social Exchange Theory, it argues that employees who actively develop their personal brand enhance their visibility, credibility, and professional image, which motivates them to engage in promotional behaviors that benefit their organization. These promotional behaviors, in turn, influence the organization's external image and strengthen the appeal of the employer brand, defined as the perceived benefits of working for a given organization. Furthermore, this theoretical framework suggests that the use of social media strengthens these ties by providing a platform through which employees can express both their personal identity and organizational identity, and reach a wider audience. Methodologically, this study adopts a theory-based integrative literature review relying on a structured analysis of prior research in the fields of organizational behavior, communication, and employer branding. By integrating previously fragmented lines of research, this study contributes to the literature by highlighting the role of employee advocacy as a key mediating mechanism and the use of social media as a contextual moderator in the relationship between personal branding and employer brand attractiveness. The study concludes that personal branding positively influences employee advocacy, which in turn strengthens employer brand attractiveness, while social media use amplifies these relationships in digital environments.From a managerial perspective, it emphasizes the importance of empowering employees to act as agents of strategic communication in order to enhance the organization's appeal in competitive labor markets. Keywords : Personal branding, Employee advocacy, Employer brand attractiveness, Social media use.
abstract_zh: 在数字化时代，组织日益依赖员工生成的沟通来塑造其雇主品牌形象。本研究提出了一个综合性的概念框架，探讨个人品牌、员工倡导与雇主品牌吸引力之间的关系，并考虑社交媒体使用的调节作用。基于社会认同理论、身份表达理论和社会交换理论，本研究认为，积极发展个人品牌的员工能够提升其可见度、可信度和专业形象，从而激励他们参与有利于组织的推广行为。这些推广行为反过来影响组织的外部形象，并增强雇主品牌的吸引力，即感知到的在特定组织工作的益处。此外，该理论框架表明，社交媒体的使用通过提供一个平台，使员工能够同时表达个人身份和组织身份，并触达更广泛的受众，从而强化这些联系。在方法论上，本研究采用基于理论的结构化综合文献综述方法，系统分析组织行为学、传播学和雇主品牌领域的先前研究。通过整合以往分散的研究线索，本研究为文献贡献在于强调员工倡导作为关键中介机制，以及社交媒体使用作为个人品牌与雇主品牌吸引力之间关系的情境调节因素。研究得出结论：个人品牌正向影响员工倡导，进而增强雇主品牌吸引力，而社交媒体使用在数字环境中放大了这些关系。从管理视角来看，本研究强调赋权员工作为战略沟通代理人的重要性，以增强组织在竞争激烈的劳动力市场中的吸引力。关键词：个人品牌、员工倡导、雇主品牌吸引力、社交媒体使用。
authors: Fatima Ezzahra Khouiammi (UCA - Université Cadi Ayyad = Cadi Ayyad University [Marrakech])
Zayer Chaimaa (UIC - Université Internationale de Casablanca)
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为员工个人品牌、员工倡导与雇主吸引力，作者来自摩洛哥高校，未涉及中国数据、制度或政策背景，属于一般性理论框架研究。
title: Employee Advocacy, Personal Branding, and Employer Attractiveness in the Digital Era: An integrative conceptual framework
title_zh: 数字时代的员工倡导、个人品牌与雇主吸引力：一个整合性概念框架

abstract: We study the extent to which exposure to COVID-19 relates to healthcare professionals’ prosociality. Drawing on empirical evidence from an incentivized experiment and a companion survey of healthcare professionals (HCPs) at a large Italian hospital (N = 194), we find that different forms of exposure to COVID-19 predict their altruistic motivation in heterogeneous ways. HCPs who worked in COVID 19 wards or had a close relative or friend severely affected by the virus are more than 5 percentage points more likely to prioritize patient welfare over personal gain, with the association for professional exposure being mostly driven by female HCPs, especially nurses. Conversely, personally contracting COVID-19 is associated with a 6 percentage point decline in prosociality. Our results highlight that different experiences of need shape prosocial behavior in hospital settings.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了接触COVID-19与医护人员亲社会性之间的关联程度。基于一项激励性实验及对意大利一家大型医院医护人员（N=194）的配套调查所获得的实证证据，我们发现，不同形式的COVID-19暴露对其利他动机的预测作用存在异质性。在COVID-19病房工作或近亲或好友严重感染该病毒的医护人员，将患者福祉置于个人利益之上的可能性高出5个百分点以上，其中职业暴露的关联主要由女性医护人员，尤其是护士驱动。相反，个人感染COVID-19与亲社会性下降6个百分点相关。我们的结果凸显了不同需求经历如何塑造医院环境中的亲社会行为。
title: COVID-19 pandemic and prosociality: an experiment with healthcare professionals
title_zh: COVID-19大流行与亲社会行为：一项针对医疗保健专业人员的实验

abstract: The rapid growth of private higher education institutions (PHEIs) in Morocco is an emerging phenomenon that brings several challenges, notably high staff turnover. In this context, attracting and retaining faculty members represent a strategic priority for PHEIs to ensure a sustainable competitive advantage and strengthen their employer brand. This brand relies on both an external dimension, oriented toward students (Whisman 2009; Nguyen et al. 2019), and an internal dimension focused on employees, which is recognized as essential (Chapleo et al. 2019). A review of the existing literature reveals a near-total absence of research addressing the link between employer branding in higher education institutions and the attraction and retention of top talent, whether in Morocco or elsewhere. This article explores the internal approach through a qualitative study involving 18 professors from two private business and engineering schools, using thematic content analysis. Our findings reveal that developing an employer brand within PHEIs is vital. However, other attractive attributes also influence teachers' decision-making processes regarding their choice of institution, such as work-life balance, ethical behavior, managerial style, compensation, and career development. Keywords: Employer brand, private higher education institution, work-life balance, ethical behavior, managerial style, compensation, career development.
abstract_zh: 摩洛哥私立高等教育机构的迅速增长是一个新兴现象，带来了诸多挑战，尤其是高员工流动率问题。在此背景下，吸引并留住教职员工成为私立高等教育机构确保可持续竞争优势、强化雇主品牌的一项战略优先事项。这一品牌既包含面向学生的外部维度（Whisman 2009; Nguyen et al. 2019），也包含聚焦于员工的内部维度，后者被认为是至关重要的（Chapleo et al. 2019）。对现有文献的回顾显示，无论是在摩洛哥还是其他地方，关于高等教育机构雇主品牌与顶尖人才吸引及保留之间联系的研究几乎完全缺失。本文通过一项涉及两所私立商业与工程学校的18位教授的定性研究，采用主题内容分析法，探讨了内部路径。我们的研究结果表明，在私立高等教育机构中发展雇主品牌至关重要。然而，其他具有吸引力的属性也影响着教师在选择院校时的决策过程，例如工作与生活的平衡、道德行为、管理风格、薪酬以及职业发展。关键词：雇主品牌，私立高等教育机构，工作与生活平衡，道德行为，管理风格，薪酬，职业发展。
authors: Hind Benkirane (UH2C - Université Hassan II de Casablanca = University of Hassan II Casablanca = جامعة الحسن الثاني (ar))
Naima Idouaarabe (Université Sultan Moulay Slimane de Béni Mellal)
title: Employer Brandin of Private Higher Education Institutions Between Attraction and Retention: Expert Perspectives
title_zh: 私立高等教育机构雇主品牌建设：吸引与保留之间的平衡——专家视角

abstract: The logistics industry, as well as various trade and industrial sectors, are facing the challenge of dealing with an economically significant shortage of truck drivers. Currently, approximately 7% of truck driver positions in Germany and Europe are vacant (IRU 2024). At the same time, statistics show an increase in transport performance in ton-kilometers and a shift towards vehicles in higher weight classes (DLR 2023). The age structure is a key aspect that could contribute to this shortage of truck drivers, particularly in a long-term perspective. In Germany, the proportion of truck drivers aged 55 or older is 36%, while at the European level this is 33%. In contrast, the proportion of truck drivers aged 25 or younger in Germany and Europe is only 3% and 5%, respectively (IRU 2024). This difference points to future challenges in human resources management for logistics: A significant proportion of truck drivers will retire due to age, but a corresponding increase in the number of younger truck drivers cannot be expected. Furthermore, truck drivers are exposed to a high daily workload. Hege et al. 2019 as well as Hill and Boyle 2007 demonstrate that an analysis is necessary to promote the occupational health and safety of this specific group, strengthen their intrinsic motivation, and enhance their performance. Truck drivers are exposed to various hazards. An empirical study showed that insomnia, a stress-induced reduction in attention, and the resulting irritability are significant risk factors for traffic accidents (Shams et al. 2021). Therefore, a promising area of research is dedicated to the well-being of truck drivers and employees. According to relevant research, employee well-being has a significant impact on work efficiency in general (Corbett 2024) and road safety specifically. To gain deeper scientific insights into this area, an interdisciplinary approach is necessary. Interdisciplinary research challenges disciplinary boundaries and exclusive focuses and offers new perspectives for understanding complex phenomena that cannot be fully grasped by a single discipline alone. Expanding disciplinary perspectives to include complex empirical questions is necessary to investigate real-world situations, gain new insights, and develop problem-oriented solutions. Challenges such as cross-disciplinary motivation, the development of a common language, the formulation of shared theories, and the creation of practical applications must be overcome. If these hurdles are overcome, interdisciplinary research can significantly contribute to a better understanding of complex management phenomena. Not only does it support a holistic perspective on theoretical questions, it also enables the development of novel methodological approaches. Collaboration between different disciplines is crucial for expanding scientific knowledge and developing practice-relevant solutions to current management challenges (Reinecke et al. 2024). This dissertation highlights the need for research in this field and addresses complex issues related to it. Due to this complexity, interdisciplinary approaches were chosen. The study addresses the relevance of personnel heterogeneity and individual resources for job performance, as well as the previously under-researched relationships between truck driver characteristics and their performance and safety. A synchronized data collection approach for truck drivers, which considers individual characteristics and their impact on health, performance, and safety, is presented below. Practical applications in human resource management and distribution are outlined. Finally, the underlying theories and methodological approaches are explained. The human factor is the central research topic in each of the individual complexes of this dissertation. This provides the relevant framework and highlights the shift from the Industry 4.0 concept with a technological focus to the "Industry 5.0" paradigm with a complementary human-centric approach. The aim is to analyze the effects of human factors and utilize them in operational areas for the productive design of work processes, thereby jointly improving work quality in terms of health and productivity. In this sense, this dissertation offers insights into future human-centric logistics management concepts.
abstract_zh: 物流业以及各类贸易和工业部门正面临应对经济上显著的卡车司机短缺问题的挑战。目前，德国和欧洲约有7%的卡车司机职位空缺（IRU 2024）。与此同时，统计数据显示，以吨公里计的运输绩效有所提升，并且车辆向更高重量级别转移（DLR 2023）。年龄结构是可能加剧卡车司机短缺的关键因素，尤其是在长期视角下。在德国，55岁及以上卡车司机的比例为36%，而在欧洲层面这一比例为33%。相比之下，德国和欧洲25岁及以下卡车司机的比例分别仅为3%和5%（IRU 2024）。这一差异预示着物流业人力资源管理未来面临的挑战：相当大比例的卡车司机将因年龄原因退休，但无法预期年轻卡车司机数量会有相应的增长。此外，卡车司机承受着高强度的日常工作负荷。Hege等人2019年以及Hill和Boyle 2007年的研究表明，有必要进行分析，以促进这一特定群体的职业健康与安全，增强其内在动机，并提升其绩效。卡车司机面临多种危害。一项实证研究表明，失眠、压力引起的注意力下降以及由此产生的易怒情绪是交通事故的重要风险因素（Shams等人2021）。因此，一个具有前景的研究领域致力于卡车司机和员工的福祉。根据相关研究，员工福祉总体上对工作效率（Corbett 2024）以及具体到道路安全具有显著影响。为了在该领域获得更深入的科学见解，需要采用跨学科方法。跨学科研究挑战学科边界和单一关注点，为理解单一学科无法完全把握的复杂现象提供了新视角。扩展学科视角以涵盖复杂的实证问题，对于调查现实情境、获取新见解和制定问题导向的解决方案是必要的。必须克服跨学科动机、共同语言的发展、共享理论的构建以及实际应用的创造等挑战。如果这些障碍得以克服，跨学科研究可以显著促进对复杂管理现象的更好理解。它不仅支持对理论问题的整体视角，还使得新颖方法论方法的开发成为可能。不同学科之间的合作对于扩展科学知识和制定应对当前管理挑战的实践相关解决方案至关重要（Reinecke等人2024）。本论文强调了该领域的研究需求，并处理了与之相关的复杂问题。由于这种复杂性，选择了跨学科方法。研究涉及人员异质性和个体资源对工作绩效的相关性，以及此前研究不足的卡车司机特征与其绩效和安全之间的关系。下文提出了一种同步数据收集方法，用于卡车司机，考虑个体特征及其对健康、绩效和安全的影响。概述了人力资源管理和配送中的实际应用。最后，解释了基础理论和方法论方法。人的因素是本论文各个独立研究模块中的核心研究主题。这提供了相关框架，并突出了从以技术为中心的工业4.0概念向以互补性人本方法为特征的“工业5.0”范式的转变。目标是分析人的因素的影响，并在运营领域利用这些因素来生产性地设计工作流程，从而在健康和生产效率方面共同改善工作质量。在这个意义上，本论文为未来以人为中心的物流管理概念提供了见解。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为德国及欧洲卡车司机，数据与政策背景均不涉及中国，与中国研究无关。
title: The Human Factor in Logistics: Physiological and Psychological Insights Regarding Truck Drivers
title_zh: 物流中的人为因素：关于卡车司机生理与心理的洞察

abstract: We study the extent to which individuals' consumption decisions are influenced by firms' stances on controversial social issues and the implied incentives for firms to take such stances. We use transactions from a major payment card company to predict cardholders' likely social alignment with firm stances and to quantify effects on consumption. The social stances taken by firms increase revenue on average, with significant heterogeneity across consumers and firm stances. Consumers most aligned with a firm's social stance increase their consumption at the firm by 19 percent in the month following widely known social stance events, and consumers most opposed to the firm's stance decrease their consumption by 12 percent. These diverging consumption responses attenuate over time but persist even a year later. Firms tend to take stances that align with their consumers' and employees' social preferences and that correlate with the firm's ownership structure. Together, our results show that consumers meaningfully respond to their social alignment with firms, and that this consumer response can incentivize profit-maximizing firms to engage with social issues.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了企业就争议性社会议题所持立场对个人消费决策的影响程度，以及这些立场为企业带来的潜在激励。我们利用一家主要支付卡公司的交易数据，预测持卡人可能与企业立场的社会一致性，并量化其对消费的影响。企业采取的社会立场平均而言增加了收入，但在不同消费者和企业立场之间存在显著异质性。在广为人知的社会立场事件发生后的一个月内，与企业立场最一致的消费者在该企业的消费增加了19%，而最反对企业立场的消费者消费减少了12%。这些分化的消费反应随时间减弱，但即使在一年后仍持续存在。企业倾向于采取与其消费者和员工的社会偏好相一致的立场，且这些立场与企业的所有权结构相关。综合来看，我们的结果表明，消费者对其与企业之间的社会一致性有实质性反应，而这种消费者反应可以激励追求利润最大化的企业参与社会议题。
title: Consuming Values
title_zh: 消费价值观

abstract: Agrifood systems (AFS) in Colombia and Peru generate substantial economic value but also impose significant environmental and social externalities that remain unpriced and largely invisible in policy and market decisions. Using the Global Impact Database (GID) and a True Cost Accounting (TCA) framework, this paper quantifies the hidden costs embedded in 19 AFS sectors, with a focus on seven major crop sectors. As one of the first cross-country applications of GID data in Latin America, the analysis offers a harmonized and comprehensive assessment of the true costs of food production, processing, and distribution. Results show that externalities are equivalent to 12 percent of AFS output in Colombia and 13 percent in Peru—a substantial burden that is not captured by conventional economic indicators. Environmental externalities dominate in both countries, driven primarily by land occupation, climate change, air pollution, and use of scarce water. Social externalities—especially underpayment, child labor, and gender wage gaps—are smaller in aggregate but become markedly more significant within crop sectors, as labor intensity and informality characterize production systems. Livestock, dairy, and bovine meat products consistently emerge as the most externality‑intensive sectors, while cereals, rice, sugarcane, oilseeds, and fruits and vegetables exhibit comparatively lower externality costs. Value‑chain decomposition shows that most externalities originate at the production stage (at farm level). These findings highlight several clear leverage points for targeted policy and investment: reducing environmental pressures in livestock systems, improving labor conditions in crop sectors, and integrating TCA metrics into national planning and sustainability strategies. Making the hidden costs visible is essential for advancing more sustainable, equitable, inclusive, and resilient food systems in Colombia and Peru.
abstract_zh: 哥伦比亚和秘鲁的农粮系统（AFS）创造了可观的经济价值，但也带来了重大的环境和社会外部性，这些外部性在政策和市场决策中仍未定价且基本不可见。本文利用全球影响数据库（GID）和真实成本核算（TCA）框架，量化了19个农粮系统部门中隐含的隐性成本，重点关注七个主要作物部门。作为拉丁美洲GID数据首批跨国应用之一，本分析提供了对粮食生产、加工和分配真实成本的统一且全面的评估。结果显示，外部性相当于哥伦比亚农粮系统产出的12%和秘鲁的13%——这一沉重负担未被传统经济指标所捕捉。两国均以环境外部性为主导，主要驱动因素为土地占用、气候变化、空气污染和稀缺水资源的使用。社会外部性——尤其是工资不足、童工和性别工资差距——在总量上较小，但在作物部门内显著更为突出，因为生产系统以劳动密集和非正规化为特征。畜牧业、乳制品和牛肉产品始终是外部性最密集的部门，而谷物、水稻、甘蔗、油籽以及水果和蔬菜的外部性成本相对较低。价值链分解显示，大多数外部性产生于生产阶段（农场层面）。这些发现凸显了若干明确的政策和投资杠杆点：减少畜牧系统环境压力、改善作物部门劳动条件，以及将TCA指标纳入国家规划和可持续性战略。使隐性成本可见对于推进哥伦比亚和秘鲁更可持续、公平、包容和有韧性的粮食系统至关重要。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为哥伦比亚和秘鲁的农食系统，数据、制度背景及政策应用均不涉及中国。
title: Assessing environmental and social burdens in agrifood systems: Insights from Colombia and Peru
title_zh: 评估农业食品系统中的环境与社会负担：来自哥伦比亚和秘鲁的启示

abstract: Applied work routinely estimates treatment effects by linear regression of theoutcome on a treatment indicator and controls, with no interactions between them. We show that, even when selection is entirely on observables and the linear model is correctly specified, minimal unmodeled treatment effect heterogeneity can produce large biases for the average treatment effect on the treated. We decompose the asymptotic bias, control by control, into the product of an unobservable heterogeneity component and an observable amplifier, estimable without outcome data, that grows without bound as the controls better explain treatment. Covariates irrelevant for the outcome are not innocuous: they can generate large biases while their spuriously significant estimates make them self-validating. We propose breakdown diagnostics: the minimal correlated heterogeneity that overturns an estimate. In difference-in-differences, group-specific trends, a standard robustness check, absorb the dynamics of the treatment effect, producing a bias that accumulates with the length of the panel. Applications to 401(k) eligibility and unilateral divorce laws illustrate.
abstract_zh: 应用研究通常通过将结果变量对处理指标和控制变量进行线性回归来估计处理效应，且不包含两者之间的交互项。我们证明，即使选择完全基于可观测变量且线性模型设定正确，最小的未建模处理效应异质性也可能对受处理者的平均处理效应产生较大偏差。我们将渐近偏差逐控制变量分解为不可观测异质性成分与可观测放大器的乘积，后者无需结果数据即可估计，且随着控制变量对处理的解释力增强而无界增长。与结果无关的协变量并非无害：它们可能产生较大偏差，同时其虚假显著的估计值使其具有自我验证性。我们提出崩溃诊断方法：即推翻估计所需的最小相关异质性。在双重差分法中，组特定趋势作为标准稳健性检验，吸收了处理效应的动态变化，从而产生随面板长度累积的偏差。对401(k)资格和单方离婚法的应用研究说明了上述问题。
title: Big Bias from Small Treatment Heterogeneity: When Controlling for Selection Backfires
title_zh: 小处理异质性导致的大偏差：控制选择效应适得其反时

abstract: Advanced economies have undergone enormous structural change in work, income distribution, and the skills of the working population over the past half century. These changes have driven changing geographies of people and households, which are sorted across regions according to their work and incomes. A key previous finding is that high-skill workers have been increasingly concentrating in large metropolitan areas, earning significant wage premiums, while returns to low-skill, lower-wage work shows less spatial variation and tends to be tied to local demand for nontradable services. However, this bipartite division loses considerable information. In this paper, we therefore use a tripartite division (high-, medium-, and low-skilled) to shed additional light on the changing spatial reality of population sorting. Our research generates robust evidence that medium-skill workers have been increasingly spatially separated away from high-skill workers. The middle-skilled and the high-skilled are much less exposed to one another than was the case in the past, a reality that is lost when using only two groups. In addition, we show how spatial sorting of the three groups has affected their relative economic welfare, by documenting shifting real incomes for the three groups in the places where they are dominant. This reflects systematic differences in how their housing costs and their wages evolve relative to each other, an effect of occupational wage differences, on one hand, and spatial sorting on the other. Even though sorting of the middle group in the direction of smaller noncoastal areas does reduce the gap in real incomes relative to the gap when such workers remain in high-skilled
abstract_zh: 过去半个世纪，发达经济体的工作结构、收入分配以及劳动人口的技能水平经历了巨大的结构性变化。这些变化推动了人口与家庭地理格局的演变，人们根据其工作和收入在不同地区间进行分选。先前的一项关键发现是，高技能工人日益集中于大都市区域，并获得显著的工资溢价，而低技能、低工资工作的回报则表现出较小的空间差异，且往往与当地对非贸易服务的需求紧密相关。然而，这种二分法划分丢失了大量信息。因此，本文采用三分法划分（高、中、低技能），以进一步揭示人口分选的空间现实变化。我们的研究提供了稳健的证据，表明中等技能工人日益在空间上与高技能工人分离。中等技能与高技能群体之间的相互接触程度远低于过去，而这一现实在使用仅两组划分时被掩盖了。此外，我们通过记录三组群体在其主导地区的实际收入变化，展示了这三组群体的空间分选如何影响其相对经济福利。这反映了他们的住房成本与工资相对于彼此演变的系统性差异，这一效应一方面源于职业工资差异，另一方面源于空间分选。尽管中等技能群体向较小非沿海地区的分选确实缩小了其实际收入差距，相较于这些工人若留在高技能主导地区时的差距而言，情况有所改善。
title: Going separate ways: spatial sorting by education, work, and real income in the USA since 1970
title_zh: 分道扬镳：1970年以来美国教育、工作与真实收入的空间分选

abstract: Given rising diabetes prevalence globally, access to diabetes treatments is gaining urgency. Yet, it remains unknown which glucose-lowering medication types people with diabetes across low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) use. In this cross-sectional analysis, we pooled nationally representative data of 223, 283 adults aged ≥25 years in 62 LMICs from 2009 to 2019. We found that 51.9% [95%-CI: 49.6%, 54.2%] of 21, 715 individuals with diabetes were undiag-nosed. Among individuals with diagnosed diabetes, 18.6% [95%-CI: 14.5%, 23.4%] reported using no glucose-lowering medication, 57.3% [95%-CI: 53.1%, 61.4%] only used oral medication, 19.5% [95%-CI: 17.6%, 21.5%] used oral med-ication and insulin, and 4.7% [95%-CI: 3.9%, 5.6%] used insulin alone. In low-income countries, fewer individuals with diabetes were diagnosed and treated than in middle-income countries. Yet, among individuals who did get diag-nosed, insulin use was two-thirds higher in low-income countries (38.9% [95%-CI: 31.6%, 46.7%]) compared to middle-income countries (23.2%; 95%-CI: 21.0%, 25.5%]). This ﬁnding could suggest a need for earlier diagnosis and treatment initiation. Our results can inform national and regional drug procurement efforts across LMICs.
abstract_zh: 鉴于全球糖尿病患病率持续上升，糖尿病治疗的可及性日益紧迫。然而，目前尚不清楚低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的糖尿病患者使用哪些类型的降糖药物。在本横断面分析中，我们汇总了2009年至2019年间来自62个低收入和中等收入国家、年龄≥25岁的223,283名成年人的全国代表性数据。我们发现，在21,715名糖尿病患者中，有51.9%[95%置信区间：49.6%，54.2%]未被诊断。在已确诊的糖尿病患者中，18.6%[95%置信区间：14.5%，23.4%]报告未使用任何降糖药物，57.3%[95%置信区间：53.1%，61.4%]仅使用口服药物，19.5%[95%置信区间：17.6%，21.5%]同时使用口服药物和胰岛素，4.7%[95%置信区间：3.9%，5.6%]仅使用胰岛素。在低收入国家，糖尿病患者的诊断率和治疗率均低于中等收入国家。然而，在已确诊的患者中，低收入国家的胰岛素使用率（38.9%[95%置信区间：31.6%，46.7%]）比中等收入国家（23.2%；95%置信区间：21.0%，25.5%]）高出三分之二。这一发现可能表明需要更早的诊断和治疗启动。我们的研究结果可为低收入和中等收入国家的国家和区域药物采购工作提供参考。
title: National evidence on glucose-lowering medication use for diabetes from 62 low- and middle-income countries
title_zh: 62个低收入和中等收入国家糖尿病降糖药物使用的国家证据

abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has been integrated into applications that are transforming the work of individuals, organisations and communities. Studies on artificial intelligence readiness of African countries using indices are growing. This study argues that understanding of artificial intelligence readiness beyond indices is crucial. Stakeholders’ views are important in establishing their needs and preparedness to adopt artificial intelligence. The aim of the study to understand artificial intelligence readiness of Malawi. Using Oxford Insights’ Government AI readiness Index, the study analysed readiness indices data, media reports and policy documents using content analysis. The findings showed that the country lacked national vision to guide governments commitment to develop and adoption artificial intelligence that affected AI sector maturity and human capacity. The country had technical infrastructure and governance principles that can leverage resilience for adoption of artificial intelligence. The study offers useful insights to policymakers on areas that require attention to develop a comprehensive national artificial intelligence policy e.g. AI ethics, data governance, intellectual property and energy and sustainability. The study contributes towards literature on artificial intelligence in the context of Malawi.
abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）已被整合进各类应用中，正深刻改变着个人、组织及社区的工作方式。利用指数评估非洲国家人工智能准备度的研究日益增多。本研究认为，超越指数层面理解人工智能准备度至关重要。利益相关者的观点对于确定其需求及采纳人工智能的准备情况具有重要意义。本研究旨在理解马拉维的人工智能准备度。借助牛津洞察（Oxford Insights）的政府人工智能准备度指数，研究采用内容分析法，对准备度指数数据、媒体报道及政策文件进行了分析。研究发现，该国缺乏指导政府承诺开发与采纳人工智能的国家愿景，这影响了人工智能行业的成熟度及人力资本建设。然而，该国拥有可利用其韧性来促进人工智能采纳的技术基础设施和治理原则。本研究为政策制定者提供了有益见解，指出了在制定全面国家人工智能政策（如人工智能伦理、数据治理、知识产权及能源与可持续性）时需关注的领域。本研究亦为马拉维背景下的人工智能文献做出了贡献。
title: State of national artificial intelligence (AI) readiness and stakeholder’s views: Case of Malawi
title_zh: 国家人工智能（AI）准备状况及利益相关者观点：以马拉维为例

abstract: How do disruptive peers shape academic and career paths? We examine this question by leveraging the random assignment of students to classrooms in Greece and identifying the effects of peer disruptiveness on academic performance and career paths. Using suspension hours as a measure of disruptiveness, we find that students assigned to more disruptive classrooms have lower academic achievement, a higher risk of grade retention, and reduced likelihood of graduating from high school on time. They are also less likely to pursue competitive STEM fields or enroll in selective postsecondary programs. The adverse effects are more pronounced for students from low-income areas, in larger classrooms, or with fewer female peers. Using a lab-in-the-field experiment, we find that exposure to multiple disruptors, compared to just one, reduces students' study motivation, college aspirations, and readiness for science studies and careers, especially for those seated closer to disruptive peers.
abstract_zh: 破坏性同伴如何塑造学业与职业路径？我们利用希腊学生随机分配至班级的机制，考察同伴破坏性对学业表现及职业路径的影响。以停课小时数作为破坏性的衡量指标，我们发现，被分配至更具破坏性班级的学生，其学业成绩较低，留级风险更高，按时高中毕业的可能性降低。他们选择竞争激烈的STEM领域或进入选拔性高等教育项目的可能性也较小。不利影响在来自低收入地区、班级规模较大或女性同伴较少的学生中更为显著。通过一项实地实验，我们发现，与仅接触一名破坏者相比，接触多名破坏者会降低学生的学习动力、大学抱负及对科学学习和职业的准备程度，尤其是对座位靠近破坏性同伴的学生而言。
title: Disruptive Peers and Academic Performance: Short- and Long-Term Outcomes
title_zh: 干扰性同伴与学业表现：短期与长期结果

abstract: This paper explores heterogeneous individual valuations of an important amenity, climate mildness, using a traditional Rosen-Roback empirical framework. It does so by including interaction terms between the amenity and worker characteristics in an hedonic wage regression that also includes a housing-price measure. The results suggest that non-young workers (those in the mid-age and old groups) value a mild climate more than do young workers, matching the usual view that the tolerance for cold weather declines with age. The findings also suggest that, like their highly educated counterparts, workers with low education levels also highly value a mild climate, with workers in the middle range of education having a lower valuation. These findings, which contradict the view that only better-off individuals care about amenities, could reflect the lower burden in mild weather of the manual work done by the less educated. In addition to presenting these empirical findings, the paper further contributes by presenting new analytics for the Rosen-Roback model in a setting with individual heterogeneity.
abstract_zh: 本文运用传统的罗森-罗巴克实证框架，探讨了工人对一项重要宜居条件——气候温和度的异质性评价。通过在特征工资回归中加入该宜居条件与工人特征的交互项，并同时纳入房价指标，本文进行了分析。结果显示，非年轻工人（中年及老年群体）对温和气候的重视程度高于年轻工人，这与通常认为的耐寒能力随年龄增长而下降的观点相符。研究还发现，与高教育水平工人相似，低教育水平工人同样高度重视温和气候，而中等教育水平工人的评价则相对较低。这些发现与仅富裕人群关注宜居条件的观点相悖，可能反映了温和天气下低教育水平工人从事体力劳动负担较轻的情况。除呈现这些实证发现外，本文还通过在个体异质性情境下对罗森-罗巴克模型进行新的分析，进一步做出了贡献。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Heterogeneous Individual Valuations of a Mild Climate
title_zh: 异质性个体对温和气候的估值

abstract: We study a technologically asymmetric, differentiated Bertrand duopoly where the technologically superior firm is a passive partial owner of its rival, and technology transfer occurs through optimal two-part licensing. We show that technology is always transferred in equilibrium, and that passive partial ownership uniformly reduces consumer surplus but can enhance social welfare when product differentiation is low and technological asymmetry is high. The analysis highlights a key trade-off between competitive intensity and efficiency gains from technology diffusion, offering new insights into the welfare and antitrust implications of partial ownership arrangements.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个技术不对称、产品差异化的伯特兰双寡头市场，其中技术领先企业被动部分持有其竞争对手的股份，且技术转移通过最优两部许可实现。研究表明，均衡状态下技术总会发生转移，而被动部分持股始终降低消费者剩余，但在产品差异化程度低且技术不对称程度高时，可能提升社会福利。分析凸显了竞争强度与技术扩散带来的效率提升之间的关键权衡，为部分持股安排的社会福利及反垄断影响提供了新见解。
title: Welfare effects of passive partial ownership in differentiated Bertrand duopoly with optimal technology licensing
title_zh: 差异化伯特兰双寡头中被动部分持股的福利效应及最优技术许可

abstract: Do creditor rights amplify or dampen economic fluctuations? Using a panel of 39 countries from 1978 to 2019, we show that credit expansions in economies with strong creditor protection are followed by smaller output losses, fewer non-performing loans, and a greater reallocation of credit away from unproductive sectors. Firm-level evidence from Delaware’s adoption of antirecharacterization laws shows that well-protected creditors cut credit to low-productivity firms while easing borrowing constraints for productive ones. Overall, our findings indicate that stronger creditor rights dampen the output losses of credit booms by facilitating a more efficient reallocation of capital.
abstract_zh: 债权人权利是放大还是抑制经济波动？利用1978年至2019年间39个国家的面板数据，我们发现，在债权人保护较强的经济体中，信贷扩张之后伴随的产出损失较小，不良贷款较少，且信贷从低效部门向高效部门的再配置更为显著。来自特拉华州采纳反定性法律的微观企业证据表明，受到良好保护的债权人会削减对低生产率企业的信贷，同时放宽对高生产率企业的融资约束。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，更强的债权人权利通过促进资本更有效的再配置，减轻了信贷繁荣带来的产出损失。
title: Credit Cycles and Creditor Rights
title_zh: 信贷周期与债权人权利

abstract: We examine the intergenerational impact of China’s 1950s adult literacy campaign, one of the largest anti-illiteracy efforts in history, reaching 150 million people. While direct effects on adult literacy remain debated, we document significant long-term benefits for the next generation’s education. Using an original dataset compiled from county gazetteers and the population census, we find a notable increase in educational attainment for children whose parents were more strongly exposed to the campaign. We attribute these results to extensive government propaganda that likely shifted population attitudes toward education. Our findings suggest that education campaigns can be a viable strategy in developing countries for improving human capital.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了中国20世纪50年代成人扫盲运动的代际影响，这是历史上规模最大的扫盲行动之一，惠及1.5亿人。尽管对成人识字率的直接影响仍存争议，但我们记录了该运动对下一代教育产生的显著长期益处。利用从县志和人口普查中汇编的原始数据集，我们发现，父母受该运动影响更深的子女，其教育成就显著提高。我们将这些结果归因于广泛的政府宣传，这可能改变了民众对教育的态度。我们的研究结果表明，在发展中国家，教育运动可作为提升人力资本的可行策略。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象明确为中国1950年代成人扫盲运动及其代际影响，使用中国县级数据和人口普查，属于中国制度背景研究。
title: The Power of Words: Adult Literacy Campaign and Intergenerational Transmission of Human Capital
title_zh: 语言的力量：成人扫盲运动与人力资本的代际传递

abstract: This paper examines how selection into medicine in the United States influences physician practice styles. We exploit macroeconomic conditions at the time of medical school application as an exogenous shock to the applicant pool and find that labor market downturns in other prestigious fields increase applications to medical school and shift the composition of matriculating cohorts toward students from non–pre-medical backgrounds. Strikingly, these low–outside-option cohorts practice medicine differently decades later. Conditional on experience, specialty, and outcome year, recession-cohort physicians bill Medicare more per beneficiary despite seeing healthier patients—particularly on discretionary, revenue-generating services—and sort into practice settings with higher-powered financial incentives. The additional spending does not produce detectable improvements in patient health. Taken together, our findings point to stronger financial motivation among those drawn into medicine when outside options are weak and suggest that medical school admissions screen imperfectly on the attributes that ultimately shape how physicians practice.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了美国医学专业选择如何影响医生的执业风格。我们利用医学院申请时的宏观经济状况作为申请者群体的外生冲击，发现其他声望较高领域的劳动力市场衰退会增加医学院的申请人数，并使入学群体的构成向非医学预科背景的学生倾斜。引人注目的是，这些外部选择较差的群体在数十年后的执业方式有所不同。在控制经验、专业和结果年份的条件下，经济衰退时期的医生尽管面对更健康的患者，却对每位受益人的医疗保险账单更高——尤其是在可自由支配、创收性服务上——并倾向于选择财务激励更强的执业环境。额外支出并未带来可检测的患者健康改善。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，当外部选择较弱时，被吸引进入医学领域的人具有更强的财务动机，并暗示医学院招生在最终塑造医生执业方式的特质筛选上并不完美。
title: Selection into Medicine
title_zh: 医学专业的选拔机制

abstract: Credit card interest rates currently average 22%, an 18% spread over the short rate. This spread far exceeds that on any other loan or bond, yet nearly half of households are credit card borrowers. Why are credit card rates so high? To understand this, and the economics of credit card banking, we use regulatory account-level data to analyze the lifetime cash flows of 550 million monthly accounts, representing 90% of the US credit card market. While charge-off rates are comparatively high, averaging around 6%, they explain only a fraction of cards' spread. Reward payments and non-interest expenses are more than offset by interchange and non-interest income. Operating expenses, particularly marketing, are very large, and are used to generate pricing power. Yet, after deducting them, card lending still earns a 6.8% return on assets (ROA), more than four times the banking sector's ROA. Using the cross section of accounts, we estimate that credit card rates price in a 4.3% default risk premium, similar to high-yield bonds. Accounting for this, card lending earns an alpha of around 1.5% relative to the aggregate bank sector.
abstract_zh: 信用卡利率目前平均为22%，较短期利率高出18个百分点。这一利差远超任何其他贷款或债券，然而近半数的家庭却是信用卡借款人。为何信用卡利率如此之高？为理解这一点及信用卡银行业的经济学原理，我们利用监管层面的账户数据，分析了5.5亿个月度账户的终身现金流，这些账户代表了美国信用卡市场的90%。尽管坏账率相对较高，平均约为6%，但这仅解释了信用卡利差的一小部分。奖励支付和非利息支出被交换费和非利息收入所抵消而有余。运营费用，尤其是营销费用，数额庞大，用于创造定价权。然而，在扣除这些费用后，信用卡贷款仍能获得6.8%的资产回报率（ROA），是银行业整体ROA的四倍多。利用账户的横截面数据，我们估计信用卡利率中包含了4.3%的违约风险溢价，与高收益债券相似。考虑到这一点，信用卡贷款相对于整个银行部门产生了约1.5%的超额收益（alpha）。
title: Credit Card Banking
title_zh: 信用卡银行业

abstract: Navigating the tax system often requires information and judgment that taxpayers may lack. Although taxpayers sometimes rely on human experts, AI could provide comparable assistance at substantially lower cost. Yet there is no causal evidence on how taxpayers use AI tax agents or how these tools affect their behavior. We fill this gap with a field experiment in the context of property tax appeals. We recruited a sample of 645 households in Dallas County, Texas. All households received access to a website providing personalized information, filing instructions, and supporting evidence for an appeal. Half were randomly assigned to a version of the website that also included an AI chatbot capable of answering questions and providing guidance tailored to their circumstances. Chatbot take-up was high: 78% initiated a conversation. Access to the chatbot increased the probability of filing an appeal without a human agent by 9.1 pp, from 41.4% to 50.5%. Evidence from clickstream data and conversation transcripts suggests that the chatbot helped households exercise judgment—that is, evaluate and act on the available information. The increase in appeal filing was smaller among less-advantaged households, providing suggestive evidence that the chatbot widened existing disparities. Our results demonstrate the potential of AI tax assistance while highlighting that who benefits depends not only on access, but also on how taxpayers use the technology.
abstract_zh: 应对税务系统往往需要纳税人可能缺乏的信息和判断力。尽管纳税人有时依赖人类专家，但人工智能或许能以显著更低的成本提供类似的协助。然而，关于纳税人如何使用人工智能税务代理或这些工具如何影响其行为，尚无因果证据。我们通过在房产税上诉背景下的实地实验填补了这一空白。我们招募了德克萨斯州达拉斯县645户家庭作为样本。所有家庭均可访问一个提供个性化信息、申请指南及支持证据的网站。其中一半家庭被随机分配至包含人工智能聊天机器人的网站版本，该机器人能够回答提问并提供针对其具体情况定制的指导。聊天机器人的使用率很高：78%的家庭发起了对话。使用聊天机器人使无人工代理提交上诉的概率提高了9.1个百分点，从41.4%升至50.5%。点击流数据和对话记录的证据表明，聊天机器人帮助家庭行使判断力——即评估并利用现有信息。在条件较不利的家庭中，上诉提交的增加幅度较小，这为聊天机器人扩大了现有差距提供了提示性证据。我们的结果展示了人工智能税务协助的潜力，同时强调受益者不仅取决于获取途径，还取决于纳税人如何使用该技术。
title: Taxpayer Behavior in the Age of AI: A Field Experiment on Property Tax Appeals
title_zh: 人工智能时代的纳税人行为：房产税申诉的实地实验

abstract: U.S. tariff rates in 2025 rose to levels not seen since the Great Depression, yet imports increased. To account for the missing trade collapse, we develop an open-economy New Keynesian model with tariff heterogeneity, inventories, and shocks to investment that capture the AI-driven boom. The model matches the untargeted paths of imports, output, and inflation; we use it to decompose the effects of tariffs and the investment boom. Absent the investment boom, imports would have fallen by 10 percent and activity would have contracted by 0.7 percent. The effects of tariffs depend on which goods are tariffed: tariffs on consumption and intermediates act like shocks to supply; tariffs on capital goods act like shocks to demand. The concentration of the 2025 tariff increases on consumption goods and the relative sparing of capital goods limited the damage to output while amplifying the inflationary impulse.
abstract_zh: 2025年美国的关税税率升至大萧条以来未见的高位，然而进口却有所增加。为解释这一缺失的贸易崩溃现象，我们构建了一个包含关税异质性、库存以及捕捉人工智能驱动繁荣的投资冲击的开放经济新凯恩斯主义模型。该模型与进口、产出和通胀的非目标路径相吻合；我们利用它来分解关税与投资繁荣的影响。若无投资繁荣，进口本将下降10%，经济活动本将收缩0.7%。关税的影响取决于被征税的商品种类：对消费品和中间品征收关税类似于供给冲击；对资本品征收关税则类似于需求冲击。2025年关税上调集中于消费品，而对资本品相对宽松，这一结构限制了对产出的损害，同时放大了通胀压力。
china_relevance_reason: 论文研究美国关税与进口现象，数据与制度背景均为美国，未涉及中国。
title: Tariffs, Investment, and the Missing Trade Collapse
title_zh: 关税、投资与贸易崩溃之谜

abstract: I study the optimal design and analysis of randomized experiments for estimating finite-population average treatment effects when potential outcomes are known to be bounded, as with binary outcomes. Among all assignment mechanisms and a broad class of affine estimators, worst-case mean-squared error (MSE) is minimized by independent random assignment and an unconventional regression of the support-midpoint-centered outcome on the recentered treatment, with no intercept. This contrasts with the usual prescription of balanced complete randomization and difference-in-means estimation: when outcomes are bounded, randomness in the realized treatment share is informative. The worst-case gain over full-sample complete randomization is asymptotically small, but gains can be first-order relative to other designs: complete within-pair randomization and pair-fixed-effect regression have twice the worst-case MSE. I then consider the general problem, allowing for any measurable estimator. Independent random assignment remains optimal, and the generally-nonlinear optimal estimator can meaningfully reduce worst-case MSE.
abstract_zh: 我研究了在潜在结果已知有界（如二元结果）的情况下，估计有限总体平均处理效应的随机实验的最优设计与分析。在所有分配机制和一类广泛的仿射估计量中，最坏情况均方误差（MSE）通过独立随机分配和对以支持中点为中心的结果对重新中心化处理的非常规回归（无截距项）达到最小。这与通常推荐的平衡完全随机化和均值差估计形成对比：当结果有界时，实现处理份额中的随机性具有信息量。相对于全样本完全随机化，最坏情况下的增益渐近地很小，但相对于其他设计，增益可能是一阶的：完全配对随机化和配对固定效应回归的最坏情况MSE是其两倍。随后，我考虑了一般问题，允许任何可测估计量。独立随机分配仍然是最优的，而一般非线性的最优估计量可以显著降低最坏情况MSE。
title: Optimal Experimental Design and Estimation when Potential Outcomes are Bounded
title_zh: 当潜在结果有界时的最优实验设计与估计

abstract: We provide the first direct estimates of the effects of minimum wages on low-wage workers in families at different points of the distribution of income-to-needs, using data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation, which oversamples low-income families. We find adverse – rather than beneficial – effects of minimum wages on the employment, hours, and earnings of initially-employed low-wage workers in poor and low-income families. Although we do not find a gradient indicating more adverse effects on the poorest low-wage workers, the adverse effects for poor and low-income low-wage workers help explain why minimum wages do not reduce poverty.
abstract_zh: 我们利用收入与项目参与调查数据（该调查对低收入家庭进行了过度抽样），首次直接估算了最低工资对处于收入-需求比分布不同位置的家庭中低工资工人的影响。研究发现，最低工资对贫困及低收入家庭中初始就业的低工资工人的就业、工作时间和收入产生了不利影响，而非有益影响。尽管我们未发现梯度表明对最贫困的低工资工人影响更为不利，但最低工资对贫困和低收入低工资工人的不利影响有助于解释为何最低工资并未减少贫困。
title: Do Minimum Wages Help Worker in Poor and Low-Income Families?
title_zh: 最低工资是否有助于贫困和低收入家庭中的工人？

abstract: We provide evidence of fraudulent diagnostic misreporting leading to spending on unnecessary medical care and show that it is strongly associated with provider profit motivation and weak prosocial preferences. Using incognito standardized patients (SP) presenting identical acute malaria symptoms as real walk-in clients to private providers in Kenya, we observe diagnostic and treatment decisions under controlled conditions with externally verified disease status. Because the SPs were confirmed to be malaria-negative, any reported positive diagnosis is a false positive by construction. Providers ordered malaria tests in 81% of the SP encounters.
