Conditional on administering a malaria test, providers report false positive results in 30% of encounters, substantially exceeding the approximately 3-5% false positive rates reported for the same malaria tests in diagnostic accuracy studies. This occurs despite near-perfect knowledge of appropriate diagnostic protocols. We link this behavior to provider preferences measured using a real-stakes, modified dictator game. While ordering a test is uncorrelated with preferences, the top 25% most profit-motivated providers report 16 percentage point (pp) more false positives and sell 20 pp more antimalarial drugs than more altruistic providers, conditional on ordering a malaria test. Misreporting is accompanied by selective concealment of diagnostic evidence from patients.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于欺诈性诊断误报导致不必要医疗支出增加的证据，并表明这种行为与提供者的利润动机及较弱的社会偏好密切相关。通过使用隐姓埋名的标准化病人（SP），他们以真实就诊客户的身份向肯尼亚的私人医疗服务提供者呈现相同的急性疟疾症状，我们在外部验证疾病状态的受控条件下观察诊断和治疗决策。由于这些SP被确认为疟疾阴性，任何报告的阳性诊断在构造上即为假阳性。提供者在81%的SP就诊中要求进行疟疾检测。在实施疟疾检测的条件下，提供者在30%的就诊中报告了假阳性结果，这一比例显著超过了同一疟疾检测在诊断准确性研究中报告的约3-5%的假阳性率。尽管提供者对适当诊断方案近乎完全了解，这种情况仍然发生。我们将这一行为与通过真实赌注的改良独裁者游戏测得的提供者偏好联系起来。虽然要求检测与偏好无关，但在要求疟疾检测的条件下，利润动机最强的前25%提供者报告的假阳性率比更利他的提供者高出16个百分点（pp），并多销售20个百分点的抗疟药物。误报行为伴随着对患者选择性隐瞒诊断证据。
title: Provider Altruism and Medical Fraud: Evidence from an Audit Study of Malaria Treatment
title_zh: 提供者利他主义与医疗欺诈：来自疟疾治疗审计研究的证据

abstract: We use randomized pay experiments among Uber drivers, paired with a natural experiment in access to a competitor, to examine how outside options shape labor supply to the firm. When hours are flexible, the firm-specific labor supply elasticity combines a market-hours component and a firm-substitution component. Access to a single competing platform nearly doubles drivers’ firm-specific elasticity and cuts the implied monopsony markdown from 68% to about 50%. The same experiments identify sex differences: women are about twice as elastic to the market as men, yet no less elastic to their employer.
abstract_zh: 我们利用优步司机中的随机薪酬实验，结合进入竞争对手的自然实验，探讨外部选择如何影响对企业的劳动力供给。在工时灵活的情况下，企业特定的劳动力供给弹性结合了市场工时成分和企业替代成分。接入单一竞争平台几乎使司机的企业特定弹性翻倍，并将隐含的买方垄断压价从68%降至约50%。同样的实验揭示了性别差异：女性对市场的弹性约为男性的两倍，但对雇主的弹性并不低于男性。
title: Outside Options and Labor Supply: Evidence from the Gig Economy
title_zh: 外部选择与劳动力供给：来自零工经济的证据

abstract: We study voluntary disclosure when partially naive receivers observe a public signal correlated with the sender’s private information. We develop a framework in which the public signal changes how receivers interpret silence, and derive a closed-form disclosure threshold nesting classical unraveling. A laboratory experiment varying the correlation confirms our predictions: disclosure decreases as the signal becomes more favorable, and receiver guesses upon nondisclosure rise toward it. The public signal can crowd out disclosure, leaving receivers less informed than without it. This informational loss peaks at intermediate correlation, where the signal shifts beliefs yet remains too noisy to substitute for disclosure.
abstract_zh: 我们研究当部分天真的接收者观察到与发送者私人信息相关的公开信号时的自愿披露行为。我们构建了一个框架，其中公开信号改变了接收者对沉默的解读方式，并推导出一个嵌套经典“拆解”结果的闭式披露阈值。一项改变相关性的实验室实验证实了我们的预测：随着信号变得更为有利，披露减少，而接收者在未披露情况下的猜测则向该信号靠拢。公开信号可能挤出披露，使接收者比没有该信号时信息更少。这种信息损失在中等相关性时达到峰值，此时信号虽能改变信念，但仍过于嘈杂，无法替代披露。
title: When Public Signals Backfire: Strategic Disclosure and Information Crowd-Out
title_zh: 当公共信号适得其反：策略性披露与信息挤出效应

abstract: We use a sample of administrative payroll data covering a large and nationally representative share of U.S. workers to study how wages adjusted during the recent inflation period. Most firms apply a single modal annual nominal wage increase to the majority of their workers, and these firm-level norms changed little during the recent period of unexpected inflation. As a result, nominal wages did not keep pace with prices for a large share of workers who stayed at their firms. Forty-three percent of workers continuously employed at the same firm over the four years spanning 2021–2024 experienced a real wage decline, with a mean loss of roughly nine percent among those who fell behind. Workers could escape sticky wage norms by changing employers — job-changers’ wages rose nearly one-for-one with inflation — but switching was too infrequent to matter for most. Even accounting for job-changers, 37 percent of all workers saw real wages decline over the 4-year period. Indexing firms’ modal raises one-for-one to inflation would have closed roughly 40 percent of the resulting shortfall relative to prepandemic trend. Drawing on cross-country evidence from Belgium, whose wages are automatically indexed to inflation, we show that incomplete wage indexation, rather than inflation itself, helps explain the persistence of depressed consumer sentiment during the 2021–2024 period.
abstract_zh: 我们利用覆盖美国工人中具有全国代表性的大样本行政工资数据，研究了近期通胀期间工资如何调整。大多数企业对其大部分员工实行单一的年度名义工资增长模式，而这些企业层面的规范在近期意外通胀期间变化甚微。因此，对于许多留在原企业的员工而言，名义工资未能跟上物价上涨的步伐。在2021年至2024年间连续在同一企业工作的员工中，有43%经历了实际工资下降，其中落后者的平均损失约为9%。员工可以通过更换雇主来规避僵化的工资规范——跳槽者的工资几乎与通胀同步上涨——但跳槽频率过低，对大多数人影响有限。即便将跳槽者考虑在内，仍有37%的全体员工在四年期间实际工资下降。若将企业的典型加薪幅度与通胀率一对一挂钩，则可弥补相对于疫情前趋势约40%的缺口。借鉴比利时（其工资自动与通胀挂钩）的跨国证据，我们表明，不完全的工资指数化，而非通胀本身，有助于解释2021-2024年间消费者情绪持续低迷的现象。
title: Sticky Wage Norms and the Real Wage Cost of Unexpected Inflation
title_zh: 粘性工资规范与意外通胀的实际工资成本

abstract: Electoral maps translate residential geography into political representation, yet they have never been systematically measured for thousands of local governments across the country. We reconstruct 3,712 city council and county commission maps across 18,521 districts using nationwide voter-file and Census data. Enacted maps overrepresent White voters and underrepresent Black and Hispanic voters, with gaps predicting the racial composition of officeholders. We juxtapose these with simulated, race-blind maps satisfying common districting constraints. Simulated maps reproduce much of this disparity, showing that geography skews representation before any boundary-drawing. Enacted maps substantially improve on the race-blind baseline only in jurisdictions subject to oversight from the Voting Rights Act or districting litigation. As courts curtail race-conscious districting, local governments may revert to a baseline that is formally neutral but substantively unequal.
abstract_zh: 选举地图将居住地理转化为政治代表权，然而，在全国数千个地方政府中，这些地图从未被系统性地衡量过。我们利用全国选民档案和人口普查数据，重建了覆盖18,521个选区的3,712个市议会和县委员会地图。已实施的地图过度代表了白人选民，而低估了黑人和西班牙裔选民，这些差距预示着公职人员的种族构成。我们将这些地图与满足常见选区划分约束的模拟、种族盲视地图进行对比。模拟地图再现了大部分这种差异，表明在任何边界划定之前，地理就已经扭曲了代表权。只有在受《投票权法案》或选区划分诉讼监督的司法管辖区，已实施的地图才显著优于种族盲视基线。随着法院限制种族意识选区划分，地方政府可能回归到一种形式上中立但实质上不平等的基线状态。
title: Race and Redistricting in Local Governments
title_zh: 地方政府中的种族与选区划分

abstract: We explore the efficacy of an online after-school tutoring program that complements teacher-provided computer-assisted learning practice. The aim is to scaffold students struggling with online Khan Academy practice at school with low-cost, one-on-one virtual supervision for about an hour a week at home. In a two-year randomized trial with the Toronto District School Board, teachers identified struggling Grade 4–8 students, whose parents were then randomly offered additional online tutoring to support their practice at home. The main obstacle was participation. Only 45% of assigned students reached a first session in Year 1. After we reframed the invitation and simplified enrollment, initial take-up in Year 2 rose to 83%, though weekly attendance remained below half—not because students dropped out, but because they attended intermittently. On average, the offer raised Khan Academy practice by about 10 minutes per week. This translated to an average gain in math assessment scores of 0.06 SD, with a confidence interval too wide to rule out null or medium-sized gains (ITT 0.055 SD; 95% CI [−0.09, 0.20]). We find a marginally significant gain in math report-card marks (about 0.08 SD; 95% CI [−0.01, 0.17]) and improvements in math satisfaction and enjoyment, with effects larger in Year 2 than in Year 1, consistent with the higher take-up that year. We therefore conclude that the program holds promise, but more is needed to ensure students actually engage with tutors on a regular basis.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了一项在线课后辅导项目的有效性，该项目补充了教师提供的计算机辅助学习练习。其目标是为在校内进行可汗学院在线练习时遇到困难的学生，提供每周约一小时、低成本的一对一虚拟监督，以支持他们在家的学习。在与多伦多地区教育局进行的一项为期两年的随机试验中，教师识别出4至8年级中学习困难的学生，随后随机向这些学生的家长提供额外的在线辅导，以支持他们在家的练习。主要障碍在于参与度。第一年，仅有45%被分配的学生参加了首次辅导。在重新调整邀请方式并简化注册流程后，第二年的初始参与率上升至83%，但每周出勤率仍低于一半——这并非因为学生退出，而是因为他们间歇性参与。平均而言，该辅导提议使可汗学院练习时间每周增加了约10分钟。这转化为数学评估成绩平均提高0.06个标准差，但置信区间过宽，无法排除零效应或中等效应（意向治疗分析效应为0.055个标准差；95%置信区间[-0.09, 0.20]）。我们发现数学成绩单分数有边际显著提高（约0.08个标准差；95%置信区间[-0.01, 0.17]），以及数学满意度和享受度的改善，且第二年的效应大于第一年，这与当年更高的参与率一致。因此，我们得出结论，该项目具有潜力，但还需更多努力以确保学生定期与辅导教师互动。
title: Virtual Tutoring with Computer-Assisted Learning: An Experiment in Take-Up and Learning
title_zh: 计算机辅助学习下的虚拟辅导：一项关于参与度与学习效果的实验

abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can make tutoring more scalable, but only if students use them to reason through mistakes rather than avoid effort. We study this question in a randomized field experiment with more than 6, 000 middle-school students in Hamilton County Schools using NUMI, a research-based computer-assisted learning (CAL) platform. Students were randomized to AI versus CAL-only support, mastery versus non-mastery progression, and one of two math topics. One week later, they completed a delayed assessment covering practiced and unpracticed material. AI students progressed more slowly and attempted fewer questions, but answered more accurately conditional on reaching an attempt. The clearest mechanism appeared after mistakes: AI improved next-attempt correctness and reduced attempts needed to return to a correct answer, while increasing time spent on each question receiving structured support. Mastery increased three-correct-in-a-row attainment but did not by itself improve delayed learning. The most encouraging delayed-test evidence appears when AI is embedded in the mastery workflow, with marginally significant gains concentrated on practiced Exercise 1 material. The results suggest that LLM tutoring can add value over standard CAL, but its value depends on structure that turns mistakes into productive learning moments.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够使辅导更具可扩展性，但前提是学生利用它们来推理错误，而非逃避学习努力。我们通过一项随机实地实验来研究这一问题，实验对象为汉密尔顿县学区超过6000名中学生，使用的是基于研究的计算机辅助学习（CAL）平台NUMI。学生被随机分配到AI辅助与仅CAL支持、掌握进度与非掌握进度，以及两个数学主题之一。一周后，他们完成了一项延迟评估，涵盖已练习和未练习的材料。AI组学生进度较慢，尝试的问题数量较少，但在达到尝试时回答的准确率更高。最明显的机制出现在犯错之后：AI提高了下一次尝试的正确率，并减少了回到正确答案所需的尝试次数，同时增加了在每道题上花费的时间，并获得了结构化支持。掌握进度提高了连续三次答对的达成率，但本身并未改善延迟学习效果。最令人鼓舞的延迟测试证据出现在AI嵌入掌握工作流程时，边际显著性的提升主要集中在已练习的练习1材料上。结果表明，LLM辅导能在标准CAL基础上增加价值，但其价值依赖于将错误转化为有效学习时刻的结构。
title: Making AI Tutoring Productive: Evidence from a Mastery-Based Math Practice Experiment
title_zh: 让AI辅导更具成效：基于精熟学习的数学练习实验证据

abstract: Generative AI has been promoted as the technology that could transform education by providing every student a personal tutor. We provide some of the first large-scale experimental evidence, from a two-year cluster randomized trial in 18 Tennessee middle schools in which randomly assigned students used Khan Academy with its AI tutor, Khanmigo, configured to coach rather than give answers, during existing daily remedial mathematics sessions. Assignment raises math achievement by 1.3 national percentile ranks per term, or about 0.06 to 0.08 standard deviations over a school year; the implied effect of a full year of active participation reaches 0.14 standard deviations. These gains resemble those from Khan Academy practice without AI assistance. One explanation is that students used the tutor infrequently and, when they did, rarely engaged it in substantive mathematical dialogue: 96 percent of students tried Khanmigo at least once, but the median student messaged it on only a third of the days they practiced, and in only 17 percent of the exercise sessions in which they made a mistake. Messages that students did send were mostly bare answers or clicks on suggested prompts. The binding constraint appears to be engagement: realizing the promise of AI tutoring will require getting students to use it, not just giving them access.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能被推崇为一项能够通过为每位学生提供个性化导师来变革教育的科技。我们提供了首批大规模实验证据之一，来自一项为期两年的整群随机试验，在田纳西州18所中学进行，随机分配的学生在现有的每日补救性数学课程中使用可汗学院及其AI导师Khanmigo，该导师被配置为引导而非直接给出答案。分配使用使数学成绩每学期提升1.3个全国百分位排名，或相当于一学年内约0.06至0.08个标准差；全年积极参与的隐含效应达到0.14个标准差。这些收益与无AI辅助的可汗学院练习效果相似。一个解释是，学生使用该导师的频率较低，且即便使用，也很少进行实质性的数学对话：96%的学生至少尝试过Khanmigo，但中位数学生在练习日仅有三分之一的天数向其发送信息，且在犯错时的练习环节中，仅17%的环节进行了互动。学生发送的信息大多为直接答案或点击建议提示。制约因素似乎是参与度：实现AI辅导的潜力需要让学生真正使用它，而不仅仅是提供访问机会。
title: One Click Away: AI Tutoring with Khanmigo in a Two-Year School Experiment
title_zh: 一键之遥：Khanmigo人工智能辅导在两年制学校实验中的应用

abstract: Involvement with the child welfare system varies dramatically across places. While some of this variation may reflect differences in underlying maltreatment risk, it may also result from differences in institutional responses to similar circumstances. To disentangle these explanations, we study Michigan public school data linked to Child Protective Services reports from 2017–2024. School-level reporting rates range from virtually none to more than half of students reported between kindergarten and fifth grade. We estimate school-specific reporting tendencies using value-added methods and document substantial variation in reporting behavior after accounting for differences in student risk. Using student movers, we show that these estimates are forecast-unbiased. Our estimates imply that school-specific reporting practices account for roughly 40 percent of the variation in reporting rates across schools. We then estimate a structural model that decomposes reporting practices into diagnostic skill and preferences. Differences in skill explain more than twice as much variation as differences in preferences, and higher-reporting schools tend to be more skilled at identifying high-risk cases. Counterfactual simulations imply that improving detection skill would yield significant welfare gains, while recent policy proposals aimed at reducing or equalizing reporting rates generally lower welfare by increasing the number of high-risk cases that go unreported.
abstract_zh: 儿童福利系统介入率在不同地区间存在显著差异。部分差异可能反映了潜在虐待风险的差异，但也可能源于机构对相似情境应对方式的不同。为厘清这些解释，我们研究了2017至2024年间密歇根州公立学校数据，并将其与儿童保护服务报告相关联。学校层面的报告率从几乎为零到幼儿园至五年级期间超过半数学生被报告不等。我们运用增值法估计学校特定的报告倾向，并在控制学生风险差异后，记录了报告行为的显著变异。利用学生流动样本，我们证明这些估计具有预测无偏性。我们的估计表明，学校特定报告实践约解释了学校间报告率变异的40%。随后，我们估计了一个结构模型，将报告实践分解为诊断技能与偏好。技能差异所解释的变异是偏好差异的两倍以上，且报告率较高的学校往往更擅长识别高风险案例。反事实模拟显示，提升检测技能将带来显著的福利改善，而近期旨在降低或均等化报告率的政策提案，则通常因增加高风险案例未被报告的数量而降低福利。
title: Institutional Variation in Child Maltreatment Reporting
title_zh: 机构差异对儿童虐待举报的影响

abstract: This study deploys a multi-region, dynamic life-cycle, general equilibrium model to assess demography’s impact, through the course of this century, on global development. Our model’s 17 regions encompass more than 150 countries comprising 99% of the world’s population. Output is produced with three labor skill groups and internationally-mobile capital, with each country deciding annually whether to adopt its frontier automation technology. Our model features region-specific fiscal policy, TFP growth, and idiosyncratic mortality. Agents live for 100 years, first as children, then as workers, and then as retirees. Work and saving decisions are governed by CES preferences. Lifespan is uncertain, but there are no annuities apart from state pensions. Hence, bequests, while significant, are unintended. Our fertility, mortality, and net immigration rates are region- and age-specific and align fully with the UN’s projections. To illustrate demographics’ power to impact the global transition, we simulate our model under the UN’s markedly different demographic projections for 2017 and 2024. The 2024 forecast is particularly pessimistic about China’s fertility prospects. Both projections produce very substantial global aging, a major global capital glut producing very low long-run real capital returns. The latest forecast entails 10% lower global GDP in 2100 and far higher payroll tax rates to fund old-age benefits. Most important, it entails a major change in the course of economic hegemony with China’s 2100 global GDP share falling from 25.6% to 14.9% and the US share rising from 11.2% to 14.4%. Our results are sensitive. Should the US eliminate all future immigration, its 14.4% global 2100 GDP share would drop to 9.2%. And were global fertility to follow the UN’s low variant, 2100 world output would be one third, not one tenth lower. The level and division of global output is also highly sensitive to the speed at which AI expands frontier technologies. Accelerated AU/AI – 4x faster-than-recent growth in capital’s share through 2050 – or Transformative AU/AI – 10x faster capital-share growth – reinforce demographic forces, ensuring long-run US economic hegemony. Indeed, Transformative AI combined with 2024 demographics implies US and Chinese 2100 global GDP shares of 25.3% and 16.9%, respectively. And not withstanding its considerable technological catch up, the US retains, based on our calibration, a technological edge over China throughout the century.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用一个多区域、动态生命周期、一般均衡模型，评估本世纪人口因素对全球发展的影响。模型涵盖17个区域，包含150多个国家，占全球人口的99%。产出由三种劳动技能组和国际流动资本共同生产，每个国家每年决定是否采纳其前沿自动化技术。模型特点包括区域特定的财政政策、全要素生产率增长及特殊死亡率。个体寿命长达100年，先为儿童，后为劳动者，再为退休者。工作与储蓄决策受CES偏好支配。寿命存在不确定性，除国家养老金外无年金产品，因此遗赠虽显著，却属非预期。生育率、死亡率及净移民率均按区域和年龄划分，与联合国的预测完全一致。为展示人口对全球转型的影响力，我们依据联合国2017年和2024年显著不同的人口预测进行模拟。2024年的预测对中国生育前景尤为悲观。两种预测均导致全球严重老龄化，产生大量全球资本过剩，长期实际资本回报率极低。最新预测显示，2100年全球GDP将下降10%，为资助老年福利，工资税率将大幅提高。最重要的是，这预示着经济霸权格局的重大转变，中国2100年全球GDP份额将从25.6%降至14.9%，而美国份额将从11.2%升至14.4%。我们的结果具有敏感性。若美国完全停止未来移民，其2100年全球GDP份额将从14.4%降至9.2%。若全球生育率遵循联合国的低方案，2100年世界产出将减少三分之一，而非十分之一。全球产出的水平与分配对AI扩展前沿技术的速度也高度敏感。加速AI/自动化——至2050年资本份额增长速度为近年来的4倍——或变革性AI/自动化——资本份额增长速度快10倍——将强化人口力量，确保美国长期经济霸权。实际上，变革性AI结合2024年人口预测，意味着美国和中国2100年全球GDP份额分别为25.3%和16.9%。尽管美国在技术追赶方面有显著进展，但根据我们的校准，整个世纪美国对中国的技术优势依然存在。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The Global Transition – The Impact of Demographics and AI on Economic Power
title_zh: 全球转型——人口结构与人工智能对经济实力的影响

abstract: Following the global financial crisis (GFC), regulators made it harder for banks to retain leveraged loan exposure. We conjecture their actions increased the share of leveraged loan issuances with no maintenance covenants (cov-lite loans) because such loans are easier to sell. We find that, post-GFC, the share of cov-lite loan issuance increased more for banks facing stricter regulation, failing to pass a stress test outright, or exhibiting greater vulnerability to the severely adverse stress test scenario. We show that, as expected from theory, cov-lite loans have a liquidity advantage that lowers their credit spread and is higher for private firms.
abstract_zh: 全球金融危机后，监管机构加大了银行保留杠杆贷款敞口的难度。我们推测，这些举措提高了无维持条款（cov-lite）杠杆贷款发行的比例，因为此类贷款更易于出售。我们发现，危机后，面对更严格监管、未能直接通过压力测试或对严重不利压力测试情景表现出更大脆弱性的银行，其cov-lite贷款发行份额增长更为显著。我们证明，正如理论预期，cov-lite贷款具有流动性优势，这降低了其信用利差，且对私营企业而言这一优势更为明显。
title: The Cov-lite Liquidity Advantage, Regulatory Pressures, and the Evolution of the Leveraged Loan Market
title_zh: 宽松流动性优势、监管压力与杠杆贷款市场的演变

abstract: Gender disparities in becoming a CEO are pronounced, and women who become CEOs, especially of large firms, are less likely to have children or be married. We study the effects of children and marriage on becoming a CEO, using longitudinal administrative data covering the universe of tax-registered firms in Costa Rica, matched to universal civil registry records that provide the timing of childbirth and marriage. We find that first childbirth is followed by a persistent decline in women’s probability of becoming a CEO, but no comparable decline for men and some evidence that CEO attainment rises. Marriage displays a different but still divergent pattern: it is associated with higher subsequent CEO attainment for men, but little change for women. Changes around childbirth account for a substantial share of the overall gender difference in CEO rates. Finally, we find evidence consistent with household specialization as a potential mechanism. Around marriage and first childbirth, women’s formal employment, earnings, and share of household earnings decline, while men become more central to household earnings as their partners reduce formal employment.
abstract_zh: 成为CEO的性别差异显著，且成为CEO的女性，尤其是大型企业的女性CEO，更不可能有子女或已婚。我们利用覆盖哥斯达黎加所有税务注册企业的纵向行政数据，并与提供生育和婚姻时间的全民民事登记记录相匹配，研究了子女和婚姻对成为CEO的影响。我们发现，首次生育后，女性成为CEO的概率持续下降，但男性没有类似的下降，且有证据表明男性成为CEO的可能性反而上升。婚姻呈现出不同但仍存在差异的模式：它与男性后续成为CEO的概率提高相关，但对女性几乎没有变化。生育带来的变化在CEO性别差异总体中占据了相当大的份额。最后，我们发现了与家庭专业化作为潜在机制相一致的证据。在婚姻和首次生育前后，女性的正规就业、收入及家庭收入占比下降，而随着伴侣减少正规就业，男性在家庭收入中的核心地位增强。
title: Do Children Derail Women from the CEO Track?
title_zh: 儿童是否会让女性偏离CEO职业轨道？

abstract: Recent applied work has used interacted local projections to study how the propagation of macroeconomic shocks changes with the policy regime. We characterize the estimand of such strategies and relate it to the policy shock literature. Our main result is a set of conditions on the regressors and underlying data-generating process under which those two approaches are equivalent in the nature of their estimand, with both identifying slices of the same space of policy dynamic causal effects. Since policy is inherently high-dimensional, however, the two approaches generically recover different slices of that space. For example, for monetary policy, standard shocks tend to deliver the effects of transitory policy rate changes, while looking across policy regimes instead isolates gradual, more forward guidance-like policy treatments.
abstract_zh: 近期应用研究采用交互局部投影法，探讨宏观经济冲击的传导如何随政策体制变化。我们刻画了此类策略的估计目标，并将其与政策冲击文献相联系。我们的主要结果是一组关于回归变量及底层数据生成过程的条件，在这些条件下，两种方法在估计目标性质上等价，均识别出同一政策动态因果效应空间中的切片。然而，由于政策本质上具有高维性，这两种方法通常恢复该空间的不同切片。例如，就货币政策而言，标准冲击往往传递出临时性政策利率变动的效应，而跨政策体制的考察则隔离出渐进式、更偏向前瞻指引的政策处理。
title: Identifying Policy Causal Effects from Rule Changes
title_zh: 从规则变化中识别政策因果效应

abstract: We study long-run career consequences of initial employment in an occupation that subsequently declines. Linking the 2000 Decennial Census to US administrative employment and earnings records through 2020, we follow more than 2.4 million workers. Employment in an occupation that contracts by at least 25 percent is associated with about 5 percent lower cumulative earnings despite slightly more quarters worked. The earnings differential closely matches evidence from Sweden and Norway, although employment adjustment differs. Occupational mobility is substantial but incomplete, while children’s later occupational destinations are much less tied to their household heads’ 2000 occupational-growth categories.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了初始就业于随后衰退的职业对长期职业生涯后果的影响。通过将2000年十年人口普查与美国行政就业及收入记录关联至2020年，我们追踪了超过240万名工人。在收缩至少25%的职业中就业，尽管工作季度数略多，但与累计收入降低约5%相关。这一收入差异与瑞典和挪威的证据高度吻合，尽管就业调整方式有所不同。职业流动性显著但不完全，而子女后来的职业去向与户主2000年职业增长类别的关联则大为减弱。
title: Declining Occupations and Career Outcomes in the United States
title_zh: 美国衰退职业与职业结果

abstract: Ten states implemented Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Food Restriction Waivers to restrict purchases of sugary beverages with SNAP funds for the first time in program history in 2026. We estimate the short-run impact of these waivers using a new panel dataset of household beverage purchases. For the average SNAP household, these waivers decrease soda purchases by 13 percent with persistent effects for up to two months after implementation. For inframarginal SNAP households, these waivers decrease soda purchases by 18.5 percent. These findings are inconsistent with the predictions of traditional demand theory and suggest that behavioral models incorporating mental accounting and labeling better characterize consumer responses to SNAP purchase restrictions.
abstract_zh: 2026年，十个州首次在补充营养援助计划（SNAP）历史上实施了食品限制豁免，以限制使用SNAP资金购买含糖饮料。我们利用一个新的家庭饮料购买面板数据集，评估了这些豁免的短期影响。对于平均SNAP家庭而言，这些豁免使苏打水购买量减少了13%，且效果在实施后持续长达两个月。对于边际内SNAP家庭，这些豁免使苏打水购买量减少了18.5%。这些发现与传统需求理论的预测不符，表明纳入心理账户和标签效应的行为模型更能刻画消费者对SNAP购买限制的反应。
title: Short-Run Impacts of SNAP Restriction Waivers on Beverage Purchases
title_zh: SNAP限制豁免对饮料购买的短期影响

abstract: What ultimately supports the market value of U.S. government debt? We measure valuation frameworks: the perceived channels that back debt value. We survey bond investors, registered voters, and economics or finance graduate-degree holders, asking them to allocate debt value across six sources derived from open-ended answers and the literature. Global safe-asset demand and permanent rollover together account for almost half of perceived value in every group, so debt value heavily relies on investor absorption rather than on government resources. Future primary surpluses, the textbook debt backing, receive about 16% even among the graduate-trained; roughly one-third say they provide little or no support. Allocations concentrate within respondents but disperse across them, forming belief archetypes that vary little with fiscal knowledge. A model shows why belief elicitation matters: identical debt quantities and price schedules can conceal differences in saleable public backing and stress-resilient demand, and therefore in debt sustainability. Concern about debt sustainability is widespread, and all three groups put the ten-year crisis odds near 50%. However, among respondents expressing concern, 90% of voters report that it is not decisive in their voting decisions, and 72% of investors report no concrete portfolio change.
abstract_zh: 最终支撑美国政府债务市场价值的是什么？我们衡量了估值框架：即支撑债务价值的感知渠道。我们调查了债券投资者、登记选民以及经济学或金融学研究生学历持有者，要求他们将债务价值分配至六个来源，这些来源源自开放式回答和文献。全球安全资产需求与永久性展期在每个群体中合计约占感知价值的一半，因此债务价值在很大程度上依赖于投资者的吸收能力，而非政府资源。未来基本盈余——教科书式的债务支撑——即使在受过研究生教育的群体中也仅获得约16%的权重；约三分之一的人表示其提供很少或没有支持。分配在受访者内部集中，但在受访者之间分散，形成了信念原型，这些原型随财政知识的变化甚微。一个模型揭示了为何信念引出至关重要：相同的债务数量和价格表可能掩盖可出售公共支撑和抗压力需求方面的差异，从而掩盖债务可持续性方面的差异。对债务可持续性的担忧普遍存在，且所有三个群体给出的十年危机概率均接近50%。然而，在表达担忧的受访者中，90%的选民表示这在其投票决策中并非决定性因素，72%的投资者表示未采取具体的投资组合调整。
title: Beliefs about Government Debt Valuation and Sustainability
title_zh: 关于政府债务估值与可持续性的信念

abstract: Elites maintain disproportionate political power even in formally inclusive political systems, yet the institutions through which they coordinate and reproduce this advantage remain poorly understood. We study membership in the Buenos Aires Jockey Club—Argentina's most prominent elite social club—exploiting staggered variation in family entry. Using difference-in-differences techniques, we find that Jockey Club membership increased the probability of holding legislative office by approximately four percentage points—more than twice the control-group mean. Consistent with a network-based mechanism, membership also increased families' centrality in elite marriage networks—a resource that can facilitate political success through access to party nominations and voter mobilization. This electoral advantage declines substantially after the 1912 Sáenz Peña democratizing reforms, suggesting that the political returns to club membership are conditional on institutional contexts that make elite network connections valuable. Our findings shed light on how elite social institutions reproduce political inequality where personal connections are essential for accessing political office.
abstract_zh: 精英即使在形式上包容的政治体系中，也维持着不成比例的政治权力，然而他们协调并再生产这一优势的制度机制仍鲜为人知。我们以阿根廷最显赫的精英社交俱乐部——布宜诺斯艾利斯赛马俱乐部为研究对象，利用家族入会时间的交错变化进行实证分析。通过双重差分方法，我们发现赛马俱乐部会员身份使担任立法职务的概率提高了约四个百分点，这一增幅超过对照组均值的两倍。与基于网络的机制相一致，会员身份还提升了家族在精英婚姻网络中的中心性——这一资源可通过获取政党提名和动员选民来促进政治成功。这种选举优势在1912年萨恩斯·佩尼亚民主化改革后显著减弱，表明俱乐部会员身份的政治回报取决于使精英网络联系具有价值的制度环境。我们的研究揭示了在个人关系对获取政治职位至关重要的情境下，精英社会制度如何再生产政治不平等。
title: Social Clubs and Political Office
title_zh: 社交俱乐部与政治职务

abstract: Theories of outsourcing often presume that private firms are more efficient producers of goods and services, but that contracting frictions mean that firms do not internalize the government's objective function. But perhaps, for some tasks, the government can actually be more productively efficient? We study this question through an experiment in Chennai, India, where the government randomly selected neighborhoods to have property tax assessments determined by private firms contracted by the government, rather than government tax inspectors. We show that inspections by government tax inspectors yielded almost double the increase in tax revenue as those done by private firms. They were also more accurate, as judged by comparing new assessments to independent assessments done by third-party surveyors we hired. Difficulties contracting with the government discouraged many competent firms from bidding. Perhaps as a result, government inspectors had higher skills and put in more effort than the workers at the private firms. Importantly, the government inspectors also had more authority to enter properties, which may be hard to transfer even to higher quality firms. The results suggest that the limits to government outsourcing may go beyond multitasking issues.
abstract_zh: 外包理论通常假定私营企业在商品和服务生产方面更具效率，但契约摩擦意味着企业并不内化政府的目标函数。然而，或许在某些任务上，政府实际上可能更具生产效率？我们通过在印度金奈进行的一项实验来研究这一问题，实验中政府随机选择社区，由政府签约的私营企业而非政府税务检查员来评估房产税。我们显示，政府税务检查员的检查所带来的税收增长几乎是私营企业的两倍。根据我们聘请的第三方调查员进行的独立评估比较，政府检查员的评估也更为准确。与政府签约的困难使许多有能力的公司不愿投标。或许正因如此，政府检查员比私营企业的工人拥有更高的技能并投入了更多努力。重要的是，政府检查员还拥有更多进入房产的权力，这种权力即使对更高质量的企业也可能难以转移。结果表明，政府外包的局限性可能超越多任务处理问题。
title: The Limits of Government Outsourcing: Property Tax Re-Assessments in India
title_zh: 政府外包的局限性：印度财产税重新评估

abstract: Macroeconomics tends to view exchange rate movements as transitory. However, persistent exchange rate realignments and the associated capital flows can have long-run implications for structural change and productivity growth. We provide empirical evidence that policies of reserve accumulation and currency undervaluation have had significant effects on manufacturing productivity, as well as on manufacturing share, product varieties, and domestic orientation of production chains. We develop a dynamic two-country model with two sectors, firm dynamics, and trade hysteresis to demonstrate a novel mechanism by which exchange rate policy reorients global supply chains and industrial structure. The model identifies conditions under which such a policy raises productivity and welfare in the home country. It also identifies conditions under which the policy leads to either permanent or reversible deindustrialization in a trading partner. Findings have implications for the long-run relationship between China and the U.S.
abstract_zh: 宏观经济学通常将汇率变动视为暂时性现象。然而，持续的汇率重估及其伴随的资本流动可能对结构变革和生产率增长产生长期影响。我们提供的经验证据表明，储备积累和货币低估政策对制造业生产率、制造业份额、产品种类及生产链的国内导向均产生了显著效应。我们构建了一个包含两个部门、企业动态和贸易滞后性的动态两国模型，以展示汇率政策如何重新引导全球供应链和产业结构的新机制。该模型识别了此类政策提升本国生产率和福利的条件，同时也明确了政策导致贸易伙伴国出现永久性或可逆性去工业化的条件。研究结果对中美之间的长期关系具有启示意义。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要明确提及研究结论对中美长期关系有启示，且研究主题涉及汇率政策、储备积累和制造业结构，与中国政策背景密切相关。
title: Exchange Rates, Structural Change, and Productivity Growth
title_zh: 汇率、结构变迁与生产率增长

abstract: The literature on imperfect competition in labor markets has expanded rapidly in recent years. This article provides a guide to the field, focusing on the firm-specific ("residual") labor supply elasticity as the definition of a firm's labor market power. We present a general framework showing how this elasticity nests the three widely studied sources of monopsony power: search frictions, preference heterogeneity, and employer concentration. We summarize the empirical estimates of the elasticity of labor supply, highlighting sources of possible heterogeneity. We emphasize that it is difficult to infer elasticities from markdowns (and vice versa) due to the diversity of firm wage-setting practices, illustrating this point using the interaction between monopsony and efficiency wages. We discuss how policy issues in antitrust, labor market regulation, immigration, and macroeconomics interact with monopsony and conclude by listing several areas for future research.
abstract_zh: 近年来，关于劳动力市场不完全竞争的文献迅速增多。本文为该领域提供了一份指南，重点将企业特定（“剩余”）劳动力供给弹性作为企业劳动力市场势力的定义。我们提出了一个一般性框架，展示这一弹性如何涵盖三种被广泛研究的买方垄断势力来源：搜索摩擦、偏好异质性和雇主集中度。我们总结了劳动力供给弹性的实证估计，强调了可能存在的异质性来源。我们指出，由于企业工资设定实践的多样性，从加价率推断弹性（反之亦然）较为困难，并通过买方垄断与效率工资之间的相互作用来说明这一点。我们讨论了反垄断、劳动力市场监管、移民和宏观经济学中的政策问题如何与买方垄断相互作用，并最后列出未来研究的几个领域。
title: Monopsony Makes it Big
title_zh: 买方垄断势力日益壮大

abstract: In this paper, we compare supplemental Medicare insurance coverage among people with probable dementia (PWPD) and matched controls, before and after onset. This retrospective secondary data analysis of insurance coverage changes using propensity score weights and the 2000-2016 Health and Retirement Study (HRS). The sample consists of 3,001 Medicare-enrolled adults age 65 and older with PWPD, and 14,055 controls. Probable dementia is assessed with the Langa-Weir approach and interviewer assessments for proxy interviews. Four years before onset, PWPD become more likely to have Medicare without supplemental coverage (2.97 percentage points; p=0.0016) than matched controls. This reflects the net effect of PWPD being less likely to have Medicare Advantage or traditional Medicare with supplemental coverage, and more likely to have Medicaid. Two years before onset, PWPD were more likely to be Medicaid-eligible (4.95 percentage points, p<0.001), but take-up rates were comparable. Enrollment assistance may improve supplemental coverage for PWPD around dementia onset, potentially increasing financial access to care.
abstract_zh: 本文对比了可能患有痴呆症（PWPD）人群与匹配对照组在发病前后补充医疗保险覆盖情况。本研究利用倾向性评分加权及2000-2016年健康与退休研究（HRS）数据，进行回顾性二次数据分析。样本包括3，001名65岁及以上已参保Medicare的PWPD成年人，以及14，055名对照组。可能痴呆症通过Langa-Weir方法及代理访谈中的访员评估进行判定。在发病前四年，PWPD相较于匹配对照组，更可能仅拥有Medicare而无补充保险（差异2.97个百分点；p=0.0016）。这反映了PWPD拥有Medicare Advantage或传统Medicare附带补充保险的可能性较低，而拥有Medicaid的可能性较高的净效应。发病前两年，PWPD符合Medicaid资格的可能性更高（差异4.95个百分点，p<0.001），但参保率相当。在痴呆症发病前后，注册援助可能改善PWPD的补充保险覆盖，从而可能增加其获得医疗服务的财务可及性。
title: Supplemental Medicare Insurance Coverage for Older Adults with Probable Dementia
title_zh: 老年人可能痴呆症补充医疗保险覆盖研究

abstract: How do biased beliefs about the interest rate distribution affect search, negotiation, and loan terms in consumer credit markets? In collaboration with Chile's financial regulator, we conducted a randomized controlled trial with 112,063 loan seekers. Randomly eliciting beliefs about interest rates led participants to search more and obtain lower rates. Most participants underestimated both interest rate levels and dispersion. Showing them a price comparison tool we built using administrative data on the universe of consumer loans caused them to update their beliefs, negotiate more, obtain lower rates without searching more, and be more likely to take out a loan.
abstract_zh: 关于利率分布的偏差信念如何影响消费信贷市场中的搜索、谈判及贷款条款？我们与智利金融监管机构合作，对112,063名贷款申请者进行了一项随机对照试验。随机引出对利率的信念促使参与者增加搜索并获取更低的利率。大多数参与者低估了利率水平和离散度。我们利用行政数据构建的价格比较工具，覆盖所有消费贷款，向参与者展示后，他们更新了信念，增加了谈判，无需更多搜索便获得了更低的利率，并且更有可能成功贷款。
title: Search and Negotiation with Biased Beliefs in Consumer Credit Markets
title_zh: 消费者信贷市场中的有偏信念与搜索谈判

abstract: Every SVAR result is conditional on two choices: the restrictions that identify the shock and the variables on which they operate. The literature disciplines the first; the second is chosen by hand. We develop a Bayesian methodology that constructs information sets, uses an out-of-sample criterion, and retains the largest system it admits. Under recursive identification, output rises with housing production rather than household credit alone. For monetary policy, an anchor-free joint Bayesian proxy SVAR with multiple instruments strengthens the credit spread channel. A core system augmented with the selected corporate spread identifies expected default risk as a potent transmission margin.
abstract_zh: 每一个SVAR结果都依赖于两个选择：识别冲击的约束条件及其作用变量。现有文献对前者进行了规范，而后者则靠人工选择。我们开发了一种贝叶斯方法，构建信息集，采用样本外准则，并保留其允许的最大系统。在递归识别下，产出随住房生产而非仅家庭信贷上升。对于货币政策，一个无锚点的联合贝叶斯代理SVAR，结合多种工具，强化了信用利差渠道。一个核心系统，辅以选定的企业利差，识别出预期违约风险作为有力的传导边际。
title: Algorithm-Driven SVARs: Navigating the Wilderness of Big Data
title_zh: 算法驱动的SVAR模型：大数据荒野中的导航

abstract: By age 17, a quarter of U.S. students have experienced a peer suicide. Using linked administrative data from South Carolina and a matched difference-in-differences design, we find that exposure to a peer's self-harm death increases the probability of a self-harm diagnosis by nearly 50% and both the incidence and frequency of mental health visits. Effects on care use and criminal behavior are concentrated among white boys, and responses diverge by prior mental health history: students without a prior diagnosis increase felony offending rather than care-seeking. Deaths from assault and transportation accidents produce no comparable rise in self-harm, consistent with contagion.
abstract_zh: 到17岁时，美国已有四分之一的学生经历过同伴自杀。利用南卡罗来纳州的关联行政数据及匹配的双重差分设计，我们发现，接触同伴自伤死亡事件会使自伤诊断的概率增加近50%，并提高心理健康就诊的发生率与频率。对医疗服务使用及犯罪行为的影响主要集中在白人男孩中，且反应因先前心理健康史而异：无先前诊断的学生更倾向于增加重罪犯罪而非寻求医疗服务。因袭击和交通事故导致的死亡并未引发类似的自伤增加，这与传染效应一致。
title: Teen Suicide and the Outcomes of Surviving Peers
title_zh: 青少年自杀与幸存同伴的结果

abstract: We use newly digitized records for 1.2 million students at 60 co-educational U.S. colleges, 1915–1943, linked to enrollment records for their children through 1963, to study how colleges shape marital matching and the intergenerational transmission of educational advantage. About 6% of men and 9% of women marry someone from their own college. This homogamy is largely causal: within colleges, more different-sex classmates and longer campus overlap both raise same-college marriage. Same-college spouses are more educated, and this advantage persists across generations. Children of same-college couples more often attend selective colleges, with spousal education explaining a third of the gap.
abstract_zh: 我们利用1915至1943年间美国60所男女合校大学120万名学生的全新数字化记录，并将其与截至1963年其子女的入学记录相链接，以研究大学如何塑造婚姻匹配及教育优势的代际传递。约6%的男性和9%的女性与本校校友结婚。这种同质性婚姻在很大程度上具有因果性：在校内，更多异性同学及更长的校园重叠时间均提高了同校婚姻的概率。同校配偶的教育程度更高，且这一优势在代际间持续存在。同校夫妇的子女更常进入精英大学，其中配偶教育水平解释了这一差距的三分之一。
title: Colleges, Assortative Mating, and Intergenerational Mobility in Twentieth-Century America
title_zh: 二十世纪美国的大学、同型婚配与代际流动

abstract: This paper examines the impact of the National Suicide Hotline Designation Act, which introduced the universal 988 calling code and earmarked federal funding to suicide crisis call centers in July 2022. We use a difference-in-differences design that leverages pre-existing cross-state variation in crisis line capacity gaps, measured by the number of pre-988 calls routed to a state but not answered in-state. The rollout substantially improved crisis line operations in states with larger baseline capacity gaps: these states answered more calls in-state and increased their in-state answer rates. However, these operational gains did not translate into detectable reductions in suicide mortality. The mortality estimates are precise enough to rule out even modest short-run reductions. We also find no statistically significant improvements in broader population mental health outcomes. These findings suggest that expanding crisis line capacity alone may be insufficient to reduce suicide deaths.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了《国家自杀热线指定法案》的影响，该法案于2022年7月引入了通用988呼叫代码，并专门拨款资助自杀危机呼叫中心。我们采用双重差分设计，利用各州在危机热线容量缺口方面的既有差异，该缺口以988实施前被路由至某州但未在该州接听的呼叫数量来衡量。该法案的推出显著改善了基线容量缺口较大州的危机热线运营状况：这些州接听了更多州内呼叫，并提高了州内接听率。然而，这些运营上的改善并未转化为可检测到的自杀死亡率下降。死亡率估计的精确度足以排除即使是温和的短期减少效应。我们还发现，在更广泛的人口心理健康结果方面，没有统计学上显著的改善。这些发现表明，仅扩大危机热线容量可能不足以减少自杀死亡人数。
title: The Impact of Suicide Hotlines on Health: Evidence from 988 Implementation
title_zh: 自杀热线对健康的影响：来自988实施的证据

abstract: The US Health and Retirement Study collects data on participants’ recall fluency (RF), their ability to recall words from a list, a standard measure of memory used by psychologists. Controlling for multiple demographic characteristics as well as IQ, people with a higher RF are more optimistic about stock returns, the price of their homes, and their life expectancy. We derive the predictions of a standard memory model and find that, consistent with them, the beliefs of higher RF people about each target domain are more sensitive to cues, to experiences in that domain, but also to irrelevant experiences in other domains, especially those similar to the target. These effects, in turn, carry to investment and retirement choices. RF emerges as an economically relevant personal trait.
abstract_zh: 美国健康与退休研究收集了参与者的回忆流畅度（RF）数据，即他们从列表中回忆单词的能力，这是心理学家使用的标准记忆测量指标。在控制多种人口统计学特征及智商后，RF较高的人对股票回报、房产价格及自身寿命预期更为乐观。我们推导了一个标准记忆模型的预测，并发现与这些预测一致，RF较高的人对每个目标领域的信念对线索、该领域的经历，乃至其他领域不相关经历（尤其是与目标相似的经历）更为敏感。这些效应进而传导至投资和退休决策。RF因此显现为一项具有经济意义的个人特质。
title: Recall Fluency, Beliefs and Behavior
title_zh: 记忆流畅性、信念与行为

abstract: How do we evaluate the welfare gains from transport infrastructure investment? We present a quantitative spatial framework that integrates traffic and economic responses to infrastructure improvements and derives the elasticity of aggregate welfare to changes in the transportation network. The resulting formula extends the traditional ``social savings'' method to incorporate route and mode choice, agglomeration and dispersion externalities, and traffic congestion. We apply the formula to the U.S. freight network and assess the benefits of reducing costs on each segment of the U.S. Interstate Highway System. The traditional and extended measures are closely related overall, but they differ in the level of estimated gains and in the ranking of some highly valued links. Where the rankings differ, network position determines how congestion and spatial adjustment alter a link's measured benefit.
abstract_zh: 我们如何评估交通基础设施投资的福利收益？我们提出一个定量空间框架，该框架整合了交通与基础设施改善的经济响应，并推导出总体福利对交通网络变化的弹性。由此得出的公式扩展了传统的“社会节约”方法，纳入了路线与模式选择、集聚与分散外部性以及交通拥堵因素。我们将该公式应用于美国货运网络，并评估了减少美国州际公路系统各路段成本所带来的收益。传统度量与扩展度量总体密切相关，但在估计收益水平及某些高价值路段的排序上存在差异。在排序不同的地方，网络位置决定了拥堵和空间调整如何改变路段的测量收益。
title: From Social Savings to Spatial Equilibrium: Evaluating Transportation Improvements in Quantitative Spatial Models
title_zh: 从社会储蓄到空间均衡：量化空间模型中交通改善的评估

abstract: We study how extended stockholder liability shaped bank resolution during and after the Panic of 1893, comparing California state banks (unlimited liability) with national banks (double liability). Using newly assembled data linking California state bank presidents to census records and national bank stock ownership data from Examination Reports, we measure managers’ personal exposures to extended liability. For California state banks, traditional fundamentals predict involuntary liquidations but do not explain voluntary exits. Instead, voluntary exits are driven by managers’ liability exposure, local economic risk, and personal wealth, consistent with managers responding to unlimited liability by initiating preemptive, orderly resolutions. For national banks under double liability, voluntary and involuntary liquidations are more similar, and personal exposure plays a smaller role in risk management. These findings show that substantial personal liability exposure can operate for modern prudential tools like compensation clawbacks and living wills. However, such extended liability also magnifies credit contractions during downturns, highlighting a fundamental tradeoff between micro-stability and macroeconomic fragility in regulatory design.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了1893年恐慌期间及之后，扩展的股东责任如何塑造了银行处置方式，对比了加利福尼亚州立银行（无限责任）与国民银行（双重责任）。利用新汇编的数据，将加州州立银行行长与人口普查记录及检查报告中的国民银行股权数据相链接，我们衡量了管理者对扩展责任的个人风险敞口。对于加州州立银行，传统基本面因素能预测非自愿清算，但无法解释自愿退出。相反，自愿退出由管理者的责任敞口、地方经济风险及个人财富驱动，这与管理者响应无限责任而采取预防性、有序处置的行为一致。对于实行双重责任的国民银行，自愿与非自愿清算更为相似，个人风险敞口在风险管理中的作用较小。这些发现表明，重大的个人责任敞口可类似于现代审慎工具，如薪酬追回和生前遗嘱，发挥作用。然而，此类扩展责任也会在经济下行期加剧信贷紧缩，凸显了监管设计中微观稳定性与宏观金融脆弱性之间的根本权衡。
title: Choosing To Fail: Managerial Liability, Risk Management and Voluntary Exits of Banks
title_zh: 选择失败：管理层责任、风险管理与银行自愿退出

abstract: We link two global trends—AI and geoeconomic fragmentation—asking how fragmentation affects the international diffusion of AI, the magnitude of gains, and their distribution across economies. We ask these questions in general but also with a focus on the MENAP economies. While the effects of AI are potentially far-reaching, the benefits are neither guaranteed nor even. Frontier AI innovation is concentrated in a small number of economies, while countries benefiting through supply-chain participation or AI adoption—with outcomes shaped by their position in global trade and production networks and their AI preparedness. Geoeconomic fragmentation slows AI diffusion and reshapes its distribution by raising trade costs, restricting technology and data flows, fragmenting digital services, and reducing cross-border investment and collaboration. Yet proactive policy choices can turn this dynamic: economies that position themselves as connectors—maintaining trade and technology links across multiple partners—can potentially capture diverted flows and outperform even the no-fragmentation benchmark. For the MENAP economies, diversified links with all major technology hubs can cushion the effects of fragmentation and provide a structural foundation to emerge as net beneficiaries of AI diffusion, but realizing that potential requires reducing AI-related trade costs, improving AI preparedness, and building local AI-related capacity.
abstract_zh: 我们将两大全球趋势——人工智能与地缘经济碎片化——联系起来，探讨碎片化如何影响人工智能的国际扩散、收益规模及其在各经济体间的分布。我们不仅从一般意义上提出这些问题，还特别关注中东、北非及阿富汗、巴基斯坦（MENAP）经济体。尽管人工智能的影响可能深远，但其益处既非必然也非均衡。前沿人工智能创新集中于少数经济体，而其他国家则通过参与供应链或采用人工智能获益——其结果受制于它们在全球贸易和生产网络中的地位及其人工智能准备度。地缘经济碎片化通过提高贸易成本、限制技术和数据流动、分割数字服务以及减少跨境投资与合作，减缓了人工智能的扩散并重塑其分布格局。然而，主动的政策选择可以扭转这一态势：那些将自己定位为连接者——与多个伙伴保持贸易和技术联系——的经济体，有可能捕获转移的流动，甚至超越无碎片化基准下的表现。对于MENAP经济体而言，与所有主要技术中心建立多元化联系可以缓冲碎片化的影响，并为成为人工智能扩散的净受益者提供结构性基础，但实现这一潜力需要降低与人工智能相关的贸易成本、提升人工智能准备度，并建设本地人工智能相关能力。
china_relevance_reason: 研究聚焦AI与地缘经济碎片化对全球及中东北非经济体的影响，未涉及中国数据、制度或政策背景，作者姓名不足以判定为中国研究。
title: AI in a Fragmenting World
title_zh: 碎片化世界中的AI

abstract: We study how in-store display ads communicate information about a product’s price and quality, both directly through ad content and indirectly through inferences consumers draw from the presence and content of the ad. We run an incentivized experiment in a simulated online store, randomizing ad exposure, ad content, and the advertised product’s price, while also eliciting participants’ beliefs and choices. Display ads shift beliefs about price and quality, even when the ad copy does not directly reveal either attribute. We provide evidence that these belief shifts have a causal effect on searches and purchases of the advertised product. Using a stylized search model, we show that while visibility explains most of the ad effects, belief updating explains a statistically and economically significant share. Casting ad content choice as an information design problem, we show that advertisers may find it optimal to conceal product information even when it exceeds consumers’ expectations.
abstract_zh: 我们研究店内展示广告如何通过广告内容直接传达产品价格与质量信息，同时通过消费者从广告的存在及内容中推断出的间接信息发挥作用。我们在一个模拟在线商店中进行了一项激励性实验，随机分配广告曝光、广告内容及广告产品的价格，同时收集参与者的信念与选择。展示广告即使未在广告文案中直接揭示价格或质量属性，也会改变消费者对这两者的信念。我们提供的证据表明，这些信念变化对广告产品的搜索与购买具有因果效应。通过一个简约的搜索模型，我们显示，尽管可见性解释了广告效应的大部分，信念更新则解释了统计上和经济上均显著的份额。将广告内容选择视为信息设计问题，我们表明，即使产品信息超出消费者预期，广告商也可能发现隐藏这些信息是最优策略。
title: The Effects of Ads on Beliefs and Implications for Consumer Search
title_zh: 广告对信念的影响及其对消费者搜索的启示

abstract: The existence of aggregate welfare gains from trade is one of the classic insights from international economics. However, these conventional welfare gains are static, in the sense that they take existing factor supplies and production technologies at a point in time as given. Recent research has highlighted dynamic effects of trade through endogenous factor accumulation and technological innovation over time, although there remains less consensus about the quantitative magnitude of these dynamic effects than about their static counterparts. Key insights from this research are that short-run and long-run responses to trade liberalization differ; capital accumulation amplifies the impact of international trade shocks; trade can facilitate technology adoption and the diffusion of ideas by changing the composition of suppliers; effects on lifetime welfare differ substantially from those on steady-state welfare, once transition dynamics are taken into account; and market failures can either magnify the overall welfare gains from trade or rationalize activist trade and industrial policies.
abstract_zh: 贸易带来的总体福利增益的存在是国际经济学中的经典洞见之一。然而，这些传统福利增益是静态的，即它们假定某一时点的要素供给和生产技术为既定。近期研究强调了贸易通过内生要素积累和技术创新随时间产生的动态效应，尽管对于这些动态效应的量化规模，共识程度不如静态对应效应。该研究的关键洞见包括：贸易自由化的短期与长期反应存在差异；资本积累放大了国际贸易冲击的影响；贸易通过改变供应商构成，能促进技术采纳和思想传播；一旦考虑转型动态，对终身福利的影响与对稳态福利的影响大相径庭；市场失灵既可能放大贸易带来的总体福利增益，也可能为积极的贸易和产业政策提供合理性依据。
china_relevance_reason: 论文研究国际贸易的动态效应，未涉及中国特定对象、数据或制度背景，属于一般性理论分析。
title: Dynamic Effects of Trade
title_zh: 贸易的动态效应

abstract: Which firms drive aggregate productivity growth? We document that firms with high price-earnings ratios tend to see increases in their subsequent earnings relative to sales, which we interpret as rents from ideas (innovation). We construct an endogenous growth model with shocks to firm innovation step-sizes and R&D efficiency and calibrate it to match patterns in the data. The model implies that growth would be much lower, even with the same innovative effort, if firms had the same step sizes. The model can be used to infer expected growth contributions of individual firms (such as members of the Magnificent Seven). We find that the share of growth coming from smaller listed firms substantially exceeds their sales share, whereas the largest listed firms account for less than their sales share.
abstract_zh: 哪些企业推动了总体生产率增长？我们记录到，市盈率较高的企业，其后续盈利相对于销售额往往有所增长，我们将此解读为来自创意的租金（即创新）。我们构建了一个内生增长模型，其中包含企业创新步长和研发效率的冲击，并对其进行校准以匹配数据中的模式。模型表明，即使创新努力相同，若企业步长相同，增长将大幅降低。该模型可用于推断个别企业（如“七巨头”成员）的预期增长贡献。我们发现，来自较小上市企业的增长份额显著超过其销售份额，而最大上市企业的增长贡献则低于其销售份额。
title: Idea Rents and Firm Growth
title_zh: 创意租金与企业成长

abstract: This paper revisits the empirical evidence on capital structure adjustment and the prevalence of financing “inaction.” We show that the conclusion of infrequent leverage adjustment is sensitive to two methodological choices: high adjustment thresholds and reliance on net balance-sheet changes. Using lower thresholds and gross flows from cash-flow statements, we find adjustment is far more frequent than previously documented, and the pattern reveals pronounced size-based heterogeneity. Smaller firms exhibit considerable inertia consistent with fixed costs; the largest firms (e.g., top 1% by assets) behave as if frictions are negligible. Frictionless recapitalization models thus better describe large-firm leverage dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了关于资本结构调整及融资“不作为”普遍性的实证证据。我们表明，杠杆调整不频繁的结论对两种方法论选择敏感：高调整阈值及依赖净资产负债表变动。采用较低阈值及现金流量表中的总流量，我们发现调整频率远高于先前文献所记载，且该模式揭示了显著的基于规模的异质性。较小企业表现出与固定成本相符的显著惯性；最大型企业（如按资产计前1%）则表现得仿佛摩擦可忽略不计。因此，无摩擦再资本化模型更能描述大型企业的杠杆动态。
title: More Frequent Than You Think: Revisiting Capital Structure Adjustment
title_zh: 比你想象的更频繁：资本结构调整再探

abstract: We explore the welfare costs of the loss of animal life in a consequentialist total utilitarian framework that incorporates the intrinsic value of living beings through their sentience. Moral philosophy and neuroscience define sentience as the capacity for valenced experience. Observable performance on cognitive tests represents a conservative lower bound on sentience under plausible neuroscientific assumptions. We estimate the relationship between cognition and neuron counts to cardinalize sentience. We collect population and neuron data for a wide range of animal species, and aggregate them into a single welfare measure. Across a wide range of parameters, the aggregate sentience losses of animals in the past half century outstrip the sentience gains to humans from population growth by at least 10,000-fold. Breaking even in welfare terms requires assigning a correspondingly small welfare weight to animals. Including the benefits of economic growth to humans does little to change these overall welfare losses.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了在后果主义总体功利主义框架下动物生命丧失的福利成本，该框架通过感知能力将生物的内在价值纳入考量。道德哲学与神经科学将感知能力定义为体验效价的能力。在合理的神经科学假设下，认知测试中的可观察表现代表了感知能力的一个保守下限。我们估算了认知与神经元数量之间的关系，以对感知能力进行基数化度量。我们收集了广泛动物物种的种群及神经元数据，并将其汇总为单一的福利指标。在广泛的参数范围内，过去半个世纪中动物的总体感知损失至少超过人口增长给人类带来的感知收益一万倍。要在福利上达到平衡，需要赋予动物相应微小的福利权重。将经济增长对人类的好处纳入考量，也几乎不会改变这些总体福利损失。
title: The Intrinsic Valuation of Biodiversity Loss
title_zh: 生物多样性损失的内在价值评估

abstract: We examine how prenatal exposure to air pollution interacts with gender-biased parental investments to shape long-run cognitive performance. Using nationally representative survey data from China, we show that fetal PM2.5 exposure significantly reduces cognitive ability for women, particularly among those with brothers. Our evidence suggests that the family investment channel operates primarily through education rather than health, with gender-biased educational resource allocation compounding negative outcomes for females. Specifically, conditional on the same level of fetal PM2.5 exposure, females receive less homework assistance from their families and attain lower levels of education.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了产前空气污染暴露如何与性别偏见的父母投资相互作用，从而影响长期认知表现。利用中国全国代表性调查数据，我们发现胎儿期PM2.5暴露显著降低女性的认知能力，尤其是有兄弟的女性。证据表明，家庭投资渠道主要通过教育而非健康发挥作用，性别偏见的教育资源分配加剧了女性的负面结果。具体而言，在胎儿期PM2.5暴露水平相同的情况下，女性从家庭获得的作业辅导较少，教育程度也较低。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Fetal Pollution Exposure, Cognitive Ability, and Gender-specific Parental Investment
title_zh: 胎儿污染暴露、认知能力与性别差异化的父母投资

abstract: Imitation is a first-order concern for enterprises operating global production processes. Firms routinely source knowledge-intensive inputs from many countries, including those with weak intellectual property laws. This column argues that firms pursue a particular strategy to protect their knowhow in such an environment: slicing production across multiple suppliers to ensure that no single supplier learns enough to imitate. In global micro data on the auto industry, the concentration of sourcing across suppliers is U-shaped in the strength of intellectual property rights – a pattern driven by the protection of high-tech components.
abstract_zh: 模仿对于运营全球生产流程的企业而言，是首要关注的问题。企业通常从多个国家采购知识密集型投入品，其中包括知识产权法律薄弱的国家。本文认为，在这种环境下，企业采取一种特定策略来保护其专有技术：将生产分散给多个供应商，以确保没有任何单一供应商能学到足够知识进行模仿。在汽车行业的全球微观数据中，供应商采购集中度与知识产权保护强度呈U型关系——这一模式由高科技组件的保护所驱动。
authors: Peter Eppinger, Bohdan Kukharskyy, Alireza Naghavi, Gianmarco Ottaviano
title: Firms slice up global production to protect their knowhow
title_zh: 企业分割全球生产以保护其专有技术

abstract: The labour force participation rate in the euro area has risen in recent years while it has declined in the US, significantly narrowing the gap between the two. This column analyses how demographic shifts are influencing the rate in both economies and finds that demographic changes are pushing participation lower, while education is an offsetting factor. The key distinction lies in within-group changes: in the euro area, these changes have significantly boosted participation, whereas in the US, they have had a small negative effect.
abstract_zh: 近年来，欧元区的劳动力参与率有所上升，而美国则出现下降，两者之间的差距显著缩小。本文分析人口结构变化如何影响这两个经济体的参与率，发现人口结构变化正推动参与率下降，而教育则是一个抵消因素。关键区别在于组内变化：在欧元区，这些变化显著提升了参与率，而在美国，它们产生了轻微的负面影响。
title: A comparison of labour force participation trends in the euro area and the US
title_zh: 欧元区与美国劳动力参与趋势的比较

abstract: We study efficient liquidity reallocation in a model of panic-based bank runs. We demonstrate that a competitive interbank market disciplines multiplicity in key equilibrium outcomes but cannot achieve the constrained efficient level of welfare when aggregate liquidity is low. A centralized reallocation of cash across banks can help tackle the underlying externality and achieve fewer bank failures. We examine a particular implementation that reallocates cash based on payment obligations between banks. An application to the Panic of 1873, where a similar policy was implemented by the New York Clearinghouse, illustrates the quantitative relevance of the mechanisms in our model.
abstract_zh: 我们研究恐慌性银行挤兑模型中的高效流动性再分配问题。我们证明，竞争性银行间市场在关键均衡结果上限制了多重性，但在总体流动性较低时无法达到约束效率水平的福利状态。银行间现金的集中再分配有助于解决潜在的外部性问题，并减少银行倒闭数量。我们考察了一种基于银行间支付义务进行现金再分配的具体实施方案。将该模型应用于1873年恐慌事件，当时纽约清算所实施了类似政策，这说明了我们模型中机制的数量重要性。
title: Liquidity Reallocation and Run Resolution
title_zh: 流动性再配置与挤兑化解

abstract: We revisit evidence on world cycles using a new quarterly macrofinancial dataset covering a broad set of countries from 1950 to the COVID-19 crisis. By filling historical data gaps, we show that previous studies overstated the influence of global factors on national GDP and credit fluctuations. Our central finding is a novel disconnect: asset prices have become increasingly synchronized under financial globalization, whereas output synchronization has remained low and stable. We propose a parsimonious model in which deeper financial integration raises risk-sharing and asset-price co-movement while encouraging riskier, less correlated production structures, thereby reconciling the observed patterns.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一套覆盖1950年至新冠疫情危机期间众多国家的新季度宏观金融数据集，重新审视了关于世界周期的证据。通过填补历史数据空白，我们表明先前研究高估了全球因素对各国GDP和信贷波动的影响。我们的核心发现是一个新颖的脱节现象：在金融全球化下，资产价格日益同步化，而产出同步性则保持低位且稳定。我们提出一个简约模型，其中更深的金融一体化提升了风险共担和资产价格联动，同时鼓励风险更高、相关性更低的生产结构，从而调和了观察到的模式。
title: World Cycles Revisited: Diverging Trends in Prices and Quantities
title_zh: 世界周期再探：价格与数量的分化趋势

abstract: Covenants mitigate agency frictions but can trigger asset sales at fire sale prices. I demonstrate covenant-driven fire sales and trace their real effects. Following a large negative oil-price shock, collateralized loan obligations exposed to oil-and-gas (O&G) firms approach their covenant thresholds and sell non-O&G loans, exerting price-pressure on non-O&G bonds and loans in primary and secondary markets. Affected non-O&G borrowers experience declines in financing, investment, R&D, and employment. Instrumenting CLO net loan sales with lenders’ O&G exposure, a one-percentage-point increase reduces firm investment by 0.08 percentage-points, 5% of mean investment. Covenant-induced liquidations can thus generate credit crunches via capital-market contagion.
abstract_zh: 契约条款能够缓解代理摩擦，但也可能在火线价格下触发资产出售。我展示了由契约驱动的火线销售及其实际影响。在油价大幅负面冲击之后，暴露于油气（O&G）企业的抵押贷款债务（CLO）接近其契约阈值，并出售非油气贷款，对一级和二级市场上的非油气债券和贷款施加价格压力。受影响的非油气借款人经历了融资、投资、研发和就业的下降。以贷款方的油气敞口作为CLO净贷款销售的工具变量，一个百分点的增加会使企业投资减少0.08个百分点，相当于平均投资的5%。因此，契约引发的清算可能通过资本市场传染导致信贷紧缩。
title: Covenant-Driven Fire Sales
title_zh: 契约驱动的抛售

abstract: This paper studies how demographics affect labor market power, the urban wage premium and the spatial concentration of population. Using disaggregated administrative data from Germany, I find that the labor supply elasticity to the firm decreases with age, suggesting that firms have more wage-setting power over older workers. I develop a quantitative spatial model in which labor market power depends on the composition of the local workforce. Calibrating the model with the reduced-form elasticity estimates shows that differences in labor supply elasticities across age groups explain 8% of the urban wage premium. Age and skill groups together account for 13%.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了人口结构如何影响劳动力市场力量、城市工资溢价及人口的空间集中。利用德国细分的行政数据，我发现企业对劳动力的供给弹性随年龄增长而下降，表明企业对老年工人拥有更强的工资设定权。我构建了一个定量空间模型，其中劳动力市场力量取决于当地劳动力的构成。通过将模型与简化形式的弹性估计进行校准，结果显示，不同年龄组间劳动力供给弹性的差异解释了城市工资溢价的8%。年龄与技能组共同解释了13%。
title: Demographics, Labor Market Power and the Spatial Equilibrium
title_zh: 人口结构、劳动力市场势力与空间均衡
